records.stem: What does Colin Dixon mean by saying "It's been the year of interactive television advertising for the last ten or twelve years" (Lines 4, Para. 1)?

options.text: Interactive television advertising will become popular in 10-12 years.
Interactive television advertising has been under debate for the last decade or so.
Interactive television advertising is successful when incorporated into situation comedies.
Interactive television advertising has not achieved the anticipated results.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （词义句意题）
【判型】 题干结构是 What does Colin Dixon mean by saying "..."，问的是某人说某句话是什么意思，本质是对一句原文的语义解读。
【拆句】 题干主干为 What does Colin Dixon mean by saying "..."，宾语从句问的是"说这句话意指什么"。by saying 是介词短语作方式状语，引号内整句是 saying 的宾语。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Interactive television advertising, which allows viewers to use their remote controls to click on advertisements, has been pushed for years. Nearly a decade ago it was predicted that viewers of "Friends", a popular situation comedy, would soon be able to purchase a sweater like Jennifer Aniston's with a few taps on their remote control. "It's been the year of interactive television advertising for the last ten or twelve years," says Colin Dixon of a digital-media consultancy. 交互式电视广告——让观众用遥控器点击广告——已被力推多年。差不多十年前就有预测说，《老友记》这部热门情景喜剧的观众很快就能用遥控器轻点几下，买到一件像 Jennifer Aniston 同款的毛衣。某数字媒体咨询机构的 Colin Dixon 说："过去十到十二年里，每一年都被说成是交互式电视广告之年。"

records.stem: What was SC Johnson accused of in the class-action lawsuits?

options.text: It gave consumers the impression that all its products were truly green.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What was SC Johnson accused of in the class-action lawsuits? 直接问被指控的具体内容，对应原文叙述句。
【拆句】 主干 What was SC Johnson accused of，被动语态：SC Johnson 是受动者；in the class-action lawsuits 作时间/事件状语，限定指控发生的场合。注意 accused of 后接的是"指控的内容"，原文对应表达可能是 misleading/gave the impression that…，需识别这一对应。
【定位】 P7 The lawsuits said that the label was misleading because it gave the impression that the products had been certified by a third party when the certification was the company's own. 诉讼指控该标签具有误导性，因为它给人留下产品已经过第三方认证的印象，而实际上该认证是公司自身做出的。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 It gave consumers the impression that all its products were truly green 把指控重点从"经第三方认证"偷换为"产品全都真正环保"，且 all 与 truly 在原文均无对应。 B) 与原文相反 It gave a third party the authority to label its products as environmentally friendly 说"授权第三方贴标"，正是原文否认的——原文为 the certification was the company's own，反向陈述。 C) ✓ 正确 the label was misleading ↔ It misled consumers gave the impression that the products had been certified by a third party ↔ to believe that its products had been certified by a third party C 项把"标签误导"与"让人以为经第三方认证"两层语义合并，并与定位句一一对应，与预判吻合。 D) 无中生有 It sold cleaning products that were not included in the official "Greenlist" 编造"卖了不在官方 Greenlist 里的清洁产品"，原文从未提及。原文 Greenlist 也并非"官方"清单，而是公司自有。

records.stem: How did Christopher Beard defend his company's labeling practice?

options.text: There were no clear guidelines concerning green labeling.

It was in conformity to the prevailing practice in the market.

records.explanation:

【判型】 How did Christopher Beard defend his company's labeling practice? 问的是"用何种说法辩护"，答案在原话里。
【拆句】 How 作方式状语，主干 did Christopher Beard defend his company's labeling practice。注意 his company's labeling practice 是"公司的标签做法"——即 Greenlist 的标注行为；考生若误读为"产品"会偏。
【定位】 P8 "We are very proud of our accomplishments under the Greenlist system and we believe that we will prevail in these cases," Christopher Beard, director of public affairs for SC Johnson, said, while acknowledging that "this has been an area that is difficult to navigate." "我们对 Greenlist 体系下取得的成就深感自豪，并且相信会在这些案件中胜诉。"SC Johnson 公共事务总监 Christopher Beard 这样说，同时也承认"这一直是一个难以把握的领域"。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 this has been an area that is difficult to navigate ↔ There were no clear guidelines concerning green labeling A 项把"难以把握"具象化为"没有明确指引"，正是 Beard 用以为公司开脱的核心辩护点。 B) 答非所问 His company's products had been well received by the public 谈"产品受欢迎"，原文未提及；Beard 提的是"自豪于 Greenlist 体系下的成就"，并非"公众反响好"。 C) 无中生有 It was in conformity to the prevailing practice in the market 说"符合行业普遍做法"，原文中 Beard 从未做过"大家都这么干"的辩解。 D) 无中生有 No law required the involvement of a third party in certification 称"法律没要求第三方介入"，原文未提任何法律层面的辩护。

【拆句】 What 作 imply 的宾语，by saying "…" 作方式状语；引语 It's kind of a Wild West 是名词性比喻——Wild West（蛮荒西部）象征"无序、无规、各自为政"。考生需识别比喻义而非字面义。

【选项】 A) 偷换概念 Businesses compete to produce green products 谈的是"竞相生产"，原文谈的是"自称环保"——重点是宣传/贴标，不是生产。 B) ✓ 正确 anybody can claim themselves to be green ↔ Each business acts its own way in green labeling Wild West ↔ Each business acts its own way B 项精准抓住"野西部=无统一规则、各自为政"的核心意涵，且与引语后半句的同位解释完全吻合。 C) 偷换概念 Consumers grow wild with products labeled green 把"野西部"的 wild 字面附着到 consumers 头上，谈"消费者疯狂"，与原文谈"行业无序"完全两码事。 D) 偷换概念 Anything produced in the West can be labeled green 把 Wild West 误解为字面地理意义上的"西部"，并嫁接到"产地→可贴绿标"的奇怪结论上。

records.stem: What do we learn about America's education system?

options.text: It provides a ladder of opportunity for the wealthy.
It contributes little to the elimination of inequality.
It has remained basically unchanged for generations.
It has brought up generations of responsible citizens.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about America's education system? 是问"关于美国教育体系我们了解到什么"，要的是原文已说出的事实表述，而不是隐含推断。
【拆句】 What do we learn about America's education system? 是标准疑问句，主干 we learn about America's education system，无从句、无否定、无比较，理解上无陷阱。

records.stem: With a tax imposed on expensive health insurance plans, most employers will likely transfer money from health expenses into wages.

records.stem: What does the author mean by saying "Teenagers at risk of depression, anxiety and suicide often wear their troubles like a neon sign" (Lines 1–2, Para. 1)?

options.text: Mental problems can now be found in large numbers of teenagers.
Teenagers' mental problems are getting more and more attention.
Teenagers' mental problems are often too conspicuous not to be observed.
Depression and anxiety are the most common symptoms of mental problems.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （词义句意题）
【判型】 题干 What does the author mean by saying 明确要求解释一句话的真实含义，标志着这是一道考查整句修辞含义的句意题。
【拆句】 主干是 What does the author mean by saying...?：宾语从句省略，引号内是被动语态 like 引导明喻，句子结构平铺直叙，无陷阱，重心在 like a neon sign 这个比喻。
【定位】 P1 Teenagers at risk of depression, anxiety and suicide often wear their troubles like a neon(霓虹灯) sign. Their risky behaviors—drinking too much alcohol, using illegal drugs, smoking cigarettes and skipping school—can alert parents and teachers that serious problems are brewing. 面临抑郁、焦虑与自杀风险的青少年，常常把自己的烦恼像霓虹灯一样挂在身上。他们的危险行为——酗酒、吸毒、抽烟、逃学——能提醒家长和老师严重问题正在酝酿。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 Mental problems can now be found in large numbers of teenagers 把焦点偷换为”患病人数多”，而原句讲的是”症状显眼”，与人数规模无关。 B) 无中生有 Teenagers' mental problems are getting more and more attention 谈”日益受到重视”，原文只字未提社会关注度的变化。 C) ✓ 正确 wear their troubles like a neon(霓虹灯) sign ↔ too conspicuous not to be observed can alert parents and teachers ↔ not to be observed 预判要点是”显眼+能被发现”，C 项 too conspicuous not to be observed 把两点压成一句，是定位句的精准同义改写。 D) 答非所问 Depression and anxiety are the most common symptoms 讨论”哪种症状最常见”，与题干所问的”霓虹灯句意”无关。

records.stem: What is the finding of the new study?

options.text: Teenagers' lifestyles have changed greatly in recent years.
Many teenagers resort to drugs or alcohol for mental relief.
Teenagers experiencing psychological problems tend to use a lot of media.
Many hitherto unobserved youngsters may have psychological problems.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What is the finding 指向一个具体的事实性结论，不是要推断也不是主旨概括。
【拆句】 What is the finding of the new study? 单主谓宾的极简疑问句，无修饰、无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 But a new study finds that there's another group of adolescents who are in nearly as much danger of experiencing the same psychiatric symptoms: teens who use tons of media, don't get enough sleep and have a sedentary(不爱活动的) lifestyle. 但一项新研究发现，还有另一群青少年同样处于经历这些精神症状的危险中：那些大量使用媒体、睡眠不足、久坐少动的青少年。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Teenagers' lifestyles have changed greatly in recent years 是一个时序变化论断，原文仅描述一群少年的当前状态，未做时序对比。 B) 张冠李戴 Many teenagers resort to drugs or alcohol for mental relief 描述的是 P1 中的高风险组特征，且原文从未说他们靠毒品酒精”自我缓解”，而是说这些行为本身是危险征兆。 C) 与原文相反 Teenagers experiencing psychological problems tend to use a lot of media 把因果方向颠倒：原文是”高媒介使用等行为→精神风险”，C 把”已有精神问题→倾向使用媒体”反着说。 D) ✓ 正确 another group of adolescents ↔ Many hitherto unobserved youngsters in nearly as much danger of experiencing the same psychiatric symptoms ↔ may have psychological problems 预判两要点：①一群被忽视的少年 ②同样有精神问题风险，D 项用 hitherto unobserved 与 may have psychological problems 一一对应。
records.keyword_relation: another group of adolescents ↔ Many hitherto unobserved youngsters；in nearly as much danger of experiencing the same psychiatric symptoms ↔ may have psychological problems

records.stem: Why do the researchers refer to teens who use tons of media, don't get enough sleep and have a sedentary lifestyle as the "invisible risk" group?

options.text: Their behaviors can be an invisible threat to society.
Their behaviors do not constitute a warning signal.
Their behaviors do not tend towards mental problems.
Their behaviors can be found in almost all teenagers on earth.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 Why do the researchers refer to...as the "invisible risk" group 问的是作者为何这样称呼，答案就在命名句旁边的解释里。
【拆句】 宾语从句 teens who use tons of media, don't get enough sleep and have a sedentary lifestyle 是三个并列动词词组作 who 的定语，描述同一群青少年，结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 Because their behaviors are not usually seen as a red flag, these young people have been dubbed the "invisible risk" group by the study's authors. 因为他们的行为通常不被视为危险信号，这些少年被研究的作者们称为”隐性风险”组。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Their behaviors can be an invisible threat to society 把”隐性”嫁接到”社会威胁”上，原文只谈对个人精神健康的风险，从未上升到社会危害。 B) ✓ 正确 not usually seen as a red flag ↔ do not constitute a warning signal 预判要点是”不被当作危险信号”，B 项就是 not...a red flag 的字面同义翻译。 C) 与原文相反 Their behaviors do not tend towards mental problems 说他们的行为不会导致精神问题，而原文整段都在强调这些行为同样会引发精神症状——方向完全相反。 D) 以偏概全 Their behaviors can be found in almost all teenagers on earth 借用了 every teenager on the planet，但原文紧接着用 But 强调”只有把三项都做到极端的少年才真正危险”，D 把这条限定吞掉了。

records.stem: What does the new study find about the invisible group?

options.text: They are almost as liable to depression as the high-risk group.
They suffer from depression without showing any symptoms.
They do not often demonstrate risky behaviors as their peers.
They do not attract the media attention the high-risk group does.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does the new study find about the invisible group 仍是问一个具体的客观发现，不需要推断。
【拆句】 What does the new study find about the invisible group? 介词 about 引出对象限定，单层疑问句，无陷阱。
【定位】 P7 The group that scored high on all nine of the risk behaviors was most likely to show symptoms of depression; in all, nearly 15% of this group reported being depressed, compared with just 4% of the low-risk group. But the invisible group wasn't far behind the high-risk set, with more than 13% of them exhibiting depression. 在九种风险行为上得分都高的那一组最容易表现出抑郁症状；总体而言，这一组中近 15% 的人报告称自己抑郁，而低风险组仅 4%。但隐性风险组并不比高风险组落后多少，超过 13% 的人表现出抑郁。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 the invisible group wasn't far behind the high-risk set ↔ almost as liable to depression as the high-risk group more than 13% of them exhibiting depression ↔ liable to depression 预判要点是”几乎不亚于高风险组”，A 项用 almost as...as 与 the high-risk group 把对比关系与对比对象一并写出。 B) 与原文相反 They suffer from depression without showing any symptoms 说他们抑郁却”无症状”，而原文清清楚楚说 13% of them exhibiting depression，恰恰是有症状被研究观察到。 C) 答非所问 They do not often demonstrate risky behaviors as their peers 答的是”隐性”何来，是 53 题层面问题，而非 54 题问的”新研究关于他们的发现”。 D) 无中生有 They do not attract the media attention the high-risk group does 谈媒体注意度，原文从未谈及媒体对两组的报道差异。

records.stem: What is the significance of Vladimir Carli's study?

options.text: It offers a new treatment for psychological problems among teenagers.
It provides new early-warning signals for identifying teens in trouble.
It may have found an ideal way to handle teenagers with behavioral problems.
It sheds new light on how unhealthy behaviors trigger mental health problems.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What is the significance of Vladimir Carli's study 问的是研究者本人在文中陈述的研究意义，是明示性陈述，不必推断。
【拆句】 What is the significance of Vladimir Carli's study? 简单主系表疑问句，of 短语作定语限定 study，无陷阱。
【定位】 P9 Carli says that one of the most significant things about his study is that it provides new early-warning signs for parents, teachers and mental health-care providers. Carli 说，他研究最重要的意义之一在于，它为家长、老师和心理保健工作者提供了新的早期预警信号。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 It offers a new treatment for psychological problems among teenagers 把”早期预警信号”升级为”新治疗方法”，原文末句虽提及 treatment，但研究本身提供的是预警而非治疗。 B) ✓ 正确 provides new early-warning signs for parents, teachers and mental health-care providers ↔ provides new early-warning signals for identifying teens in trouble 预判要点是”提供新的早期预警信号”，B 项几乎原词复现 early-warning signals，把信号面向的目的写出。 C) 过度推断 It may have found an ideal way to handle teenagers with behavioral problems 把研究的意义升级为”找到了理想的处置办法”，原文只说”提供新的早期预警信号”，远没有 ideal way 这种程度。 D) 无中生有 It sheds new light on how unhealthy behaviors trigger mental health problems 谈”揭示不健康行为如何引发心理问题的机制”，原文未做任何机制层面的解释。

records.stem: What does Dr. Sadoway think of energy storage?

options.text: It involves the application of sophisticated technology.
It is the direction energy development should follow.
It will prove to be a profitable business.
It is a technology benefiting everyone.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What does Dr. Sadoway think of energy storage? 直接问具体人物的具体观点，属于可在原文中找到原句出处的细节题。
【拆句】 Q46 是常规 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 Dr. Sadoway think of energy storage 中 think of 是固定短语「对……的看法」，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 But Sadoway isn't alone in trumpeting energy storage as a missing link to a cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future. 但 Sadoway 并不是唯一一个把储能鼓吹为通向更清洁、更高效、更公平能源未来之关键缺口的人。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 It involves the application of sophisticated technology. 谈的是「涉及高深技术」，而定位句只评价储能在能源未来中的地位，未提及技术是否 sophisticated。 B) ✓ 正确 a missing link to a cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future ↔ the direction energy development should follow cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future ↔ energy development 预判说「储能是能源未来必经之路」，B 选项 the direction energy development should follow 是同一意思的抽象表达，逻辑等值。 C) 偷换概念 It will prove to be a profitable business. 把储能定义为「会被证明是赚钱的生意」，而 P1 Sadoway 表述的是其能源价值，并未评判利润前景。 D) 过度推断 It is a technology benefiting everyone. 把储能升格为「让每个人都受益」，但 P1 只提到 more equitable 这一个限定，并未做「人人受益」的全称承诺。
records.keyword_relation: a missing link to a cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future ↔ the direction energy development should follow；cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future ↔ energy development

evidence.text: But Sadoway isn't alone in trumpeting energy storage as a missing link to a cleaner, more efficient, and more equitable energy future

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：It involves the application of sophisticated technology. 谈的是「涉及高深技术」，而定位句只评价储能在能源未来中的地位，未提及技术是否 sophisticated。
distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：It will prove to be a profitable business. 把储能定义为「会被证明是赚钱的生意」，而 P1 Sadoway 表述的是其能源价值，并未评判利润前景。

【拆句】 Q47 主干 What is most likely to happen 是 What 作主语的疑问句；when 引导的时间状语从句 when advanced batteries become widely used 限定时机，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 Having already enabled a communications revolution, the battery is now poised to transform just about everything else. 电池已成就了一场通信革命，如今则势将变革几乎所有其他领域。

Having already enabled a communications revolution ↔ revolutionary changes 预判「几乎所有领域将被变革」即 The world will undergo revolutionary changes.——the world 覆盖 everything else 的范围、revolutionary changes 对应 transform。

records.explanation:

【判型】 In some rural communities of emerging economies, people have begun to ___________. 是要求补全谓语行为的不完整陈述句，本质上仍在问「这些社区做了什么具体的事」。

【定位】 P4 Instead, some in Africa and Asia are seeing their first lightbulbs illuminated by the power of sunlight stored in batteries. 相反，非洲和亚洲的部分地区，第一盏灯泡正被电池中储存的阳光所点亮。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 find digital devices simply indispensable 谈「数字设备不可或缺」，但 P4 谈的是电力供应方式而非数字设备的依赖度。 B) 偷换概念 communicate primarily by mobile phone 谈手机通讯，但 P4 讨论的是供电而非通讯方式。 C) ✓ 正确 their first lightbulbs illuminated ↔ light their homes the power of sunlight stored in batteries ↔ stored solar energy 预判「用储存的太阳能点亮家」与 light their homes with stored solar energy 的主谓宾完全对应，无歧义。 D) 与原文相反 distribute power with wires and wooden poles 与原文 rural communities are bypassing the wires and wooden poles that spread power 直接矛盾——原文说「跳过电线杆」，选项说「用电线杆配电」。

【拆句】 Q50 主干 What does the author imply about the centralized electric grid，imply about 表「对……作出何种暗示」，无从句、无否定、无陷阱。
【定位】 P7 What happens to the centralized electric grid, which took decades and billions of dollars to build, as more and more people become "prosumers," who produce and consume their own energy onsite? 当越来越多的人成为「产消者」——自产自用能源——耗费数十年和数十亿美元建成的集中电网，将何去何从？
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 What happens to the centralized electric grid … as more and more people become "prosumers," ↔ It might become a thing of the past. took decades and billions of dollars to build ↔ a thing of the past 预判「集中电网可能走向终结」即 It might become a thing of the past.——might 体现「推断而非断言」的克制，a thing of the past 体现「淡出、被取代」的语义。 B) 张冠李戴 It might turn out to be a "prosumer". 把电网当成 prosumer，但 as more and more people become "prosumers," 明确把 prosumers 限定为「人」——集中电网是被产消者削弱的对象，而不是产消者本身。 C) 与原文相反 It will be easier to operate and maintain. 暗示电网未来更易运维，但全段以 risks 起头、以 What happens to the centralized electric grid 作反问收束——作者隐含的是「集中电网的处境堪忧」，与「更易运维」相反。 D) 过度推断 It will have to be completely transformed. 中 will have to 与 completely 把作者克制的反问/隐忧夸大为「必须彻底改造」的强断言——原文只表「命运不明」，未承诺「必须、彻底」。

records.stem: Du Bois was opposed to the use of race as ________.

options.text: a basis for explaining human genetic diversity
an aid to understanding different populations
an explanation for social and cultural differences
a term to describe individual human characteristics

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 Du Bois was opposed to the use of race as ________ 问的是某人具体反对把 race 当作什么，是对原文一句话的客观转述。
【拆句】 Du Bois was opposed to the use of race as ________：be opposed to 是被动结构的固定搭配，意为「反对」；as ________ 引出反对的对象身份（把 race 当作什么）。空格处填的内容是 as 的宾语补足语，对应「race 被用作什么」。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 American sociologist W. E. B. Du Bois was concerned that race was being used as a biological explanation for what he understood to be social and cultural differences between different populations of people. 美国社会学家 W. E. B. Du Bois 担心的是：race（种族）正在被用作一种生物学解释，去解释他所理解的本质上是社会和文化层面的群体差异。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 a basis for explaining human genetic diversity 把 race 与 genetic diversity 挂钩——这是文章后半段 Yudell 等人的现代议题，而非 Du Bois 一百多年前反对的内容。 B) 与原文相反 an aid to understanding different populations 把 race 包装成「理解不同人群的助力」，但 Du Bois 反对的恰是这种「用 race 来理解群体」的做法，而非把它当工具。 C) ✓ 正确 race was being used as a biological explanation for what he understood to be social and cultural differences ↔ an explanation for social and cultural differences 预判「反对把 race 当社会文化差异的解释」与 an explanation for social and cultural differences 句意完全重合，直接锁 C。 D) 偷换概念 a term to describe individual human characteristics 强调「描述个体特征」，而原文 Du Bois 反对的是用 race 解释不同 populations（群体）之间的差异，与「个体特征」无关。

evidence.text: American sociologist W. E. B. Du Bois was concerned that race was being used as a biological explanation for what he understood to be social and cultural differences between different populations of people

records.stem: The study by Svante Pääbo served as an example to show ________.

records.explanation:

records.stem: The example of the disease cystic fibrosis underdiagnosed in people of African ancestry demonstrates that ________.

options.text: it is absolutely necessary to put race aside in making diagnosis

records.stem: What is Yudell's suggestion to scientists?

options.text: They should be more precise with the language they use.
They refrain from using politically sensitive terms.
They throw out irrelevant concepts in their research.
They examine all possible variables in their research.

【定位】 P6 Yudell said scientists need to get more specific with their language, perhaps using terms like "ancestry" or "population" that might more precisely reflect the relationship between humans and their genes, on both the individual and population level. Yudell 说科学家需要在用词上更精确，或许可以采用 ancestry（祖源）或 population（人群）这类词，它们也许能更准确地反映人类与基因之间的关系，无论在个体层面还是群体层面。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 scientists need to get more specific with their language ↔ They should be more precise with the language they use. 预判「用词更精确」与 They should be more precise with the language they use. 句意一致，且原句的每个成分（主语、情态、核心形容词、宾语）都在选项里同义保留，锁 A。 B) 无中生有 They refrain from using politically sensitive terms. 让科学家「避免使用政治敏感词」，原文从未提及 sensitive 一词；Yudell 实际是承认 race 作为政治社会变量仍有用（P7），并非要避开政治色彩词。 C) 过度推断 They throw out irrelevant concepts in their research. 让科学家「抛弃无关概念」，但原文并未让 Yudell 主张丢弃 race，而是建议用更精确的词替代；且 race 在 P7 中仍被认为对某些研究 useful，并非 irrelevant。 D) 答非所问 They examine all possible variables in their research. 让科学家「考察所有可能的变量」，原文 Yudell 谈的是用词更精确（语言层面），不是要考察更多变量（研究方法层面）。

records.stem: What can be inferred from Yudell's remark in the last paragraph?

options.text: Clinging to racism prolongs inequity and discrimination.
Physiological disparities are quite striking among races.
Doing away with racial discrimination is challenging.
Racial terms are still useful in certain fields of study.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （推断题）
【判型】 What can be inferred from Yudell's remark in the last paragraph? 中 inferred 是推断题的硬标志。
【拆句】 What can be inferred from Yudell's remark in the last paragraph?：被动式 can be inferred 表示「能够被推断出什么」；from Yudell's remark in the last paragraph 是推断的来源限定（末段 Yudell 的话）。结构清晰，关键是认出 inferred 这个题型信号。
【定位】 P7 "While we argue phasing out racial terminology in the biological sciences, we also acknowledge that using race as a political or social category to study racism, although filled with lots of challenges, remains necessary given our need to understand how structural inequities and discrimination produce health disparities between groups." 「虽然我们主张在生物科学中逐步淘汰种族术语，但我们也承认：把 race 作为一种政治或社会范畴来研究种族主义，尽管面临大量挑战，但仍然是必要的——因为我们需要理解结构性不平等和歧视如何在不同群体间造成健康差异。」
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Clinging to racism prolongs inequity and discrimination. 把话题反转成「死守种族主义会延长不平等」，但 Yudell 末段是承认研究 racism 仍有必要，并未谈到「死守 racism」会怎样。 B) 偷换概念 Physiological disparities are quite striking among races. 说「种族间生理差异相当明显」，但原文 health disparities 指的是「健康差异」，而且这些差异是结构性不平等和歧视造成的（社会原因），并非由生理差异主导。 C) 偷换概念 Doing away with racial discrimination is challenging. 把 challenging 安到「消除种族歧视」上，但原文 filled with lots of challenges 修饰的是「把 race 作为政治社会范畴去研究 racism」这件事，不是「消除歧视」。 D) ✓ 正确 using race as a political or social category to study racism, although filled with lots of challenges, remains necessary ↔ Racial terms are still useful in certain fields of study. there are a few areas where race as a construct might still be useful in scientific research ↔ Racial terms are still useful in certain fields of study. 预判「race 在某些领域仍有用」与 Racial terms are still useful in certain fields of study. 完全一致，且 P6 与 P7 双重印证 still useful 与 certain fields 两个核心点，锁 D。

records.stem: What do chain smokers think of cigarette packaging?

options.text: Fancy packaging can help to engage new smokers.
It has little to do with the quality or taste of cigarettes.
Plain packaging discourages non-smokers from taking up smoking.
It has little impact on their decision whether or not to quit smoking.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What do chain smokers think of cigarette packaging? 直接问某人群对某事物的具体看法，不含 infer/suggest/imply，是典型细节题。
【拆句】 What do chain smokers think of cigarette packaging? 是标准 what 引导的特殊疑问句，主语 chain smokers、谓语 think of、宾语 cigarette packaging，结构平铺、无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Any veteran nicotine addict will testify that fancy packaging plays no role in the decision to keep smoking. 任何资深烟民都会作证，花哨的包装在是否继续吸烟的决定中起不到任何作用。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念：偷换观点持有者 原文谈的是"老烟民对包装的看法"，A 把视角偷换成"包装能否拉新烟民"（engage new smokers），这是 P2 政府视角，不是题干所问 chain smokers 的视角。 B) 无中生有：原文话题外的属性 B 项中的 the quality or taste of cigarettes 在全文中没有任何陈述——原文从头到尾讨论的是包装与吸烟行为的关系，从未提及香烟本身的品质或口味。 C) 偷换概念：偷换观点持有者 + 偷换话题对象 C 项谈的是 Plain packaging discourages non-smokers from taking up smoking，对应 discourage new generations from starting in the first place，这是政府视角对 plain packaging 的功能阐述，而题干问的是 chain smokers 对一般 cigarette packaging 的看法。 D) ✓ 正确 fancy packaging plays no role in the decision to keep smoking ↔ It has little impact on their decision whether or not to quit smoking D 项在两端做了等值改写：no role → little impact、keep smoking → whether or not to quit smoking，与预判完全吻合。

records.stem: What has the UK government agreed to do concerning tobacco packaging?

options.text: Pass a law to standardise cigarette packaging.
Rid cigarette cartons of all advertisements.
Subsidise companies to adopt plain packaging.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What has the UK government agreed to do concerning tobacco packaging? 直接问政府同意做的一件具体事，是细节复述题。
【拆句】 What has the UK government agreed to do concerning tobacco packaging? 主干为 What has the UK government agreed to do，介词短语 concerning tobacco packaging 限定话题范围，结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 But that isn't why the government—under pressure from cancer charities, health workers and the Labour party—has agreed to legislate for standardised packaging. 但这并不是政府在癌症慈善机构、卫生工作者和工党的压力下同意为标准化包装立法的原因。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 has agreed to legislate for standardised packaging ↔ Pass a law to standardise cigarette packaging A 项在动作词（legislate→pass a law）与对象词（standardised packaging→standardise cigarette packaging）两端都做了等值改写，与预判一一对应。 B) 偷换概念：用历史动作冒充本次承诺 原文政府承诺的是 legislate for standardised packaging（立法实现标准化包装），并非 Rid cigarette cartons of all advertisements（去掉烟盒上所有广告）；广告禁令在 banning advertising 中提及，但那是政府的历史动作，不是 P2 这次新承诺的内容。 C) 无中生有：杜撰未提及的执行手段 C 项 Subsidise companies to adopt plain packaging 中"补贴企业去采用 plain packaging" 在原文中完全没有依据——政府是用立法强制，不是用补贴诱导。 D) 偷换概念：颠倒手段与目的的指向 原文 Plain packaging would be another step in the reclassification of cigarettes from inviting consumer products to narcotics 提到的 reclassification 是"把香烟从消费品重新分类为麻醉剂"，分类的依据是产品属性而非包装本身；D 项 Reclassify cigarettes according to packaging 颠倒了因果，把 plain packaging 推动重新分类的过程，偷换成"按包装来分类香烟"。

records.stem: What has happened in Australia where plain packaging is implemented?

options.text: Premature death rates resulting from smoking have declined.
The number of smokers has dropped more sharply than in the UK.
The sales of tobacco substitutes have increased considerably.
Cigarette sales have been falling far more quickly than in the UK.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What has happened in Australia where plain packaging is implemented? 问澳大利亚在执行该政策后发生了什么，是事实复述。
【拆句】 What has happened in Australia where plain packaging is implemented? 主句问 what has happened，where 引导定语从句修饰 Australia、说明背景；要识别"在已执行该政策的澳大利亚发生了什么"这一限制条件。
【定位】 P3 This approach has led over time to a fall in smoking with numbers having roughly halved since the 1970s. Evidence from Australia suggests plain packaging pushes society further along that road. 这种做法长期以来使吸烟人数下降，自 1970 年代以来吸烟人数大约减半。来自澳大利亚的证据表明，plain packaging 会让社会沿这条路走得更远。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念：偷换结果指标 原文 plain packaging pushes society further along that road 中 that road 指"吸烟人数下降"，并非"过早死亡率下降"——虽然 tobacco is one of the biggest causes of premature death in the UK 提到了 premature death，但那是"为何值得尝试 plain packaging"的论据，不是"澳大利亚发生的结果"。 B) ✓ 正确 plain packaging pushes society further along that road ↔ The number of smokers has dropped more sharply than in the UK B 项把 further（更远）转写为 more sharply（更陡），并显化了 that road 所指的英国吸烟下降，与预判完全吻合。 C) 无中生有：杜撰未提及的相关概念 C 项中的 tobacco substitutes（烟草替代品）在全文中没有任何对应——文中讨论的是 plain packaging 对吸烟率的影响，而非任何替代产品的销量。 D) 偷换概念：相近但不等值的指标替换 D 项 Cigarette sales have been falling far more quickly than in the UK 有两处偏差：其一，原文谈的是吸烟者人数（numbers 指吸烟人数），不是 cigarette sales（香烟销量）；其二，原文 plain packaging pushes society further along that road 在澳大利亚的语境是"已经实现的结果"，但 "销量下降" 与 "吸烟人数下降" 并非同一指标——前者衡量市场，后者衡量行为。

records.stem: Why has it taken so long for the UK government to consider plain packaging?

options.text: Prime Minister Cameron has been reluctant to take action.
There is strong opposition from veteran nicotine addicts.
Many Members of Parliament are addicted to smoking.
Pressure from tobacco manufacturers remains strong.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 Why has it taken so long for the UK government to consider plain packaging? 问"为何拖这么久"，原文有显性陈述，不需推断。
【拆句】 Why has it taken so long for the UK government to consider plain packaging? 主句 Why has it taken so long，it 为形式主语，真正主语是不定式 for the UK government to consider plain packaging，要识别这一形式主语结构。
【定位】 P5 But strength of will is the missing ingredient where Mr. Cameron and public health are concerned. His attitude to state intervention has looked confused ever since his bizarre 2006 lament(叹惜) that chocolate oranges placed seductively at supermarket checkouts fueled obesity. 但在 Cameron 先生与公共健康问题上，意志的强度正是缺失的那一味要素。从 2006 年他离奇地为超市收银台旁诱人摆放的巧克力橘子"助长肥胖"而叹惜以来，他对国家干预的态度一直显得迷茫。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 But strength of will is the missing ingredient where Mr. Cameron and public health are concerned. ↔ Prime Minister Cameron has been reluctant to take action The government has moved reluctantly into a sensible public health policy ↔ Prime Minister Cameron has been reluctant to take action A 项 reluctant to take action 与 P5 的 strength of will is the missing ingredient 等值，与 P6 的 moved reluctantly 直接呼应，是预判的同义改写。 B) 偷换概念：偷换原文人物的角色 原文 Any veteran nicotine addict will testify that fancy packaging plays no role in the decision to keep smoking. 中 veteran nicotine addicts 是被引证的旁观者，他们"作证"包装与戒烟无关，并未"强烈反对"立法；B 项把这一旁观引证偷换成了"老烟民构成强烈反对"。 C) 无中生有：杜撰人物的私人属性 C 项 Many Members of Parliament are addicted to smoking 在全文找不到依据——原文 MPs voted overwhelmingly in favour of Labour amendments 谈的是 MPs 投票支持立法，恰恰与"自己沉迷吸烟"相反。 D) 偷换概念：背景常态冒充直接原因 原文 Naturally, the tobacco industry is violently opposed. 确实说烟草业激烈反对，但这是行业的常态立场，作者并未把它列为"拖延了 5 年"的直接原因；P5 给出的拖延归因是 Cameron 缺意志，并非烟草厂商的压力。

It is too expensive for most young people.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （主旨题）
【判型】 What is the author's opinion of going to university 没有任何细节性钩子，直接问作者对整件事的态度/结论，属于全文性的主旨/态度判断。
【拆句】 题干主干 What is the author's opinion of going to university 极简：疑问代词 What 作表语 + be 动词 + 主语 the author's opinion + of 引导对象。无从句、无否定、无比较，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 Yet it still pays to go to university ↔ It is worthwhile after all they have little choice but to embrace university ↔ It is worthwhile after all it still pays = worthwhile，still/after all 共同承载"虽有抱怨但终究如此"的让步语气，正是先抑后扬全文的最大公约数。 B) 以偏概全 simply a waste of time 只对应第 1、2 段的负面铺垫，忽略了 Yet it still pays 之后的整片正向论证；且 simply（仅仅是）口吻过强，与作者两面权衡的立场相反。 C) 与原文相反 作者立场清晰——"上大学仍然值得"——并非"不好说"。hard to say whether it is good or bad 把先抑后扬误读成"作者也没立场"，掩盖了 Yet it still pays 这一明确表态。 D) 以偏概全 too expensive for most young people 借用首段 £44,000 of debt 的事实，但作者从未下结论"对大多数年轻人太贵"——相反，他在第 3 段提示 you only start repaying when you are earning £21,000 a year，承认还款门槛对低收入毕业生友好。把数字事实直接抬到"作者总观点"是局部冒充整体。

records.stem: What does the author say about the employment situation of British university graduates?

options.text: Few of them are satisfied with the jobs they are offered.
It usually takes a long time for them to find a decent job.
Graduates from elite universities usually can get decent jobs.
Most of them take jobs which don't require a college degree.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say about the employment situation 问的是作者就具体话题陈述了什么事实，无 infer/imply/main idea 标记，属于细节题。
【拆句】 题干主干 What does the author say about the employment situation of British university graduates：助动词 does + 主语 the author + 实义动词 say + 介词短语 about ... 引出话题。of 短语充当 employment situation 的后置定语，框定主体范围。结构清晰、无从句、无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 And graduating doesn't even provide any guarantee of a decent job: six in ten graduates today are in non-graduate jobs. 而且毕业也根本不能保证一份体面的工作：如今十个毕业生里有六个干的是不需要大学学历的活儿。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 原文只提及"工作是否需要学历"这一客观属性，从未谈及毕业生对工作"满意/不满意"的主观感受。 B) 无中生有 原文谈的是"找到的工作够不够体面"，从未提"找一份工作要花多久"，时间维度是凭空引入的。 C) 张冠李戴 原文确有 Recruiters circle elite universities like vultures 一句，但那是"招聘者围猎名校生"，是 Q54 的素材，与本题问"整体毕业生就业现状"错位。 D) ✓ 正确 six in ten graduates today are in non-graduate jobs ↔ Most of them take jobs which don't require a college degree 六成被同义量化为 Most，non-graduate jobs 被关系从句解释，两端语义等值，与预判完全吻合。

records.stem: What does the author say is important for university students besides classroom instruction?

options.text: Making sure to obtain an upper-second class degree.
Practical skills they will need in their future careers.
Interactions among themselves outside the classroom.
Developing independent and creative thinking abilities.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say is important ... besides classroom instruction 问的是某具体方面（非课堂的重要因素）作者说了什么，答案应能从一两句原文中直接读出。
【拆句】 题干 What does the author say is important for university students besides classroom instruction 中 What 同时充当 say 的宾语和后置 is 的主语，是一个省略关系代词的嵌套结构——本质等于 "What [the author says] is important ... besides ..."。besides 引导的介词短语作状语，表示"除……之外"。这是六级常见的嵌入式疑问句，结构稍密，但理解为"作者说什么东西很重要"即可。
【定位】 P3 It's not just the lectures and tutorials that are important. Education is the sum of what students teach each other in between lectures and seminars. 重要的并不只是课堂讲授与辅导。教育，等于学生们在课堂与讨论课之间相互教给对方的一切之和。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 lack a 2.1, i.e., an upper-second class degree 出现在第 4 段说"用人单位会卡 2.1 学位线"，是顶级岗位招聘的硬门槛、不是"课堂之外什么对学生重要"。 B) 无中生有 原文从未提及 practical skills / future careers 这一组合；这是套用了"大学应教实用技能"的常识，与文本无关。 C) ✓ 正确 what students teach each other in between lectures and seminars ↔ Interactions among themselves outside the classroom "互相教对方"是一种最典型的 interaction；"课堂之间"自然落在"课堂之外"，与预判完全吻合。 D) 无中生有 Developing independent and creative thinking abilities 是国内素质教育语境的高频套话，原文从头到尾未出现 independent 或 creative 的对应表述。

evidence.text: It's not just the lectures and tutorials that are important. Education is the sum of what students teach each other in between lectures and seminars

records.stem: What is said to be an advantage of going to university?

options.text: Learning how to take risks in an ever-changing world.
Meeting people who will be helpful to you in the future.
Having opportunities of playing a leading role in society.
Gaining up-to-date knowledge in science and technology.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What is said to be an advantage 用被动 is said 引出，问的是某一项被陈述的具体好处，属可在原文直接找到的细节。
【拆句】 题干 What is said to be an advantage of going to university：被动语态 is said to be，What 作表语；of going to university 是 advantage 的后置定语。语态被动但内容明确，无陷阱。
【定位】 P4 Students at university also meet those likely to be in leading jobs in the future, forming contacts for life. 在大学里，学生还能结识那些未来可能身居要职的人，由此结下一辈子的人脉。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Learning how to take risks in an ever-changing world 整句话原文未提；take risks 与 ever-changing world 都是凭空添加的现代叙事词。 B) ✓ 正确 meet those likely to be in leading jobs in the future, forming contacts for life ↔ Meeting people who will be helpful to you in the future 未来身居要职者结成终身人脉 → 对自己将来有帮助，是定位句直接的同义改写。 C) 过度推断 原文是 meet those likely to be in leading jobs——上大学的人是"结识"将来身居要职者，并非自己"扮演 leading role"。把 meet leading-job people 推到 play a leading role 多走了一步。 D) 无中生有 原文谈"人脉"与"招聘"，从未提及 up-to-date knowledge in science and technology；这是"上大学就学最新知识"的常识脑补。

evidence.text: Students at university also meet those likely to be in leading jobs in the future, forming contacts for life

records.stem: What can we infer from the last paragraph?

options.text: It is natural for students to make complaints about university education.
Few students are willing to bear the burden of debt incurred at university.
University education is becoming attractive to students who can afford it.
The prestige of the university influences employers' recruitment decisions.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （推断题）
【判型】 What can we infer from the last paragraph 的 infer 是推断题硬标志，需要从末段陈述出发做一步推理。
【拆句】 题干 What can we infer from the last paragraph：情态动词 can + 主语 we + 动词 infer + 介词短语 from the last paragraph 指明推理来源。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 Perhaps the reason why so many universities offer their students so little is they know studying at a top university remains a brilliant investment even if you don't learn anything. Studying at university will only become less attractive if employers shift their focus away from where someone went to university—and there is no sign of that happening anytime soon. 也许那么多大学之所以给学生提供得那么少，是因为他们清楚：哪怕你什么都没学到，在顶级大学念书仍然是一笔绝佳投资。只有当用人单位不再以"你出自哪所大学"作为录用焦点时，上大学才会变得不再吸引人——而短期内看不到任何这种迹象。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 原文 School-leavers may moan 只是承接前文情绪化描述，并非"末段推断"的核心；"学生抱怨大学是常态"是文字面表层意思，不算 infer。 B) 与原文相反 原文末句明说 they have little choice but to embrace university and the student debt that comes with it——学生别无选择只能接受债务；选项 Few students are willing to bear the burden of debt 把"被迫接受"偷换成"几乎没人愿意承担"。"被迫接受" ≠ "不愿承担"，且原文是"接受"，选项是"不接受"，方向相反。 C) 与原文相反 原文是"大学投资回报仍丰、雇主标准未变 ⇒ 上大学仍然吃香"——是"持续吸引人"，选项 becoming attractive to students who can afford it 暗示"正在变得吸引（之前不太吸引）"且把范围缩到"付得起的人"，两处都与原文不符。"付得起的人"在原文也无对应。 D) ✓ 正确 Studying at university will only become less attractive if employers shift their focus away from where someone went to university ↔ The prestige of the university influences employers' recruitment decisions studying at a top university remains a brilliant investment even if you don't learn anything ↔ The prestige of the university influences employers' recruitment decisions 把"only ... if ..."和"no sign of that"合起来读，等于雇主当前仍以出身院校论英雄，与预判完全吻合。
records.keyword_relation: Studying at university will only become less attractive if employers shift their focus away from where someone went to university ↔ The prestige of the university influences employers' recruitment decisions；studying at a top university remains a brilliant investment even if you don't learn anything ↔ The prestige of the university influences employers' recruitment decisions

evidence.text: Perhaps the reason why so many universities offer their students so little is they know studying at a top university remains a brilliant investment even if you don't learn anything. Studying at university will only become less attractive if employers shift their focus away from where someone went to university—and there is no sign of that happening anytime soon

distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：原文末句明说 they have little choice but to embrace university and the student debt that comes with it——学生别无选择只能接受债务；选项 Few students are willing to bear the burden of debt 把"被迫接受"偷换成"几乎没人愿意承担"。"被迫接受" ≠ "不愿承担"，且原文是"接受"，选项是"不接受"，方向相反。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：原文是"大学投资回报仍丰、雇主标准未变 ⇒ 上大学仍然吃香"——是"持续吸引人"，选项 becoming attractive to students who can afford it 暗示"正在变得吸引（之前不太吸引）"且把范围缩到"付得起的人"，两处都与原文不符。"付得起的人"在原文也无对应。

【答案】 H) outcome 名词
【词性槽】 形容词 learning 后跟名词中心词
【依据】 learning outcome = 学习成果，是教育术语 learning outcome 是教育评价里的固定表达，意思是"学习成果"，与后文 such as a graduate's ability to investigate and reason 解释"调查与推理能力"完全吻合——本段正是在说"用学习成果衡量教学质量"。
【竞争词】 I) predominance 义不通：学习的优势地位 predominance 意为"主导、优势地位"，learning predominance 在英文里没有这种搭配，也不能用"调查推理能力"作其例子。 K) reputation 义不通：学习的名声 reputation 多与 for/of 搭配表"某人某事的名声"，learning reputation 不是地道表达，也与 such as 后"具体能力"对应不上。
records.keyword_relation: learning outcome = 学习成果，是教育术语

evidence.text: Purdue now has a pilot test to assess students' critical thinking skills. Yet like many college teachers around the U.S., the faculty remain  {{29}}  that their work as educators can be measured by a "learning  {{30}}  " such as a graduate's ability to investigate and reason. However, the professors need not worry so much. The results of a recent experiment showed that professors can use  {{31}}  metrics to measure how well students do in three key areas: critical thinking, written communication, and quantitative literacy.

distractor_explanations.I: 义不通：学习的优势地位：predominance 意为"主导、优势地位"，learning predominance 在英文里没有这种搭配，也不能用"调查推理能力"作其例子。
distractor_explanations.K: 义不通：学习的名声：reputation 多与 for/of 搭配表"某人某事的名声"，learning reputation 不是地道表达，也与 such as 后"具体能力"对应不上。

records.stem: 选择第 31 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 O) standardized 形容词
【词性槽】 形容词修饰复数名词 metrics
【依据】 standardized metrics = 标准化的量表 本段主旨是 Purdue now has a pilot test to assess students' critical thinking skills，要客观评估就需要"标准化的衡量指标"——standardized 与 metrics/test/measure 是英语里高度凝固的搭配，正好回应上文 faculty 对"教学被量化"的担忧。
【竞争词】 C) demanding 义偏：苛刻的指标 demanding metrics 强调"要求高、难达标"，本句重点不在"难"而在"统一、可比"，与"科学测量三大能力"主旨不合。 D) doubtful 义反：可疑的指标 doubtful metrics 意为"令人怀疑的指标"，与作者"教授们其实不必担心，因为指标可用"的肯定态度正好相反，逻辑南辕北辙。
records.keyword_relation: standardized metrics = 标准化的量表

evidence.text: Purdue now has a pilot test to assess students' critical thinking skills. Yet like many college teachers around the U.S., the faculty remain  {{29}}  that their work as educators can be measured by a "learning  {{30}}  " such as a graduate's ability to investigate and reason. However, the professors need not worry so much. The results of a recent experiment showed that professors can use  {{31}}  metrics to measure how well students do in three key areas: critical thinking, written communication, and quantitative literacy.

distractor_explanations.C: 义偏：苛刻的指标：demanding metrics 强调"要求高、难达标"，本句重点不在"难"而在"统一、可比"，与"科学测量三大能力"主旨不合。
distractor_explanations.D: 义反：可疑的指标：doubtful metrics 意为"令人怀疑的指标"，与作者"教授们其实不必担心，因为指标可用"的肯定态度正好相反，逻辑南辕北辙。

records.stem: 选择第 32 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 B) confirm 动词
【词性槽】 并列连词 and 后承接谓语动词
【依据】 本次结果"印证了"以往研究 本段主线是 far fewer students were achieving at high levels on critical thinking than they were doing for written communication or quantitative literacy，新实验得到了和以往研究相同的悲观结论——"confirm earlier studies"意为"证实了以往研究的结论"，与开篇 a nationwide study of college graduates had shown that more than a third had made no __(26)__ gains in such mental abilities 前后呼应。
【竞争词】 M) signify 义偏：意味着以往研究 signify 表"意味着、表示"，宾语通常是抽象事物（significance、importance），signify earlier studies 在英语里不成搭配，也不能传达"印证"之义。
【易错】 最具迷惑性的错误词是 M) —— signify 与 confirm 中文同译为"表示"易混 。考生若把 signify 当成"证实"会与正解 confirm 撞车；防坑：记住 signify 的主语多为符号/现象、宾语为抽象意义，而"实验结果印证以往研究"的固定搭配只有 confirm earlier studies。
records.keyword_relation: 本次结果"印证了"以往研究

evidence.text: Despite the success of the experiment, the actual results are worrisome, and mostly  {{32}}  earlier studies. The organizers of the experiment concluded that far fewer students were achieving at high levels on critical thinking than they were doing for written communication or quantitative literacy. And that conclusion is based only on students nearing graduation.

distractor_explanations.M: 义偏：意味着以往研究：signify 表"意味着、表示"，宾语通常是抽象事物（significance、importance），signify earlier studies 在英语里不成搭配，也不能传达"印证"之义。

records.stem: 选择第 33 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 K) reputation 名词
【词性槽】 形容词 global 修饰的名词
【依据】 reputation for sth = 因……著称 reputation for + 名词是"因……享有声誉"的固定结构，global reputation for excellence in teaching 自然意味"在教学卓越方面享有全球声誉"，与后文 have only begun to demonstrate what they can produce 形成"美名在外，但实证不足"的对比逻辑。
【竞争词】 I) predominance 义偏 + 搭配不成立 predominance 意为"主导地位"，常与 of 搭配（the predominance of X），不与 for 搭，且不像 reputation 那样能承接"as known for excellence"的语义。
records.keyword_relation: reputation for sth = 因……著称

evidence.text: American universities, despite their global  {{33}}  for excellence in teaching, have only begun to demonstrate what they can produce in real-world learning. Knowledge-based degrees are still important, but employers are  {{34}}  advanced thinking skills from college graduates. If the intellectual worth of a college degree can be  {{35}}  measured, more people will seek higher education—and come out better thinkers.

distractor_explanations.I: 义偏 + 搭配不成立：predominance 意为"主导地位"，常与 of 搭配（the predominance of X），不与 for 搭，且不像 reputation 那样能承接"as known for excellence"的语义。

records.stem: 选择第 34 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 C) demanding 动词
【词性槽】 are 后跟现在分词构成进行时
【依据】 雇主"要求"毕业生具备高级思维能力 本段语境 Knowledge-based degrees are still important, but employers are __(34)__ advanced thinking skills from college graduates 转折说"知识型学位仍重要，但雇主正要求……"，demand sth from sb 是"向某人要求某物"的固定搭配，正好对接前文"批判性思维是高校核心目标"的论点。
【竞争词】 G) monopolized 义不通：雇主垄断思维能力 monopolize 意为"垄断"，搭配宾语多为 market/industry/conversation；雇主"垄断毕业生的思维能力"不合逻辑，且形式上 are monopolized 是被动语态，与 advanced thinking skills 作宾语冲突。 J) presuming 义偏：雇主假定思维能力 presume 意为"推测、假定"，多带 that 从句或抽象事物，are presuming advanced thinking skills 表达"假定其存在"，与后文 from college graduates 配不上"向毕业生索取"的方向。
【易错】 最具迷惑性的错误词是 J) —— presuming 与 demanding 同为 -ing 形式词性正确 。考生若只看词性会在 demanding/presuming 间犹豫；防坑：盯紧空后的介词 from——demand sth from sb 才是固定搭配，presume sth from sb 不通，看介词比看词义更快。
records.keyword_relation: 雇主"要求"毕业生具备高级思维能力

evidence.text: American universities, despite their global  {{33}}  for excellence in teaching, have only begun to demonstrate what they can produce in real-world learning. Knowledge-based degrees are still important, but employers are  {{34}}  advanced thinking skills from college graduates. If the intellectual worth of a college degree can be  {{35}}  measured, more people will seek higher education—and come out better thinkers.

distractor_explanations.G: 义不通：雇主垄断思维能力：monopolize 意为"垄断"，搭配宾语多为 market/industry/conversation；雇主"垄断毕业生的思维能力"不合逻辑，且形式上 are monopolized 是被动语态，与 advanced thinking skills 作宾语冲突。
distractor_explanations.J: 义偏：雇主假定思维能力：presume 意为"推测、假定"，多带 that 从句或抽象事物，are presuming advanced thinking skills 表达"假定其存在"，与后文 from college graduates 配不上"向毕业生索取"的方向。

records.stem: 选择第 35 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 A) accurately 副词

【依据】 回扣"准确测量学位价值"的全文主线 全文一直在讨论如何客观、可信地证明大学培养出了批判性思维，accurately measured 正好抓住这一主线——"如果大学学位的智识价值能被准确衡量"，逻辑承接末句 more people will seek higher education—and come out better thinkers。

records.stem: A number of factors are driving down the global oil prices not just for now but in the foreseeable future.
records.explanation:
【答案】 D 段（强锚点）
【锚点】 多重因素＋未来油价持续走低
【定位】 D 段 Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer. The advent of new technologies has added about 4.2 million barrels per day to the crude oil market, contributing to a global over-supply. In addition, other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes. 预计油价将在更长时间内保持更低。新技术的出现每天给原油市场新增约 420 万桶，导致全球供过于求。此外，还有多种因素继续压低油价：欧佩克战略行为的改变、伊朗出口的预期增长、全球需求的缩减（尤其是来自新兴市场）、美国石油消费的长期下降，以及替代品对石油的部分挤占。
【改写】 A number of factors are driving down the global oil prices ↔ other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices 并列因素＋向下方向的同义替换 not just for now but in the foreseeable future ↔ Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer 时间长度的同义改写
【辨邻】 C Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014 只讲了跌幅事实，没有 A number of factors 与 foreseeable future 同时落地的并列因素清单。 Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014 E Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived 锁定的是 gas/coal，而非 global oil prices。 Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived
records.keyword_relation: A number of factors are driving down the global oil prices ↔ other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices；not just for now but in the foreseeable future ↔ Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer

evidence.text: Oil prices are expected to remain lower for longer. The advent of new technologies has added about 4.2 million barrels per day to the crude oil market, contributing to a global over-supply. In addition, other factors are putting downward pressure on oil prices: change in the strategic behavior of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries, the projected increase in Iranian exports, the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets), the long-term drop in petroleum consumption in the United States, and some displacement of oil by substitutes

distractor_explanations.C: Oil prices have dropped by over 60% since June 2014 只讲了跌幅事实，没有 A number of factors 与 foreseeable future 同时落地的并列因素清单。
distractor_explanations.E: Natural gas and coal—also fossil fuels—have similarly seen price declines that look to be long-lived 锁定的是 gas/coal，而非 global oil prices。

records.stem: Pricing carbon proves the most economical way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
records.explanation:
【答案】 L 段（强锚点）
【锚点】 碳定价＝最经济的减排方式
【定位】 L 段 Economic reasoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions. 经济学推理表明，对每个国家而言，最便宜的方式就是给碳排放定价。
【改写】 Pricing carbon ↔ put a price on carbon emissions 动名词与动词短语的句式转换 the most economical way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions ↔ the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions 正反向最高级同义
【辨邻】 M Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon 只在论证 价格对齐机制，没有把碳定价说成 最便宜的减排路径。 Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon N Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitute for a carbon price 是从反面贬低补贴，没有正面给出最高级判断。 Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitute for a carbon price
records.keyword_relation: Pricing carbon ↔ put a price on carbon emissions；the most economical way to reduce greenhouse gas emissions ↔ the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions

evidence.text: Economic reasoning shows that the least expensive way for each country is to put a price on carbon emissions

distractor_explanations.M: Setting the right carbon price will therefore efficiently align the costs paid by carbon users with the true social opportunity cost of using carbon 只在论证 价格对齐机制，没有把碳定价说成 最便宜的减排路径。
distractor_explanations.N: Direct subsidies to research and development have been adopted by some governments but are a poor substitute for a carbon price 是从反面贬低补贴，没有正面给出最高级判断。

records.stem: It is estimated that extreme weather conditions have endangered the lives of millions of African children.
records.explanation:
【答案】 J 段（强锚点）
【锚点】 极端天气危及数百万非洲儿童
【定位】 J 段 For example, the United Nations Children's Fund estimates that some 11 million children in Africa face hunger, disease, and water shortages as a result of the strongest El Nino weather phenomenon in decades. 例如，联合国儿童基金会估计，约 1100 万非洲儿童因数十年来最强的厄尔尼诺天气现象而面临饥饿、疾病与缺水。
【改写】 extreme weather conditions ↔ the strongest El Nino weather phenomenon in decades 具体气候事件 → 上位概括 millions of African children ↔ 11 million children in Africa 具体数字 → 量级上位 endangered the lives of ↔ face hunger, disease, and water shortages 结果聚合的同义

records.stem: The prices of coal are low as a result of over-supply and decreasing demand.
records.explanation:
【答案】 E 段（强锚点）
【锚点】 煤价因供过于求与需求下降而低
【定位】 E 段 Coal prices also are low, owing to over-supply and the scaling-down of demand, especially from China, which burns half of the world's coal. 煤炭价格同样很低，其原因是供过于求与需求下降，尤其是来自中国的需求下降，中国消耗了全世界一半的煤炭。
【改写】 The prices of coal are low ↔ Coal prices also are low 主语换序＋同义 over-supply and decreasing demand ↔ over-supply and the scaling-down of demand 近义短语逐字对位
【辨邻】 D contributing to a global over-supply 与 the scaling-down of global demand (especially from emerging markets) 都讲油，没讲煤。 contributing to a global over-supply

records.stem: Higher fossil fuel prices prove to be conducive to innovation and application of cleaner technology.
records.explanation:
【答案】 H 段（强锚点）
【锚点】 高化石燃料价格利于清洁技术创新与应用
【定位】 H 段 There is strong evidence that both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices. 有强力证据表明，更高的化石燃料价格能够有力地推动清洁技术的创新与采用。
【改写】 Higher fossil fuel prices ↔ higher fossil fuel prices 几乎逐字一致 conducive to innovation and application of cleaner technology ↔ both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged 近义动词＋被动主动转换

distractor_explanations.A: low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy technologies 的因（low prices）与果（discourage）都与陈述句相反。

records.stem: If fossil fuel prices remain low for a long time, it may lead to higher emissions of greenhouse gases.
records.explanation:
【答案】 A 段（强锚点）
【锚点】 化石燃料长期低价 → 温室气体排放升高
【定位】 A 段 Notwithstanding important recent progress in developing renewable fuel sources, low fossil fuel prices could discourage further innovation in, and adoption of, cleaner energy technologies. The result would be higher emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases. 尽管可再生能源近年来取得了重要进展，但低化石燃料价格可能阻碍清洁能源技术的进一步创新与采用。其结果将是二氧化碳和其他温室气体的排放升高。
【改写】 fossil fuel prices remain low for a long time ↔ Fossil fuel prices are likely to stay low for long 时间长度的同义 it may lead to higher emissions of greenhouse gases ↔ The result would be higher emissions of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases 因果连接词的同义＋上位概括
【辨邻】 H both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices 只立论于 higher prices，没有把 低价持续 → 高排放 这条结论说出。 both innovation and adoption of cleaner technology are strongly encouraged by higher fossil fuel prices I The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to clean energy sources 的结论是 延迟转型，与陈述句的 排放升高 不对位。 The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to clean energy sources

distractor_explanations.I: The current low fossil fuel price environment will thus certainly delay the energy transition from fossil fuel to clean energy sources 的结论是 延迟转型，与陈述句的 排放升高 不对位。

records.stem: Even major fossil exporting countries have great potential to develop renewable energies.
records.explanation:

【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say about the shrinking spending of international tourists in the U.S.? 问的是作者就一个具体现象给出了什么说法，落点在文章对该现象的客观陈述，不要求推断也不要求归纳全文。

【定位】 P3 The company pledged to cut 600 back-office positions, though some 150 workers in those roles would be reassigned to other jobs. records.stem: What is the impact of rubbish dumps on wildlife?

options.text: They have forced white storks to search for safer winter shelters.
They have seriously polluted the places where birds spend winter.
They have accelerated the reproduction of some harmful insects.
They have changed the previous migration habits of certain birds.

records.explanation:

【判型】 What is the impact of rubbish dumps on wildlife?问的是一个具体客观事实——X对Y产生了什么影响，不带infer／suggest／imply类信号词。
【拆句】 主干是What is the impact of rubbish dumps on wildlife?——What作表语提问，主语是the impact，of rubbish dumps是impact的修饰（影响的发出者），on wildlife是impact的指向对象（影响的承受者）。句子平铺直叙，无陷阱。

Instead of flying thousands of miles in search of food, they make the waste sites their winter feeding grounds. 巨大的垃圾堆和肆意扩张的填埋场，是人类对野生动物造成的较为令人不安的影响之一。它们已经导致一些鸟类放弃迁徙。这些鸟不再飞越数千英里去寻找食物，而是把垃圾场当成它们的越冬觅食地。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 They have forced white storks to search for safer winter shelters.说鸟去寻找「更安全的」避寒处，但原文明说鸟把垃圾场当作winter feeding grounds，且垃圾场被Flack描述为very risky，恰恰不安全，与原文相反。 B) 无中生有 They have seriously polluted the places where birds spend winter.说垃圾场严重污染了鸟的越冬地，但原文谈的是「垃圾场本身成了越冬地」，并未说垃圾场污染了「鸟原本的越冬地」，无对应。 C) 张冠李戴 They have accelerated the reproduction of some harmful insects.说垃圾场加速了害虫繁殖，但White storks feed on locusts and other insects that can become pests的主语是white storks以蝗虫等为食，谈的是鸟为生态服务的作用；「加速繁殖」既未提，主语也错位。 D) ✓ 正确 led some birds to give up on migration ↔ changed the previous migration habits of certain birds 预判要的是「让鸟不再迁徙」，changed the previous migration habits of certain birds正是这层意思的上位表述（「放弃」是「改变」的子集），且无其他选项触及「迁徙习惯」。

records.stem: What do we learn about birds following the traditional migration routes?

options.text: They can multiply at an accelerating rate.
They can better pull through the winter.
They help humans kill harmful insects.
They are more likely to be at risk of dying.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about birds following the traditional migration routes?问的是关于某类鸟的客观陈述，是细节复现题。
【拆句】 主干What do we learn about birds，following the traditional migration routes是现在分词短语作birds的后置定语，限定「哪类鸟」——是「走传统迁徙路线的」那一类，与「停在垃圾场过冬」的那一类对比。
【定位】 P3 Andrea Flack of the Max Planck Institute found that birds following traditional migration routes were more likely to die than German storks that flew only as far as northern Morocco, and spent the winter there on rubbish dumps. Max Planck研究所的Andrea Flack发现，遵循传统迁徙路线的鸟比那些只飞到摩洛哥北部并在那里垃圾场过冬的德国白鹳更容易死亡。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 They can multiply at an accelerating rate.说传统路线鸟「加速繁殖」，但原文从未涉及任何鸟的繁殖率，全段在谈「存活率」。 B) 与原文相反 They can better pull through the winter.说传统路线鸟「更能熬过冬天」，但原文明说他们were more likely to die——死亡率更高即更难熬过冬天，方向反了。 C) 张冠李戴 They help humans kill harmful insects.说「帮人类杀害虫」，原文White storks feed on locusts and other insects that can become pests谈的确是白鹳吃害虫的生态作用，但这一作用属于全体白鹳的物种属性，并非特指「走传统路线的鸟」，与Q52题干主语错配。 D) ✓ 正确 more likely to die ↔ more likely to be at risk of dying 预判要的是「更容易死」，D项把die包装成be at risk of dying，比较方向（more likely）与对象（traditional路线的鸟）都对得上，是唯一保留比较方向且语义一致的选项。

records.stem: What does Andrea Flack say about the birds overwintering on rubbish dumps?

options.text: They may end up staying there permanently.
They may evolve new feeding habits.
They may have trouble getting adequate food.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What does Andrea Flack say about the birds overwintering on rubbish dumps?问某人对某事的具体说法，是引语细节题。
【拆句】 主干What does Andrea Flack say，about the birds是say的宾语介短，overwintering on rubbish dumps是现在分词后置定语修饰birds——指「在垃圾场过冬的那群鸟」，与传统路线鸟相区分。
【定位】 P4 "It's very risky. The birds can easily eat pieces of plastic or rubber bands and they can die," said Flack. "And we don't know about the long-term consequences. They might eat something toxic and damage their health. We cannot estimate that yet." 「风险很大。鸟很容易吃下塑料碎片或橡皮筋，然后死掉。」Flack说。「而且我们不知道长期后果。它们可能吃下有毒物质而损害健康。我们目前还无法估算这一点。」
【选项】 A) 过度推断 They may end up staying there permanently.说鸟可能「永久留在垃圾场」，但原文只谈「在垃圾场过冬」（over wintering），是季节性行为，未提任何「永久」信号。 B) ✓ 正确 They might eat something toxic and damage their health. ↔ They may eat something harmful. 预判要的是「可能吃到有害物」，They may eat something harmful.逐词对应原文might eat something toxic，是教科书式的「情态等值+毒→害上位化」组合改写。 C) 无中生有 They may evolve new feeding habits.说鸟「可能进化出新的觅食习惯」，evolve／new feeding habits在原文找不到对应；Flack的话题是健康风险，不是觅食习惯演化。 D) 与原文相反 They may have trouble getting adequate food.说鸟「可能难以获得足够食物」，但原文For the birds it's a very convenient way to get food. There are huge clusters of organic waste they can feed on明说食物又多又方便，与「难以获得」完全相反。

records.stem: What can be inferred about the Spanish birds tagged in the study?

options.text: They gradually lose the habit of migrating in winter.
They prefer rubbish dumps far away to those at home.
They are not attracted to the rubbish dumps on their migration routes.
They join the storks from Germany on rubbish dumps in Morocco.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （推断题）
【判型】 What can be inferred about the Spanish birds tagged in the study?含be inferred信号词，明确要求做一步推理而非直接复述。
【拆句】 主干What can be inferred about the Spanish birds，tagged in the study是过去分词作Spanish birds的后置定语（被研究标记的那群西班牙鸟），限定研究范围内的样本，不是泛指所有西班牙鸟。
【定位】 P6 Landfill sites on the Iberian peninsula have long attracted local white storks, but all of the Spanish birds tagged in the study flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel. 伊比利亚半岛上的垃圾填埋场长期以来一直吸引着当地的白鹳，但研究中被标记的所有西班牙鸟都飞越撒哈拉沙漠到了西非Sahel。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 They gradually lose the habit of migrating in winter.说西班牙鸟「逐渐丧失迁徙习惯」，但原文恰恰相反——这批鸟「飞越撒哈拉」完成了远距离迁徙，证明迁徙习惯保留得好好的，是过推+反向。 B) 过度推断 They prefer rubbish dumps far away to those at home.说鸟「偏好远处的垃圾场胜过本地的」，但原文未说这批鸟去Sahel是为了「那里的垃圾场」，他们去的是Sahel（越冬地）而非Sahel的垃圾场；同时prefer...to...是主动偏好，原文无主观偏好证据。 C) ✓ 正确 all of the Spanish birds tagged in the study flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel ↔ They are not attracted to the rubbish dumps on their migration routes. 预判要的是「宁可远飞也不停本地垃圾场」，not attracted to the rubbish dumps on their migration routes正是把「飞越而过」明示为「未被吸引」，是这一步推断的精准表达。 D) 与原文相反 They join the storks from Germany on rubbish dumps in Morocco.说西班牙鸟「在摩洛哥垃圾场与德国鸟会合」，但原文明说西班牙鸟flew across the Sahara desert to the western Sahel——他们飞过了撒哈拉到Sahel，根本没停在摩洛哥；摩洛哥垃圾场停的是德国鸟。

records.stem: What is scientists' other concern about white storks feeding on landfills?

options.text: The potential harm to the ecosystem.
The genetic change in the stork species.
The spread of epidemics to their homeland.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What is scientists' other concern问的是科学家的「另一个」具体担忧，是要找原文明示的客观陈述。
【拆句】 主干What is scientists' other concern about white storks feeding on landfills?——other修饰concern暗示「除前文已提之外」，about white storks feeding on landfills是concern的内容介短，feeding on landfills是现在分词作后置定语修饰storks。
【定位】 P7 But that's not the only uncertainty. Migrating birds affect ecosystems both at home and at their winter destinations, and disrupting the traditional routes could have unexpected side effects. 但这不是唯一的不确定性。迁徙鸟同时影响起点和越冬地的生态系统，而扰乱传统迁徙路线可能带来意想不到的副作用。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 Migrating birds affect ecosystems both at home and at their winter destinations, and disrupting the traditional routes could have unexpected side effects. ↔ The potential harm to the ecosystem. 预判要的是「对生态系统的潜在影响」，A项把affect ecosystems（动词短语）+could have side effects（情态+负面后果）合并为harm to the ecosystem+potential（名词+形容词），是双重包装但完全等值。 B) 无中生有 The genetic change in the stork species.说「鹳物种的基因变化」，但原文从未涉及genetic／基因层面的描述，只谈行为（迁徙改变）与生态影响。 C) 无中生有 The spread of epidemics to their homeland.说「流行病传到家乡」，epidemics／流行病在全文找不到对应；原文谈的是吃塑料／有毒物的个体健康风险，不是种群间的传染病。 D) 偷换概念 The damaging effect on bio-diversity.说「对生物多样性的破坏」，bio-diversity与ecosystems看似近义但概念不同——前者特指物种数量／丰富度，后者指系统整体。原文用的是ecosystems（系统），并未谈到bio-diversity（多样性）。

records.explanation:

【依据】 trigger mental pictures = 触发心理图像 trigger 是“激发/触发”，正面或中性色彩，可与 mental pictures 搭配表“调出脑海中的图像”；与全文“说出关键词加速大脑反应”的主旨一致：用语言线索去“触发”大脑里的图片，加快搜索。

records.stem: What do we learn about the decision of technical and community colleges in Tennessee?

【拆句】 What do we learn about the decision of technical and community colleges in Tennessee? 是一个直接特殊疑问句，about 后面带一个长名词短语，里面 of technical and community colleges in Tennessee 是 the decision 的两层后置修饰（of 短语 + in 短语）；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Tennessee's technical and community colleges will not outsource(外包) management of their facilities to a private company, a decision one leader said was bolstered by an analysis of spending at each campus. 田纳西州的技术学院与社区学院不会把它们的设施管理外包给私营公司，一位领导者说这一决定有 "对各校园开支的一份分析" 作支撑。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 a decision one leader said was bolstered by an analysis of spending at each campus ↔ It is backed by a campus spending analysis. 选项 It is backed by a campus spending analysis. 把 bolster 换成 back，把 of 短语压成复合名词，语义和预判 "决定有开支分析作支撑" 一一对应。 B) 看清谁拒绝了谁 It has been flatly rejected by the governor. 的 rejected by the governor 与 Governor Bill Haslam's proposal to privatize management of state buildings 中州长 "提出外包" 的事实相反——是 Morgan 不接受州长的方案，不是州长否决学院的决定。 C) 无中生有 It has neglected their faculty's demands. 中 faculty's demands（教师诉求）在原文没有任何对应：文中提到的是 Workers' advocates（工人权益倡导者），并非 faculty（教师），也未出现 demands 这一指控。 D) 过度推断 It will improve their financial situation. 把改善财务状况说成学院决定的结果；原文里 in an effort to save money 是州长想 "为州里省钱" 才提出外包的动机，并未说不外包能改善学院财务。

evidence.text: Tennessee's technical and community colleges will not outsource(外包) management of their facilities to a private company, a decision one leader said was bolstered by an analysis of spending at each campus

distractor_explanations.B: 看清谁拒绝了谁：It has been flatly rejected by the governor. 的 rejected by the governor 与 Governor Bill Haslam's proposal to privatize management of state buildings 中州长 "提出外包" 的事实相反——是 Morgan 不接受州长的方案，不是州长否决学院的决定。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：It has neglected their faculty's demands. 中 faculty's demands（教师诉求）在原文没有任何对应：文中提到的是 Workers' advocates（工人权益倡导者），并非 faculty（教师），也未出现 demands 这一指控。

records.stem: What does the campus spending analysis reveal?

options.text: Private companies play a big role in campus management.

Facilities management has greatly improved in recent years.
Colleges exercise full control over their own financial affairs.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What does the campus spending analysis reveal? 问的是分析揭示了什么客观事实，仍属对原文结论句的转述。
【拆句】 What does the campus spending analysis reveal? 是 What 作宾语前置的特殊疑问句，主语是 the campus spending analysis，谓语 reveal；结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 outgoing Chancellor John Morgan said an internal analysis showed that each campus' spending on facilities management fell well below the industry standards identified by the state. 即将离任的校长 John Morgan 说，一份内部分析显示，每一所校园在设施管理上的开支都远低于该州认定的行业标准。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Private companies play a big role in campus management. 与原文方向直接相反——分析得出的结论恰恰是 "不需要外包给私企"，raising the question of the value of pursuing a broad scale outsourcing initiative 是在反问外包的必要性。 B) ✓ 正确 each campus' spending on facilities management fell well below the industry standards ↔ Facilities management by colleges is more cost-effective. "开支低于业内标准 + 学院自己在管" 两段信息合起来就是 "由学院来管反而更省钱"，与选项 Facilities management by colleges is more cost-effective. 完全等值。 C) 无中生有 Facilities management has greatly improved in recent years. 中 in recent years 的时间纵向比较，全文没有任何依据；原文只做 "当前校园开支 vs 当前业内标准" 的横向比较，未涉及历史改进。 D) 以偏概全 Colleges exercise full control over their own financial affairs. 中 full control over financial affairs 的全权说法在原文没依据；原文只谈一笔具体开支（设施管理）低于业内标准，并未谈学院整体财权的归属。
records.keyword_relation: each campus' spending on facilities management fell well below the industry standards ↔ Facilities management by colleges is more cost-effective.

evidence.text: outgoing Chancellor John Morgan said an internal analysis showed that each campus' spending on facilities management fell well below the industry standards identified by the state

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：Private companies play a big role in campus management. 与原文方向直接相反——分析得出的结论恰恰是 "不需要外包给私企"，raising the question of the value of pursuing a broad scale outsourcing initiative 是在反问外包的必要性。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：Facilities management has greatly improved in recent years. 中 in recent years 的时间纵向比较，全文没有任何依据；原文只做 "当前校园开支 vs 当前业内标准" 的横向比较，未涉及历史改进。

records.stem: Workers' supporters argue that Bill Haslam's proposal would _________.

options.text: deprive colleges of the right to manage their facilities

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 Workers' supporters argue that Bill Haslam's proposal would _________. 留空让你补出 Workers' supporters 的论点内容，即原文对应论点的同义转述。
【拆句】 Workers' supporters argue that Bill Haslam's proposal would _________. 是一个简单复合句：主句主语 Workers' supporters，谓语 argue；that 引导宾语从句，从句里 Bill Haslam's proposal 作主语、would 后接选项补出的动词原形；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P4 Workers' advocates have criticized Haslam's plan, saying it would mean some campus workers would lose their jobs or benefits. 工人权益倡导者批评 Haslam 的方案，称这会意味着一些校园工人失去工作或福利。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 deprive colleges of the right to manage their facilities 把后果说成 "剥夺学院自管权"，原文 Haslam has said colleges would be free to opt in or out of the outsourcing plan 反而强调学校可自由进出。 B) 偷换概念 make workers less motivated in performing duties 提到 "工作积极性下降"，原文从未谈及 motivation 维度；倡导者担心的是 "失业 / 失福利" 这种实体损失，不是士气。 C) ✓ 正确 some campus workers would lose their jobs or benefits ↔ render a number of campus workers jobless 原文给的是 "丢工作 OR 丢福利" 两个并列后果，选项 render a number of campus workers jobless 命中其中 "丢工作" 这一支；六级选 "原文也直说过" 的那一项，没毛病。 D) 答非所问 lead to the privatization of campus facilities 把 "私有化校园设施" 说成倡导者批评的后果；但 privatize 本来就是 Haslam 计划本身（Governor Bill Haslam's proposal to privatize management of state buildings），不是倡导者另外担心的后果。

evidence.text: Workers' advocates have criticized Haslam's plan, saying it would mean some campus workers would lose their jobs or benefits

distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：make workers less motivated in performing duties 提到 "工作积极性下降"，原文从未谈及 motivation 维度；倡导者担心的是 "失业 / 失福利" 这种实体损失，不是士气。

At this time there is nothing to take action on since the analysis has yet to be completed. 州里负责设施管理项目的团队仍在制定其业务可行性报告，预计 2 月底完成并对外公开。眼下没有可执行的事项，因为分析还没完成。

records.stem: Why did John Morgan decide to resign?

options.text: He had lost confidence in the Tennessee state government.

records.explanation:

【拆句】 Why did John Morgan decide to resign? 是 Why 起手的特殊疑问句，结构平铺直叙，decide to resign 是 "动词 + 不定式" 的常规搭配；无陷阱。
【定位】 P8 Morgan said last week that he would retire at the end of January because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities of the Board of Regents system and create separate governing boards for each of them. Morgan 上周说他将在 1 月底退休，原因是州长提议把董事会系统下的 6 所大学拆出来，各自成立独立的治理委员会。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 He had lost confidence in the Tennessee state government. 把原因从 "反对州长某具体方案" 扩大成 "对州政府整体失去信心"，原文从未谈及他对州政府整体的信任状态。 B) 以偏概全 He disagreed with the governor on higher education policies. 中 higher education policies 是复数泛指 "高等教育政策" 整体；原文 Morgan's comments on outsourcing mark the second time this month that he has come out against one of Haslam's plans 只表明 "第二次反对州长其中一项方案"，仍是单一政策维度。 C) 张冠李戴 He thought the state's outsourcing proposal was simply unworkable. 把辞职原因说成 "觉得外包方案不可行"，但原文 In his resignation letter, Morgan called the reorganization "unworkable". 中 unworkable 修饰的是 the reorganization（重组）而不是 outsourcing；辞职原因明确是 because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities，即重组，不是外包。 D) ✓ 正确 because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities of the Board of Regents system and create separate governing boards for each of them ↔ He opposed the governor's plan to reconstruct the college board system. 原文交代他辞职的直接原因就是州长这一拆分提案，辞职这个行为本身即 oppose 的最强表达，与选项 He opposed the governor's plan to reconstruct the college board system. 等值。
records.keyword_relation: because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities of the Board of Regents system and create separate governing boards for each of them ↔ He opposed the governor's plan to reconstruct the college board system.

evidence.text: Morgan said last week that he would retire at the end of January because of the governor's proposal to split off six universities of the Board of Regents system and create separate governing boards for each of them

distractor_explanations.B: 以偏概全：He disagreed with the governor on higher education policies. 中 higher education policies 是复数泛指 "高等教育政策" 整体；原文 Morgan's comments on outsourcing mark the second time this month that he has come out against one of Haslam's plans 只表明 "第二次反对州长其中一项方案"，仍是单一政策维度。

records.stem: What is said about the Grand Tour?

options.text: It was fashionable among young people of the time.
It was unaffordable for ordinary people.
It produced some famous European artists.
It made a compulsory part of college education.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What is said about the Grand Tour 直接问关于这件事的某个陈述，是对原文细节的事实性核对，不要求归纳整篇也不要求推断。

records.stem: How did Grand Tourists benefit from their travel?

options.text: They found inspiration in the world's greatest masterpieces.

records.stem: Why did many Grand Tourists visit the private collections?

options.text: They could buy unique souvenirs there to take back home.

Private collections were of greater variety.

records.explanation:

【判型】 Why did many Grand Tourists visit the private collections 问的是一个具体原因，原文应有 since/because 之类的因果句，是细节题而非推断题。

【定位】 P3 Since there were few museums anywhere in Europe before the close of the eighteenth century, Grand Tourists often saw paintings and sculptures by gaining admission to private collections, and many were eager to acquire examples of Greco-Roman and Italian art for their own collections. 由于 18 世纪末以前整个欧洲几乎没有什么博物馆，Grand Tourists 往往通过取得进入私人收藏的许可来看画作与雕塑，许多人还急切地希望为自己的收藏获取希腊罗马和意大利艺术的样本。

records.stem: How did the Grand Tour influence the architecture in England?

options.text: There appeared more and more Roman-style buildings.

【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 noblemen often applied what they learned from the villas of Palladio in the Veneto and the evocative ruins of Rome to their own country houses and gardens ↔ There appeared more and more Roman-style buildings the villas of Palladio in the Veneto and the evocative ruins of Rome ↔ Roman-style 原文写「贵族把学到的罗马风格用到自家房子」，A There appeared more and more Roman-style buildings 是从结果角度对这件事的客观转述，对应得严丝合缝。 B) 偷换概念 Many aristocrats began to move into Roman-style villas（许多贵族开始搬进罗马风格的别墅）原文是把「从别墅中学到的」风格应用到自家英国住宅上，不是搬进意大利的别墅；move into 这一行为原文未提。 C) 以偏概全 Aristocrats' country houses all had Roman-style gardens（贵族的乡间住宅都有罗马风格的花园）原文用 often applied（经常应用），是高频但非全部；选项 all 把高频升级成绝对全部，范围被偷偷放大。 D) 无中生有 Italian architects were hired to design houses and gardens（意大利建筑师被雇来设计房子和花园）原文说的是 noblemen 自己应用所学，未提雇佣意大利建筑师；hire 这一动作整体属于杜撰。

Robots must obey humans, except where the order would conflict with law 1; and 3. Robots must act in self-preservation, unless doing so conflicts with laws 1 or 2. 艾萨克·阿西莫夫在设计他的机器人三大法则时回避了"道德"这一整个概念。这三条法则是：1. 机器人不能伤害人类，也不能坐视人类受到伤害；2. 机器人必须服从人类，除非命令与法则1冲突；3. 机器人必须自我保全，除非这样做与法则1或法则2冲突。

【拆句】 What does the author say about Asimov's robots? 直问句，疑问代词 What 作 say 的宾语，about 引出对象；结构简单。
【定位】 P2 These laws are programmed into Asimov's robots—they don't have to think, judge, or value. They don't have to like humans or believe that hurting them is wrong or bad. They simply don't do it. 这些法则被编程进阿西莫夫笔下的机器人体内——它们不必思考、判断或评价。它们不必喜欢人类，也不必认同伤害人类是错或恶。它们只是"不做"而已。

Robots cannot harm humans or allow humans to come to harm ↔ not to hurt human beings 正解抓住"被编程进去的就是不伤人"这一最核心机制，是定位句和法则1合并后的同义改写。 C) 无中生有 They perform duties in their owners' best interest. 引入"主人最佳利益"这一文中根本没有的角色，原文谈的是 humans/humanity 而非 owners。 D) 过度推断 They stop working when a moral issue is involved. 描述了"碰到道德问题就停工"的情景，原文只说机器人不需思考道德，没有任何"停工"的描述。

records.stem: What does the author want to say by mentioning the word "harm" in Asimov's laws?

options.text: Abstract concepts are hard to program.
It is hard for robots to make decisions.
Robots may do harm in certain situations.
Asimov's laws use too many vague terms.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （例证目的题）
【判型】 What does the author want to say by mentioning the word "harm" in Asimov's laws? 明确问"提到 harm 这个词意在说明什么"，是典型例证目的题。
【拆句】 What does the author want to say by mentioning the word "harm" in Asimov's laws? 主干 the author want to say what；by mentioning… 是方式状语；in Asimov's laws 修饰 harm，定位范围更精确。
【定位】 P4 A word such as "harm" is vague (what about emotional harm? Is replacing a human employee harm?), and abstract concepts present coding problems. 像"伤害"这样的词含义模糊（情感上的伤害算不算？取代一名人类员工算不算伤害？），而抽象概念在编程上会带来问题。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 abstract concepts present coding problems ↔ Abstract concepts are hard to program. 预判方向是"抽象概念难编程"，A 几乎是 abstract concepts present coding problems 的逐词改写，是例证目的题的标准答案形态。 B) 答非所问 It is hard for robots to make decisions. 谈的是机器人决策困难，是后续 P5 实验的结论，而非 harm 这个例子的目的。 C) 偷换概念 Robots may do harm in certain situations. 谈机器人"在某些情境下会造成伤害"，混淆了 harm 例子的服务对象——这里 harm 是被讨论的词，不是机器人行为本身。 D) 以偏概全 Asimov's laws use too many vague terms. 把"举一个模糊词 harm"夸大成"使用太多模糊术语"，原文只举一例并未做"too many"的程度判定。

records.stem: What has the roboticist at the Bristol Robotics Laboratory found in his experiment?

options.text: Robots can be made as intelligent as human beings some day.

Robots can be programmed to perceive potential perils.

records.explanation:

【判型】 What has the roboticist at the Bristol Robotics Laboratory found in his experiment? 问的是实验具体发现，答案可直接在原文找到事实陈述。
【拆句】 What has the roboticist at the Bristol Robotics Laboratory found in his experiment? 现在完成时 has…found，强调发现这一动作的结果；at the Bristol Robotics Laboratory 作 the roboticist 的后置定语，缩小指代范围。
【定位】 P5 But when two H-bots became imperiled, the robot choked 42 percent of the time, unable to decide which to save and letting them both "die." 但当两个 H-bot 同时陷入险境时，该机器人有 42% 的概率"卡壳"——它无法决定先救哪一个，结果让两个都"死"了。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 Robots can be made as intelligent as human beings some day. 提到"将来"和"和人类一样聪明"，原文实验只给当下结果，未做任何未来预测。 B) 与原文相反 Robots can have moral issues encoded into their programs. 说"可以把道德议题编码进程序"，与原文 The experiment highlights the importance of morality——之所以强调道德重要性恰是因为现在没编码进去——的逻辑相反。 C) ✓ 正确 when two H-bots became imperiled, the robot choked 42 percent of the time, unable to decide which to save ↔ Robots can have trouble making decisions in complex scenarios. 选项把"两个 H-bot 同时遇险卡壳"的具体结果，抽象为"复杂场景下做决策困难"，是细节题最规范的同义改写。 D) 偷换概念 Robots can be programmed to perceive potential perils. 把"被编程救人于险"偷换为"被编程感知风险"，但实验真正的发现是"在两难情境会卡壳"，而非"能否感知风险"。

records.stem: What does the example of iPhone 6s serve to show?

options.text: The huge capacity of the smartphones people now use.
The widespread use of smartphones all over the world.
The huge impact of new technology on people's everyday life.
The rapid technological progress in a very short period of time.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （例证目的题）
【判型】 What does the example of iPhone 6s serve to show? 明确问"这个例子用来说明什么"，是典型的例证目的题。
【拆句】 题干主干是 What does the example serve to show，of iPhone 6s 是 example 的后置定语，serve to do 意为"用来做某事"。句子平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Our world now moves so fast that we seldom stop to see just how far we have come in just a few years. The latest iPhone 6s, for example, has a dual-core processor and fits nicely into your pocket. By comparison, you would expect to find a technological specification like this on your standard laptop in an office anywhere in the world. 我们的世界如今变化太快，我们几乎不停下来看一看：仅仅几年间我们已经走出了多远。比如最新的 iPhone 6s 配有双核处理器，又能轻松装进口袋；相比之下，你本以为这种技术规格要在世界各地办公室里的标准笔记本电脑上才能见到。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 The huge capacity of the smartphones people now use. 只复述了例子里 dual-core processor 这种"容量大"的细节，没有上升到作者真正要论证的"技术进步快"。 B) 无中生有 The widespread use of smartphones all over the world. 谈的是"普及程度"，可原文 iPhone 6s 例子只谈"技术规格"，全段也没提"在全世界被广泛使用"。 C) 偷换概念 The huge impact of new technology on people's everyday life. 把话题偷换成"新技术对日常生活的巨大影响"，可原文 iPhone 6s 例子只谈"几年前到现在的技术规格变化"，没有展开"对日常生活造成何种影响"。 D) ✓ 正确 Our world now moves so fast that we seldom stop to see just how far we have come in just a few years. ↔ The rapid technological progress in a very short period of time. 预判"短时间内技术进步惊人"与 The rapid technological progress in a very short period of time. 完全对位，rapid = so fast、in a very short period of time = in just a few years。

records.stem: What will business owners do when they become aware of the benefits of the Internet of Things?

options.text: Employ fewer workers in their operations.
Gain automatic control of their businesses.
Invest in more smart buildings and cities.
Embrace whatever new technology there is.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What will business owners do when they become aware of the benefits of the Internet of Things? 问的是企业主一旦意识到好处会采取什么行动，答案是原文里的客观陈述。

records.stem: What is the most exciting challenge when we possess more and more data?

options.text: How to turn it to profitable use.

records.explanation:

【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 how to creatively leverage this ever-growing amount of data to deliver cost savings, improvements and tangible benefits ↔ How to turn it to profitable use. 预判"把海量数据创造性地变成实际效益"与 How to turn it to profitable use. 完全对位，turn it to profitable use = leverage data to deliver benefits。 B) 张冠李戴 How to do real time data analysis. 来自 run real time data analytics to extract actionable and ongoing knowledge，是上一段铺垫的能力，而第 7 段明确把"最大挑战"定义为 how to creatively leverage ... data，不是"如何做实时分析"。 C) 偷换概念 How to link the actionable systems. 用 link the actionable systems"连接可行动的系统"，原文 actionable and ongoing knowledge 里 actionable 修饰 knowledge（可付诸行动的知识），并非什么 actionable systems；同时"如何连接系统"也不是原文设定的挑战。 D) 答非所问 How to devise new ways to store it. 中的 store data"存储数据"来自 the housing of this enormous and rapidly growing amount of data，但原文紧接着用 not only ... but also ... 把重点放在"运行实时数据分析"上，第 7 段更把"最大挑战"定义为"创造性利用数据"，存储显然不是答案。
