records.stem: What does the author think about working from anywhere and at anytime?

options.text: It is feasible with a connection to the internet.
It will thrive in smart buildings, cities and homes.
It is still a distant Utopian dream for ordinary workers.
It will deliver tangible benefits to both boss and worker.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干虽含 think，但锁死了具体话题 working from anywhere and at anytime，作者的看法就在那一两句话里，仍走定位路径而非全文串线。
【拆句】 主干 What does the author think about X，about 后跟动名词短语 working from anywhere and at anytime；anywhere 和 anytime 由 and 并列。
【定位】 P8 Let's face it, it wasn't too long ago that the idea of working from anywhere and at anytime was some form of a distant Utopian(乌托邦式的) dream, and yet now we can perform almost any office-based task from any location in the world as long as we have access to the internet. 我们得承认，不久以前"任何时间任何地点办公"还像是遥远的乌托邦梦；可如今只要我们能上网，就几乎能在世界上任何地方完成几乎任何办公任务。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 and yet now we can perform almost any office-based task from any location in the world as long as we have access to the internet ↔ It is feasible with a connection to the internet. 预判"只要上网就能实现"与 It is feasible with a connection to the internet. 完全对位：feasible 概括"can perform""已经能做到"，with a connection to the internet 等值于 as long as we have access to the internet。 B) 张冠李戴 It will thrive in smart buildings, cities and homes. 把 smart buildings, cities and homes 这一全文话题硬粘到"任意时间地点办公"上。原文 P8 明确给出的条件是 access to the internet，并没有说"在智能楼宇/城市/家里才会兴盛"。 C) 与原文相反 It is still a distant Utopian dream for ordinary workers. 把作者明确否定的旧状态当成现状。原文以 and yet now 转折，已说明 distant Utopian dream 是 "过去的看法"，作者现在的态度恰恰相反；这是典型"正话反说"。 D) 张冠李戴 It will deliver tangible benefits to both boss and worker. 中的 tangible benefits 来自第 7 段 cost savings, improvements and tangible benefits to both businesses and citizens，谈的是"用数据带来收益"的对象，被搬到"任意时间地点办公"上做承诺；同时 boss/worker 这种二分对象也是原文没有的。

options.text: It falls short of researchers' expectations.

It varies greatly with different algorithms.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）

【定位】 P5 As the databases grew, machine accuracy dipped across the board. Algorithms that were right 95% of the time when they were dealing with a 13,000-image database, for example, were accurate about 70% of the time when confronted with 1 million images. 随着数据库不断扩大,机器准确率全面下降。例如,当处理 13000 张图的数据库时准确率为 95% 的算法,在面对 100 万张图时只有约 70% 的准确率。

records.stem: What is the difficulty confronting researchers of facial-recognition machines?

They have trouble converting face datasets into the right format.

records.explanation:

【拆句】 What is the difficulty confronting researchers of facial-recognition machines? 主干 What is the difficulty,confronting researchers... 是现在分词短语作 difficulty 的后置定语,逻辑上 difficulty 是 confront 的主语——"使研究者面临困境的那个困难是什么"。
【定位】 P8 The trouble is, for many of the researchers who'd like to design systems to address these challenges, massive datasets for experimentation just don't exist—at least, not in formats that are accessible to academic researchers. 麻烦在于,对许多想设计系统来应对这些挑战的研究者来说,用于实验的大规模数据集根本就不存在——至少不存在学术研究者能够获取的格式。

There are no public databases that contain millions of faces. ↔ public databases with sufficient face samples 预判的"学术研究者拿不到大规模公开人脸数据集"与 There do not exist public databases with sufficient face samples. 在"不存在 + 公开 + 足量 + 数据集"四点全部对应,锁定 B。 C) 无中生有 There are no appropriate algorithms to process the face samples."没有合适的算法"无原文支撑;原文 tested a variety of facial-recognition algorithms 说算法"很多种",且文中所有困难都指向"数据缺失"而非"算法缺失"。 D) 偷换概念 They have trouble converting face datasets into the right format."难以把数据集转换成正确格式"偷换概念;原文 not in formats that are accessible to academic researchers 只是描述"现有数据集不是研究者能拿到的格式",并未说研究者要去"转换格式"(convert),且"转换"动作的主语应是数据所有者而非研究者。

records.stem: What should students do if taxpayers are to bear their college costs?

options.text: Work even harder to repay society.
Choose majors that will serve society's practical needs.
Allow taxpayers to participate in college administration.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What should students do if taxpayers are to bear their college costs? 问的是一个条件下的具体行为建议，作者已在文中给出明确答复，属细节题。
【拆句】 主干 What should students do；if taxpayers are to bear their college costs 是 if 引导的条件状语从句，be to do 表 "被安排 / 注定要"，意为 "假如让纳税人来承担学费"。
【定位】 P4 If we're going to force taxpayers to foot the bill for college degrees, students should only study those subjects that're of greatest benefit to taxpayers. 假如我们要让纳税人为大学学位买单，学生就只应学那些对纳税人最有利的科目。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 Work even harder to repay society. 把 "选什么专业" 偷换为 "更努力工作"；P4 谈的是 "study what"，根本不是 "how hard to work"。 B) 以偏概全 Choose their subjects more carefully. 只说 "更谨慎选择"，没说选择标准是 "对社会有用"；和 only study those subjects that're of greatest benefit to taxpayers 的硬约束比，缺少 "为纳税人 / 为社会" 这一关键限定。 C) ✓ 正确 students should only study those subjects that're of greatest benefit to taxpayers ↔ Choose majors that will serve society's practical needs 预判核心是 "挑对社会有用的专业"。Choose majors 对应 study those subjects，serve society's practical needs 对应 of greatest benefit to taxpayers，无遗漏。 D) 偷换概念 Allow taxpayers to participate in college administration. 把纳税人的发言权由 taxpayers should be able to decide what students will study 偷换为 college administration，越过了原文限定的范围。

【定位】 P5 And the value of what the student can produce is reflected in the wage employers are willing to pay the student to produce it. 而学生能产出之物的价值，正反映在雇主愿意支付给学生让其去产出的那份工资里。

Or we can allow students both to choose their majors and pay for their education themselves ↔ College students should fund their own education P8 的 Or 分支正面说 "学生自选自付"，P9 用 Either way 反向说 "纳税人不该付"，两句一正一反共同指向 College students should fund their own education，是唯一覆盖全篇主线的选项。

【判型】 题干 What does the author say about the Jones-Klenow method? 问的是「关于这个方法作者说了什么」，对象单一、答案在介绍该方法的段落中，属细节题。

【选项】 A) 过度推断 原文仅说该方法 can be used to assess economic performance both across countries and over time（可被用来评估），并未说它 is widely used to compare the economic growth across countries（已被广泛使用）。从「可被使用」推到「已被广泛使用」是六级阅读典型的过度推断。 B) 无中生有 原文只说它比平均收入更全面，没有任何句子表明它 revolutionizes the way of measuring ordinary people's livelihood（彻底变革了衡量方式）。revolutionizes 是极强的褒义动词，原文不存在如此强度的评价。 C) 以偏概全 原文确实提到该方法考虑 growth in consumption per person，但只是若干维度之一，并未称该方法 focuses on people's consumption rather than their average income——把多维方法窄化为「只看消费、不看收入」，是典型以偏概全。 D) ✓ 正确 considerably more comprehensive than average income ↔ a more comprehensive measure of people's economic well-being 预判结果 = 更全面的衡量方法，选项 a more comprehensive measure of people's economic well-being 几乎逐词复现预判，D 即正确项。

Because of these differences, comparing France's consumption with the U.S.'s overstates the gap in economic welfare. 然而，那种比较忽略了其他相关因素：闲暇时间、预期寿命和经济不平等。……由于这些差异，仅拿法国和美国的消费做比较，会夸大两国在经济福祉方面的差距。

【定位】 P6 In order to achieve a successful outcome or reward, some level of risk is almost always essential. 为了取得成功的结果或回报,某种程度的冒险几乎总是必不可少的。

records.stem: What does the author say is the problem with science journalism?

options.text: It is keen on transmitting sensational information.
It tends to oversimplify people's health problems.
It may give inaccurate or distorted information to the public.
It may provide information open to different interpretations.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say is the problem 是问作者明确说过的内容，定位句即答案，归为细节题。
【拆句】 What does the author say is the problem with science journalism? 是宾语从句嵌套，主句问 the problem 是什么，with science journalism 是后置定语，问「作者认为科学新闻业的问题是什么」，结构无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 Unfortunately, pieces of science journalism can also oversimplify and generalize their subject material to the point that the basic information conveyed is obscured or at worst, obviously wrong. 遗憾的是，科学新闻报道有时也会把题材过度简化和泛化，以至于其所传递的基本信息被弄得含糊不清，最严重时甚至明显出错。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 原文说「夸大基础研究对人类健康的影响」，但用的是 can be exaggerated，是一种倾向性描述，并不等同于 keen on transmitting sensational information 这种「热衷传播耸动信息」的主动定性。 B) 偷换概念 原文 oversimplify and generalize their subject material 的宾语是「题材」，而 oversimplify people's health problems 把宾语换成「人们的健康问题」，宾语被偷换。 C) ✓ 正确 the basic information conveyed is obscured or at worst, obviously wrong ↔ inaccurate or distorted information to the public pieces of science journalism ↔ give inaccurate or distorted information to the public C 项的 inaccurate 对应 obviously wrong、distorted 对应 obscured 形成一一对应，且不超出定位句范围，是最贴预判的选项。 D) 偷换概念 原文说信息是 obscured（被弄含糊）或 obviously wrong（明显出错），都是「错」或「糊」，并非 open to different interpretations（可作多种解读）这种「歧义」维度。

records.stem: What should scientists do to impart their latest findings to the public more effectively?

options.text: Seek timely assistance from the media.

records.stem: What does Andrew Hacker's Numeracy 101 aim to do?

options.text: Allow students to learn high-level math step by step.
Enable students to make practical use of basic math.
Lay a solid foundation for advanced math studies.
Help students to develop their analytical abilities.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does Andrew Hacker's Numeracy 101 aim to do? 指向一处具体客观信息，由原文一句直接支撑。
【拆句】 Q48 主干 What does Andrew Hacker's Numeracy 101 aim to do，所有格 Andrew Hacker's 修饰 Numeracy 101，结构无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 Such courses, Hacker argues, are a remedy for the numerical illiteracy of adults who have completed high-level math like algebra but are unable to calculate the price of, say, a carpet by area. Hacker 认为，这类课程是给数字盲成年人的一剂良方——这些人学过代数等高等数学，却连按面积算地毯价格这种事都不会。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Allow students to learn high-level math step by step. 让学生循序渐进学高等数学；但 Hacker 在 advanced algebra and other higher-level math should be cut 主张删高等数学，Numeracy 101 是高等数学之外的 alternative，不可能 step by step 学高等数学。 B) ✓ 正确 are a remedy for the numerical illiteracy of adults who have completed high-level math like algebra but are unable to calculate the price of, say, a carpet by area ↔ Enable students to make practical use of basic math. 预判"让人会用基本数学做日常实事"与 Enable students to make practical use of basic math. 一致。 C) 与原文相反 Lay a solid foundation for advanced math studies. 说为"高等数学打基础"；但 Numeracy 101 教的是分析联邦预算、公司财报这类"公民统计"，目的就是替代高等数学之路，而不是为之打基础。 D) 偷换概念 Help students to develop their analytical abilities. 把 learn to analyze public information like the federal budget 里的 analyze 直接抓出做成"培养分析能力"，但课程的真正目的是 a remedy for the numerical illiteracy——治数字盲、让人会用基本数学，分析公共信息只是手段而非目的本身。

records.stem: What does Maria Droujkova suggest math teachers do in class?

options.text: Make complex concepts easy to understand.
Start teaching children math at an early age.
Help children work wonders with calculus.
Try to arouse students' curiosity in math.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does Maria Droujkova suggest math teachers do 指向具体人物的具体建议，由原文一句直接承载。
【拆句】 Q49 主干 What does Maria Droujkova suggest，宾语从句 math teachers do in class 省略了从属连词 that，math teachers 是宾从主语、do 是谓语；考生若没看出这是宾语从句，可能把 in class 错挂到 suggest 上。
【定位】 P8 Make mathematics more available. Redesign it so it's more accessible to more kinds of people: young children, adults who worry about it, adults who may have had bad experiences. "让数学更易接近，"Droujkova 说，"重新设计它，让它对更多种人都更易于亲近：小孩、对数学有畏惧的成人、有过糟糕经历的成人。"
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 Redesign it so it's more accessible to more kinds of people: young children, adults who worry about it, adults who may have had bad experiences ↔ Make complex concepts easy to understand. 预判"让数学（包括复杂概念）变得易被各类人理解"，与 Make complex concepts easy to understand. 一致；Droujkova 立场是"高等数学要保留 + 重设计得让人易亲近"，正对应"把复杂概念变易懂"。 B) 以偏概全 Start teaching children math at an early age. 只抓住 taught basic calculus concepts to 5-year-olds 这一例证细节，但那只是介绍 Droujkova 个人经历，不是她给教师的建议；她的建议是 Redesign it ... more accessible to more kinds of people，对象包括儿童和各种成人，不限于"早教孩子"。 C) 偷换概念 Help children work wonders with calculus. 中的 work wonders（创造奇迹）原文无对应；它把 P7 介绍 Droujkova 教 5 岁孩子微积分这一事实，偷换成"让孩子用微积分创造奇迹"，含义被夸张了。 D) 张冠李戴 Try to arouse students' curiosity in math. 用的是 an injection of childlike wonder 中"孩童般的好奇"这层意思——但那是 Droujkova 对"美国课堂"的总体期望（行文走向），不是她给教师的 in class 具体可执行建议；P8 才是"在课上该做什么"的祈使句段，问题里 in class 把答案锚定到 P8。

records.stem: What does Pamela Harris think should be the goal of math education?

options.text: To enable learners to understand the world better.
To help learners to tell fake math from real math.
To broaden Americans' perspectives on math.
To exert influence on world development.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does Pamela Harris think should be the goal of math education? 指向 Harris 的具体看法，由原文一句直接支撑。
【拆句】 Q50 主干 What does Pamela Harris think，think 后嵌套主语从句 should be the goal of math education，what 同时充当从句的表语；句式有点绕，但语义指向明确——找 Harris 认为数学教育的目标。
【定位】 P9 Harris says that American education is suffering from an epidemic of "fake math"—an emphasis on rote memorization(死记硬背) of formulas and steps, rather than an understanding of how math can influence the ways we see the world. Harris 说，美国教育正在遭受一种"假数学"的流行病——强调对公式和步骤的死记硬背，而不是去理解数学如何影响我们看世界的方式。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 To enable learners to understand the world better. 把宾语从 perspectives on math 偷换成 the world——Harris 强调的是数学对"看世界方式"的影响（让人对"数学如何影响视角"有理解），不是让人去"更好地理解世界"本身；目标的关注点是 math/perspectives on math，不是 the world。 B) 无中生有 To help learners to tell fake math from real math. 把 fake math 这个 Harris 用来批评现状的词，偷做成"教育目标=让人区分假数学与真数学"；但 Harris 从未把"区分真假数学"当成教育目标，fake math 只是她给现状贴的诊断标签。 C) ✓ 正确 an understanding of how math can influence the ways we see the world ↔ To broaden Americans' perspectives on math. 预判"让人懂数学如何影响我们看世界"与 To broaden Americans' perspectives on math. 在语义上一致：对数学的视角被拓宽=理解数学如何影响我们看世界。注：标准答案为 C。 D) 过度推断 To exert influence on world development. 把 influence the ways we see the world（影响"看世界的方式"）夸张成"影响世界发展"——influence 的宾语由 ways we see the world（认知层面）被偷换成 world development（现实层面），推过了头。

records.stem: What do we learn about the robot Terapio?

options.text: It has been put to use in many Japanese hospitals.
It provides specific individualized care to patients.
It does not have much direct contact with patients.
It has not revolutionized medical service in Japan.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What do we learn about the robot Terapio? 问 "我们从文中了解到 Terapio 什么"，是 What do we learn about 句型，等同于细节询问。
【拆句】 What do we learn about the robot Terapio? 主语 we，谓语 learn，about the robot Terapio 是话题状语，the robot 是 Terapio 的同位说明。无难点。
【定位】 P3 This type of robot will likely be one of the first to be implemented in hospitals because it has fairly minimal patient contact. 这类机器人很可能会成为最早被引入医院的机器人之一，因为它与病人的直接接触相当少。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 It has been put to use in many Japanese hospitals. 用现在完成时 has been put to use 表示"已被广泛使用"，原文却说 will likely be one of the first to be implemented——是将来时的"很可能将率先被引入"，并未发生。 B) 张冠李戴 It provides specific individualized care to patients. 中 individualized care to patients="为病人提供个性化照护"；原文 It follows a specific individual, such as a doctor or nurse 是"跟随某位医护人员"——主语虽是 Terapio，宾语却是医护而非病人。 C) ✓ 正确 it has fairly minimal patient contact ↔ It does not have much direct contact with patients. C 把 minimal 用 not much 这一更口语化的否定结构表达，把名词短语 patient contact 改成介词结构 contact with patients，与预判逐字对应。 D) 无中生有 It has not revolutionized medical service in Japan. 给 Terapio 下"尚未革新医疗"的判断，原文只描述其功能，未做任何"革命/未革命"的评价。

records.stem: What are telepresence robots designed to do?

options.text: Directly interact with patients to prevent them from feeling lonely.
Cater to the needs of patients for recovering their cognitive capacity.
Closely monitor the patients' movements and conditions around the clock.
Facilitate communication between patients and doctors or family members.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What are telepresence robots designed to do? 询问该机器人被设计的具体功能，是对具体功能的客观提问。
【拆句】 What are telepresence robots designed to do? 主语 telepresence robots，be designed to do 是被动+不定式，表"被设计来做……"。结构清晰。
【定位】 P4 Telepresence robots such as MantaroBot, Vgo, and Giraff can be controlled through a computer, smartphone, or tablet, allowing family members or doctors to remotely monitor patients or Skype them, often via a screen where the robot's 'face' would be. 诸如 MantaroBot、Vgo、Giraff 之类的远程呈现机器人，可以通过电脑、手机或平板控制，让家人或医生远程监护病人，或借助机器人"脸部"位置的屏幕与病人 Skype 视频。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Directly interact with patients to prevent them from feeling lonely. 中 directly interact 与原文 the robot itself doesn't have to engage directly—it can serve as an intermediary 正相反——原文强调机器人不直接参与，只做中介。 B) 过度推断 Cater to the needs of patients for recovering their cognitive capacity. 中 recovering cognitive capacity 暗示"治疗/恢复"，原文 cognitive functioning 只说"有助于认知功能"，并未承诺恢复。 C) 无中生有 Closely monitor the patients' movements and conditions around the clock. 中 around the clock（24 小时不间断）与 closely monitor movements 都未在原文出现，原文仅说"远程监护"且未规定时长。 D) ✓ 正确 allowing family members or doctors to remotely monitor patients or Skype them ↔ Facilitate communication between patients and doctors or family members. enhance communication and decrease feelings of loneliness ↔ Facilitate communication between patients and doctors or family members. D 用上位词 communication 与 facilitate 收束原文两处下位动作（remotely monitor、Skype、enhance communication），与预判完全契合。
records.keyword_relation: allowing family members or doctors to remotely monitor patients or Skype them ↔ Facilitate communication between patients and doctors or family members.；enhance communication and decrease feelings of loneliness ↔ Facilitate communication between patients and doctors or family members.

evidence.text: Telepresence robots such as MantaroBot, Vgo, and Giraff can be controlled through a computer, smartphone, or tablet, allowing family members or doctors to remotely monitor patients or Skype them, often via a screen where the robot's 'face' would be

distractor_explanations.B: 过度推断：Cater to the needs of patients for recovering their cognitive capacity. 中 recovering cognitive capacity 暗示"治疗/恢复"，原文 cognitive functioning 只说"有助于认知功能"，并未承诺恢复。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：Closely monitor the patients' movements and conditions around the clock. 中 around the clock（24 小时不间断）与 closely monitor movements 都未在原文出现，原文仅说"远程监护"且未规定时长。

records.stem: What is one special feature of the robot Actroid F?

options.text: It interacts with patients just like a human companion.
It operates quietly without patients realizing its presence.
It likes to engage in everyday conversations with patients.
It uses body language even more effectively than words.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What is one special feature of the robot Actroid F? 问"一个独有特征"，是对客观属性的询问。
【拆句】 What is one special feature of the robot Actroid F? 主系表结构，one special feature 是表语前置的疑问主语，of 短语点明所属对象。无难点。
【定位】 P6 On the less cute and more scary side there is Actroid F, which is so human-like that some patients may not know the difference. This conversational robot companion has cameras in its eyes, which allow it to track patients and use appropriate facial expressions and body language in its interactions. Actroid F 没那么可爱、反倒有点吓人，它极度拟人化，以至于一些病人都分不出真假。这位"会聊天的机器人陪伴者"眼里嵌着摄像头，可以追踪病人并在互动中使用恰当的面部表情和肢体语言。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 so human-like that some patients may not know the difference ↔ It interacts with patients just like a human companion. This conversational robot companion has cameras in its eyes, which allow it to track patients and use appropriate facial expressions and body language in its interactions. ↔ It interacts with patients just like a human companion. A 把"human-like + conversational companion + interactions"三处信息收敛为一句"like a human companion 互动"，与预判完全契合。 B) 偷换概念 It operates quietly without patients realizing its presence. 把"病人难辨真假"误读成"病人没察觉"，原文 may not know the difference 是"分不清真假"，不是"没察觉存在"。 C) 过度推断 It likes to engage in everyday conversations with patients. 把 conversational（可对话的）夸大为 likes everyday conversations（喜欢日常闲聊），原文未表达机器人"喜欢"任何事，机器人也不具人格偏好。 D) 无中生有 It uses body language even more effectively than words. 把"使用面部表情和肢体语言"夸大为"肢体语言比词语更有效"，原文未做任何"肢体语言 vs 词语"的比较。
records.keyword_relation: so human-like that some patients may not know the difference ↔ It interacts with patients just like a human companion.；This conversational robot companion has cameras in its eyes, which allow it to track patients and use appropriate facial expressions and body language in its interactions. ↔ It interacts with patients just like a human companion.

evidence.text: On the less cute and more scary side there is Actroid F, which is so human-like that some patients may not know the difference. This conversational robot companion has cameras in its eyes, which allow it to track patients and use appropriate facial expressions and body language in its interactions

distractor_explanations.C: 过度推断：It likes to engage in everyday conversations with patients. 把 conversational（可对话的）夸大为 likes everyday conversations（喜欢日常闲聊），原文未表达机器人"喜欢"任何事，机器人也不具人格偏好。
distractor_explanations.D: 无中生有：It uses body language even more effectively than words. 把"使用面部表情和肢体语言"夸大为"肢体语言比词语更有效"，原文未做任何"肢体语言 vs 词语"的比较。

records.stem: What can we infer from the last paragraph?

options.text: Doctors and surgeons will soon be laid off.
The robotics industry will soon take off.
Robots will not make nurses redundant.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （推断题）
【判型】 题干 What can we infer from the last paragraph? 含 infer，明确要求基于末段做一步推断。
【拆句】 What can we infer from the last paragraph? What 作 infer 的宾语前置，can we infer 是情态动词疑问，from the last paragraph 是来源状语。结构清楚。
【定位】 P7 Instead, they perform routine and laborious tasks, freeing nurses up to attend to patients with immediate needs. This is one industry where it seems the integration of robots will lead to collaboration, not replacement. 相反，机器人做的是常规而繁重的活儿，让护士腾出手照顾急需照护的病人。机器人融入这一行业，看来带来的将是合作而非取代。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Doctors and surgeons will soon be laid off. 与原文 robot doctors and surgeons may not be far off 正相反——原文说"机器人医生/外科医生可能不远了"，是人替换为机器人；而且整段强调合作而非替代，谁也不会被裁。 B) 以偏概全 The robotics industry will soon take off. 把原文 This is one industry（指护理这一行业）扩大为"整个机器人产业"。原文只评护理行业用机器人的前景，不评机器人产业自身。 C) ✓ 正确 This is one industry where it seems the integration of robots will lead to collaboration, not replacement. ↔ Robots will not make nurses redundant. freeing nurses up to attend to patients with immediate needs ↔ Robots will not make nurses redundant. C 把"not replacement"用 make…redundant 这一英式习语反向表达，词面与原文最远但语义最近，是推断题正确项的典型样态。 D) 偷换概念 Collaboration will not replace competition. 把原文 collaboration, not replacement 中的 replacement（取代）偷换成 competition（竞争），并把 collaboration 的对立面强行改换。
records.keyword_relation: This is one industry where it seems the integration of robots will lead to collaboration, not replacement. ↔ Robots will not make nurses redundant.；freeing nurses up to attend to patients with immediate needs ↔ Robots will not make nurses redundant.

evidence.text: Instead, they perform routine and laborious tasks, freeing nurses up to attend to patients with immediate needs. This is one industry where it seems the integration of robots will lead to collaboration, not replacement

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：Doctors and surgeons will soon be laid off. 与原文 robot doctors and surgeons may not be far off 正相反——原文说"机器人医生/外科医生可能不远了"，是人替换为机器人；而且整段强调合作而非替代，谁也不会被裁。

distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：Collaboration will not replace competition. 把原文 collaboration, not replacement 中的 replacement（取代）偷换成 competition（竞争），并把 collaboration 的对立面强行改换。

records.stem: 选择第 31 空的词汇
records.explanation:

records.stem: 选择第 32 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 K) primarily 副词
【词性槽】 be + __ + 名词短语，副词修饰
【依据】 ‘主要是埋伏型猎手’最贴 Lions are __(32)__ ambush hunters, so when they feel their prey has __(33)__ them, they usually give up on the hunt. 后半句说‘一旦猎物发现自己就放弃’，是对‘以埋伏为主要捕猎方式’的解释；primarily（主要地）与该因果链完全吻合。
【竞争词】 D) currently ‘目前是埋伏猎手’不合常识 currently 强调时间‘当下’，会暗示狮子以前不是埋伏猎手，这与生物学常识及上下文都不符。 G) elsewhere ‘在别处是埋伏猎手’语义违和 elsewhere 表地点对比，文中并未在比较两个地点，代入读起来奇怪。 H) nevertheless ‘然而是埋伏猎手’缺转折对象 nevertheless 是转折副词，本句前没有可让它转折的对立语义，硬塞进来逻辑断裂。
records.keyword_relation: ‘主要是埋伏型猎手’最贴

Through satellite tracking of both the herd and the lions in the area, they will be able to  {{35}}  if their psychological trickery will work to help keep farmers from shooting lions.

records.stem: What is the focus of the new study from Duke University?

options.text: The contributors to children's early attention.
The predictors of children's academic success.
The factors that affect children's emotional well-being.
The determinants of children's development of social skills.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （主旨题）
【判型】 题干 What is the focus of the new study 把问题指向「研究关注的是什么」，是典型的主旨提问。
【拆句】 What is the focus of the new study from Duke University? 是一个 wh- 疑问句，主语 the focus，介词短语 of the new study from Duke University 作后置定语；句子平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 The contributors to children's early attention 把「早期注意力」当作被解释的对象, 而原文是把它当作解释学业成功的「自变量」, 完全颠倒了因果关系。 B) ✓ 正确 early attention skills were the most consistent predictor of academic success ↔ The predictors of children's academic success examined early academic attention and socio\-emotional skills and how each contributed to academic success ↔ The predictors of children's academic success B 项「儿童学业成功的预测因子」恰好对应预判的主线: 找出哪些早期因素能预测学业成功, 且能覆盖 P4 P8 等多段, 是全文焦点。 C) 偷换概念 The factors that affect children's emotional well\-being 把研究对象偷换成 emotional well-being (情绪健康), 而原文研究的是 academic success, socio-emotional skills 只是其中一个因素, 不是被研究的对象。 D) 偷换概念 The determinants of children's development of social skills 把研究对象说成「社交技能的发展」, 而原文研究的是 academic success; social acceptance 在原文只是预测因子, 不是被解释的目标。
records.keyword_relation: early attention skills were the most consistent predictor of academic success ↔ The predictors of children's academic success；examined early academic attention and socio\-emotional skills and how each contributed to academic success ↔ The predictors of children's academic success

evidence.text: early attention skills were the most consistent predictor of academic success
examined early academic attention and socio-emotional skills and how each contributed to academic success

records.stem: How did the researchers ensure that their findings are valid?

records.stem: What do we learn from the findings of the Duke study?

options.text: Modest students are generally more attentive than their contemporaries.

【定位】 P7 Our findings suggest that even more modest attention difficulties can increase the risk of negative academic outcomes. 我们的研究发现表明, 即使是更轻微的注意力问题, 也会增加学业上出现负面结果的风险。

records.stem: What does the author say about the negative impact of smartphones?

options.text: It has been overshadowed by the positive impact.
It has more often than not been taken for granted.
It is not so obvious but has caused some concern.
It is subtle but should by no means be overstated.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say about the negative impact of smartphones? 直接问作者就某一具体话题的说法，无 infer/imply/mainly about 等信号词。
【拆句】 题干主干 What does the author say about the negative impact of smartphones? 是 say about 的宾语提问，无从句无否定，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 Often the advantages of convenient, mobile technology are both obvious and taken for granted, leaving more subtle topics for concerned discussion: Are smartphones disturbing children's sleep? Is an inability to get away from work having a negative impact on health? And what are the implications for privacy? 便利的移动技术所带来的好处常常既显而易见、又被视为理所当然，这就把一些更微妙的话题留给人们去担忧地讨论：智能手机是否干扰了孩子的睡眠？无法从工作中抽身是否对健康造成了负面影响？以及对隐私意味着什么？
【选项】 A) 过度推断 It has been overshadowed by the positive impact. 中 overshadowed by 是"被掩盖、盖过"的强烈对比关系，但原文只说正面优势被视为 taken for granted（理所当然），并未说它在分量上压过负面，是凭空升级的语义。 B) 张冠李戴 It has more often than not been taken for granted. 把 taken for granted 这一描述套在 negative impact 上，但原文里 taken for granted 修饰的明明是 the advantages（正面影响）；属典型的对象错配。 C) ✓ 正确 more subtle topics ↔ not so obvious concerned discussion ↔ caused some concern 预判要求"不那么明显 + 已引发担忧"两个语义块都到位，只有 It is not so obvious but has caused some concern. 同时覆盖；but 这一转折也精准对应原文的隐含让步语气。 D) 无中生有 It is subtle but should by no means be overstated. 前半 subtle 对得上原文，但后半 should by no means be overstated（"决不应被夸大"）是作者本人没有表达的立场——原文只是把负面影响列入讨论范围，并未给出"别夸大"的建议。

records.stem: What characterizes traditional psychological research?

options.text: It is based on huge amounts of carefully collected data.

【定位】 P5 These studies are confirming, challenging and extending what's been found using more traditional approaches, in which people report how they behaved in real life or participate in relatively short and artificial laboratory-based tasks. 这些研究正在确认、挑战并拓展那些用更传统方法所得出的结论——所谓传统方法，是指让人们自我报告他们在现实生活中如何行事，或参加相对简短且人为设计的实验室任务。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 It is based on huge amounts of carefully collected data. 把传统研究刻画为"基于大量精心采集数据"，但原文恰恰强调传统方法是 short and artificial（短且人为）的实验室任务，与"大量数据"形成相反描述。 B) ✓ 正确 laboratory-based tasks ↔ lab observations people report how they behaved in real life ↔ participants' reports 预判要求"实验室任务 + 自我报告"两块都到位，只有 It relies on lab observations and participants' reports. 把两块用 and 并列同时收齐，完全契合 in which 从句的双特征结构。 C) 无中生有 It makes use of the questionnaire method. 把传统研究锁定为"使用问卷法"，但原文只说 report（口头/书面报告）与 laboratory-based tasks（实验室任务），从未提 questionnaire——这是凭空指定了一种原文没有的方法。 D) 无中生有 It is often expensive and time-consuming. 给传统研究贴上"贵且费时"的标签，但原文只字未提研究的成本或时长——文中 short 修饰的是"任务的时长"而非"研究的耗时"，方向也不一致。

records.stem: What did Stephen Hawking think of artificial intelligence?

options.text: It would be vital to the progress of human civilisation.
It might be a blessing or a disaster in the making.
It might present challenges as well as opportunities.
It would be a significant expansion of human intelligence.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What did Stephen Hawking think of artificial intelligence? 问的是某人对某事物的具体看法，要求回原文找观点句。
【拆句】 题干 What did Stephen Hawking think of artificial intelligence? 是 wh-疑问句，主干 「X think of Y」，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Professor Stephen Hawking has warned that the creation of powerful artificial intelligence (AI) will be "either the best, or the worst thing, ever to happen to humanity". 霍金教授警告说，创造强大的人工智能将会是「发生在人类身上最好或最坏的事」。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 vital to the progress of human civilisation 只取了「好」的一面，丢掉了 worst thing 的另一面。 B) ✓ 正确 the best, or the worst thing ↔ a blessing or a disaster ever to happen to humanity ↔ in the making 预判「可能最好可能最坏」，与 a blessing or a disaster in the making 在结构和语义上都完全对应，锁定 B。 C) 范围程度偷改 challenges as well as opportunities 听起来很对，但 challenges 远弱于 worst thing，opportunities 远弱于 best thing，程度被显著削弱。 D) 答非所问 a significant expansion of human intelligence 与 our own minds are amplified by AI 近似，但那是 Q46 之外的内容，且 Q46 问的是首段的总体评价，不是 P3 的局部细节。

records.stem: What did Hawking say about the creation of the LCFI?

It would mark a step forward in the AI industry.

records.stem: What did Hawking say was a welcome change in AI research?

options.text: The shift of research focus from the past to the future.
The shift of research from theory to implementation.
The greater emphasis on the negative impact of AI.
The increasing awareness of mankind's past stupidity.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What did Hawking say was a welcome change in AI research? 是问 Hawking 所说的具体内容，定位句一句话即可作答。
【拆句】 What did Hawking say was a welcome change in AI research? 含套层从句：主句 What did Hawking say，宾语从句省略主语 「(what) was a welcome change」。即问 Hawking 所说的「那个 welcome change」是什么。
【定位】 P2 "We spend a great deal of time studying in history," Hawking said, "which, let's face it, is mostly the history of stupidity. So it's a welcome change that people are studying instead the future of intelligence." 「我们花大量时间研究历史，」霍金说，「而历史多半是一部愚蠢史。所以人们改去研究未来智能，是一个可喜的变化。」
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 studying in history ↔ from the past studying instead the future of intelligence ↔ to the future welcome change ↔ shift of research focus 预判「研究对象由历史转向未来」，与 The shift of research focus from the past to the future. 完全对位，锁定 A。 B) 无中生有 原文谈的是「历史 vs 未来」，与「理论 vs 实施」完全不在一个维度。 C) 偷换概念 Hawking 称可喜变化是研究 future of intelligence，而不是着重 AI 的负面影响。 D) 答非所问 原文 mostly the history of stupidity 只是 Hawking 的一句吐槽，用来对比为何研究未来反而是 welcome change，并不是 welcome change 本身。
records.keyword_relation: studying in history ↔ from the past；studying instead the future of intelligence ↔ to the future；welcome change ↔ shift of research focus

records.stem: What concerns did Hawking raise about AI?

options.text: It may exceed human intelligence sooner or later.
It may ultimately over-amplify the human mind.
Super-intelligence may cause its own destruction.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What concerns did Hawking raise about AI? 是细节，答 Hawking 担忧的具体内容。
【拆句】 What concerns did Hawking raise about AI? 主干 「X raise concerns about Y」，raise 是搭配动词，about AI 指明话题范围。结构清晰。
【定位】 P3 the world-renowned physicist has often been cautious about AI, raising concerns that humanity could be the architect of its own destruction if it creates a super-intelligence with a will of its own. 这位享誉世界的物理学家在 AI 问题上常常小心翼翼，他担忧：如果人类造出有自己意志的超级智能，人类可能会成为自我毁灭的设计师。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Hawking 谈的是自我意志的超级智能毁灭人类，不是 AI 何时迟早超过人类智能的时间预测。 B) 与原文相反 原文 our own minds are amplified by AI 是正面预期，B 选项加了 over- 变成负面 over-amplify，与原文相反。 C) 偷换概念 原文是 super-intelligence 毁灭人类（destruction of humanity），C 改成 super-intelligence 毁灭 its own——主体宾语反了。 D) ✓ 正确 humanity could be the architect of its own destruction ↔ ruin mankind super-intelligence with a will of its own ↔ Super-intelligence if it creates ↔ eventually 预判「超级智能或将毁灭人类」，与 Super-intelligence may eventually ruin mankind. 完全对位，锁定 D。
records.keyword_relation: humanity could be the architect of its own destruction ↔ ruin mankind；super-intelligence with a will of its own ↔ Super-intelligence；if it creates ↔ eventually

evidence.text: the world-renowned physicist has often been cautious about AI, raising concerns that humanity could be the architect of its own destruction if it creates a super-intelligence with a will of its own

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：Hawking 谈的是自我意志的超级智能毁灭人类，不是 AI 何时迟早超过人类智能的时间预测。
distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：原文 our own minds are amplified by AI 是正面预期，B 选项加了 over- 变成负面 over-amplify，与原文相反。

records.stem: What do we learn about some entrepreneurs from the technology industry?

options.text: They are much influenced by the academic community.
They are most likely to benefit from AI development.
They share the same concerns about AI as academics.
They believe they can keep AI under human control.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about some entrepreneurs from the technology industry? 问的是关于该群体的具体陈述，走细节路径。
【拆句】 What do we learn about some entrepreneurs from the technology industry? 主干 「learn about X」；from the technology industry 是后置定语修饰 entrepreneurs。无陷阱。
【定位】 P6 The academic community is not alone in warning about the potential dangers of AI as well as the potential benefits. A number of pioneers from the technology industry, most famously the entrepreneur Elon Musk, have also expressed their concerns about the damage that a super-intelligent AI could do to humanity. 学术界并非唯一发出 AI 警示的群体。来自科技业的一批先驱（其中最著名的是企业家埃隆·马斯克）也表达了对超级智能 AI 可能给人类带来损害的担忧。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 原文只说两群体不约而同地担忧，并未说企业家是受学术界影响才担忧的——立场一致 ≠ 受影响。 B) 无中生有 原文未提及科技业企业家「最可能受益于 AI 发展」，纯属臆造。 C) ✓ 正确 The academic community is not alone in warning ↔ share the same concerns about AI as academics have also expressed their concerns ↔ share the same concerns academic community ↔ academics 预判「与学术界同样担忧」，与 They share the same concerns about AI as academics. 在立场、对象、群体三方面都对位，锁定 C。 D) 与原文相反 原文表达的是科技业企业家担忧 AI 危害，D 却说他们相信能控制 AI——方向反转。
records.keyword_relation: The academic community is not alone in warning ↔ share the same concerns about AI as academics；have also expressed their concerns ↔ share the same concerns；academic community ↔ academics

evidence.text: The academic community is not alone in warning about the potential dangers of AI as well as the potential benefits. A number of pioneers from the technology industry, most famously the entrepreneur Elon Musk, have also expressed their concerns about the damage that a super-intelligent AI could do to humanity

distractor_explanations.A: 过度推断：原文只说两群体不约而同地担忧，并未说企业家是受学术界影响才担忧的——立场一致 ≠ 受影响。

records.explanation:

【拆句】 题干 What does the passage say about the startups 是简单特殊疑问句，主干 the passage say what about the startups，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 The market for products designed specifically for older adults could reach $30 billion by next year, and startups want in on the action. 专门为老年人设计的产品市场明年可能达到 300 亿美元，初创公司想要在这块蛋糕里分一杯羹。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 选项 They never lose time in upgrading products for seniors 说「绝不浪费时间升级产品」，原文从未提及「升级速度」或 never lose time 这一信息。 B) ✓ 正确 The market for products designed specifically for older adults could reach \$30 billion by next year ↔ the seniors' goods market startups want in on the action ↔ want to have a share of 预判「初创公司想进入老年市场分蛋糕」，与 They want to have a share of the seniors' goods market 在话题（老年市场）和动作（分一份）两个维度上完全等值，无其他选项能同时满足。 C) 与原文相反 选项 They invite seniors to their companies to try their products 说创业公司请老人去公司，但原文 Brookdale, the country's largest owner of retirement communities, has been inviting a few select entrepreneurs just to move in for a few days 是养老社区 Brookdale 邀请创业者入住社区，方向完全相反。 D) 以偏概全 选项 They try to profit from promoting digital products to seniors 把范围缩成「数字产品」，但原文 products designed specifically for older adults 并未限定为数字产品；后文也提到全身吹风机、自助穿衣这类非数字产品。

records.stem: Some entrepreneurs have been invited to Brookdale to______.

options.text: have an interview with potential customers
conduct a survey of retirement communities
collect residents' feedback on their products
show senior residents how to use IT products

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 Some entrepreneurs have been invited to Brookdale to 是不完整陈述句，问目的，需要从原文找邀请的目的状语。
【拆句】 题干 Some entrepreneurs have been invited to Brookdale to 是被动语态待补全句，have been invited to do 中 to 后面接选项补完，考生须把选项当作目的状语来读。
【定位】 P1 So Brookdale, the country's largest owner of retirement communities, has been inviting a few select entrepreneurs just to move in for a few days, show off their products and hear what the residents have to say. 因此，全美最大的养老社区运营商 Brookdale 一直邀请少数精选的创业者入住几天，展示产品，听取居民的意见。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 选项 have an interview with potential customers 把「听取反馈」偷换成「采访潜在客户」；原文 Brookdale 居民是「试用者」，且交流方式是聊天、玩牌等非正式途径（Playing pool, playing cards, having dinner），不是正式采访。 B) 张冠李戴 选项 conduct a survey of retirement communities 把调查对象错挂到「养老社区」上；原文要求创业者听取的是居民对产品的反馈，调查对象是产品，不是社区。 C) ✓ 正确 hear what the residents have to say ↔ collect residents' feedback show off their products ↔ on their products 预判中「听取居民意见」是邀请的根本目的，collect residents' feedback on their products 正是这个目的的标准书面表达，其他选项要么动作错（A、B、D），要么对象错。 D) 与原文相反 选项 show senior residents how to use IT products 说创业者来「教老人用 IT 产品」；原文方向相反，是创业者来「听老人怎么说自己的产品」，且产品类型不限于 IT。

records.stem: What does Rodriguez say is important in promoting products?

options.text: Knowing the likes and dislikes of customers.
Demonstrating their superiority on the spot.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does Rodriguez say is important in promoting products 问 Rodriguez 的原话，是原文直接引语的转述。
【拆句】 题干 What does Rodriguez say is important in promoting products 中 What 既是 say 的宾语从句主语，又是 is important 的主语，结构是 What [is important in promoting products] does Rodriguez say？考生易把它读成两个分立的疑问，实际只问一件事：什么东西在推销中重要。
【定位】 P5 When they get to know me and to trust me, knowing for sure I'm not selling them something—there'll be more honest feedback from them. 当他们开始了解我、信任我，确信我不是来卖东西的——就会有更诚实的反馈。

records.stem: What is the purpose of the new U.S. space policy?

options.text: To lay out general guidelines for space exploration.
To encourage companies to join in space programs.
To make the best use of satellites in space.
To improve traffic conditions in space.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）

【拆句】 标准 What is the purpose of X？ 句式，主语 the new U.S. space policy，无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Space Policy Directive-3 lays out general guidelines for the United States to mitigate(缓解) the effects of space debris and track and manage traffic in space. 《第三号空间政策指令》为美国列出大致指南，以缓解太空碎片的影响并追踪、管理太空中的交通。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 To lay out general guidelines for space exploration. 把原文的 traffic in space 偷换成 space exploration，「探索」是与「交通管理」截然不同的活动。 B) 无中生有 To encourage companies to join in space programs. 在原文找不到任何「鼓励公司加入」的表述，最接近的 companies are already starting to build massive constellations 只说明现状，不是政策目的。 C) 过度推断 To make the best use of satellites in space. 中 make the best use of 远超出原文 track and manage traffic in space 的「追踪＋管理」语义，且话题对象从「交通」被换成「卫星」。 D) ✓ 正确 track and manage traffic in space ↔ improve traffic conditions in space 预判要求落在「碎片」或「交通」两个语义里，四个选项中只有 To improve traffic conditions in space. 命中「交通」且与 track and manage traffic in space 等值，锁定 D。

records.stem: What is a space vehicle launching entity required to do according to the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices?

options.text: Give an estimate of how long its debris will stay in space.
Account for the debris it has released into space at any time.
Provide a detailed plan for managing the space debris it creates.
Make a thorough analysis of any possible addition to space debris.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What is a space vehicle launching entity required to do …? 问的是法规明文规定，原文有逐字依据。
【拆句】 主干 What is a space vehicle launching entity required to do？ 后接 according to … 状语限定来源；动词 required 被动语态隐藏施事者，但不影响理解，无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 That's why this new policy also includes directions to update the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices, which already require any entity that launches a satellite or spacecraft to vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris. 这就是为何这项新政策还包含更新现行《美国政府轨道碎片缓解标准做法》的指示。该做法已经要求任何发射卫星或航天器的实体严格分析其各种行为——无论是意外故障还是正常操作——产生更多太空碎片的可能性。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 Give an estimate of how long its debris will stay in space. 把原文 any piece of debris they plan to release over 5mm that might stay in orbit for 25 years or more 这一附加规定截取出来当主要义务；原文里停留时间只是判断要不要核算的门槛，发射方被要求的是分析创造碎片的可能性。 B) 偷换概念 Account for the debris it has released into space at any time. 中现在完成时 has released 指向已发生的事实，而原文 vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris 是面向未来的可能性分析。 C) 偷换概念 Provide a detailed plan for managing the space debris it creates. 把「分析产生新碎片的可能性」扭曲为「为已产生的碎片做管理方案」，是 dispose of or capture space debris 那种事后处置的语义，而非 vigorously analyze the likelihood。 D) ✓ 正确 vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris ↔ Make a thorough analysis of any possible addition to space debris. the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris ↔ any possible addition to space debris 预判要求三要素同时命中，Make a thorough analysis of any possible addition to space debris. 一一对应——thorough ↔ vigorously，analysis ↔ analyze，possible addition ↔ the likelihood that any of their actions。

evidence.text: That's why this new policy also includes directions to update the current U.S. Government Orbital Debris Mitigation Standard Practices, which already require any entity that launches a satellite or spacecraft to vigorously analyze the likelihood that any of their actions, from an unexpected failure or normal operations, will create more space debris

records.stem: What did the author realize when he re-entered the corporate world?

records.explanation:

distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：Cultivating positive interpersonal relationships helped him expel solitary feelings 表态是”积极关系帮他赶走了孤独”，与原文”作者发现其实没那么重要、连期待都落空了”的语义方向相反；且原文从未说同事关系帮他驱散孤独。

records.stem: What do we learn from many studies about collegial relationships?

options.text: Inharmonious relationships have an adverse effect on productivity.

Conflicting relationships in the workplace exist almost everywhere.

records.explanation:

【判型】 What do we learn from many studies 询问已有研究的具体发现，是对客观信息的复述，归入细节题。

【定位】 P1 So much research has explored the way in which collegial(同事的) ties can help overcome a range of workplace issues affecting productivity and the quality of work output such as team-based conflict, jealousy, undermining, anger, and more. 大量研究已经探究了同事间的关系如何帮助化解一系列影响生产率与工作产出质量的职场问题，比如团队冲突、嫉妒、暗中拆台、愤怒等等。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 collegial(同事的) ties can help overcome a range of workplace issues affecting productivity and the quality of work output such as team-based conflict, jealousy, undermining, anger, and more ↔ Inharmonious relationships have an adverse effect on productivity. team-based conflict, jealousy, undermining, anger ↔ Inharmonious relationships 预判说”和谐关系能化解影响生产率的问题”，等价于”关系不和谐就会损害生产率”，正与 Inharmonious relationships have an adverse effect on productivity 在逻辑上对应。 B) 偷换概念 Harmonious relationships are what many companies aim to cultivate 谈的是”公司想培育”，原文谈的是”研究探究关系如何化解职场问题”；研究发现 ≠ 公司目标，属于偷换概念。 C) 与原文相反 Close collegial relationships contribute very little to product quality 说”对产品质量贡献很小”，原文 can help overcome a range of workplace issues affecting productivity and the quality of work output 说的是”能帮助克服影响产出质量的问题”，恰好相反。 D) 过度推断 Conflicting relationships in the workplace exist almost everywhere 把原文里仅作为”被研究的负面问题之一”提到的 conflict 放大成”在职场几乎到处存在”的全称断言，超出原文范围。

records.stem: What can be inferred about relationships at work from an academic analysis?

options.text: They are vital to corporate culture.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （推断题）
【判型】 What can be inferred 直接给出 infer 字样，按规则归为推断题，需要从定位句做一步合理延伸。
【拆句】 Q48 主干 What can be inferred about relationships at work，from 引出依据 from an academic analysis。被动 can be inferred 等于 we can infer，理解上无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 It's a simple term that encapsulates(概括) the fact that relationships at work can reasonably be non-intimate, inconsequential, unimportant and even, dare I say it, disposable or substitutable. 这是个简单的术语，它概括了一个事实：职场关系完全可以是非亲密的、无足轻重的、不重要的，甚至——我冒昧地说——可有可无、可被替代。

records.stem: Why do some experts consider lying a milestone in a child's development?

records.stem: Why does the Harvard neuroscientist say that lying takes work?

options.text: It is hard to choose from several options.
It is difficult to sound natural or plausible.
It requires speedy blood flow into one's brain.
It involves lots of sophisticated mental activity.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 Why does the Harvard neuroscientist say that lying takes work? 问神经科学家为什么作此判断，理由原文必有交代。
【拆句】 主干 Why does the Harvard neuroscientist say...，that 引导宾语从句 that lying takes work，takes work 这里取「需要付出努力/费劲」的引申义，不是字面的「带去工作」，是典型的熟词僻义点。
【定位】 P2 Harvard cognitive neuroscientist Joshua Greene says, for most of us, lying takes work. In studies, he gave subjects a chance to deceive for monetary gain while examining their brains in a functional MRI machine, which maps blood flow to active parts of the brain. Some people told the truth instantly and instinctively. But others opted to lie, and they showed increased activity in their frontal parietal(颅腔壁的) control network, which is involved in difficult or complex thinking. 哈佛认知神经科学家 Joshua Greene 说，对大多数人而言，撒谎是要费劲的。在研究中，他让受试者有机会为金钱回报而撒谎，同时用 fMRI 检查他们的大脑——fMRI 能映射出大脑活跃区域的血流。有些人会即时本能地说真话，但另一些人选择撒谎，他们的颅腔壁控制网络活动增强，而这一区域涉及困难或复杂的思考。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文 deciding between truth and dishonesty 是说撒谎者在「说真说假」之间挣扎，并未说选项 hard to choose from several options 的「多项中难选」；A 把二选一夸大成多选一，且重点偏离了「费劲」的脑科学解释。 B) 无中生有 原文讨论的是撒谎时大脑活动加剧，没说撒谎者要 sound natural or plausible（让谎言听起来自然可信）；这种表达层面的难度是常识联想，原文未涉及。 C) 偷换概念 原文是说 fMRI 仪器 maps blood flow to active parts of the brain——把血流映射到活跃脑区作观察手段，并非撒谎本身需要 speedy blood flow into one's brain。选项把仪器原理偷换成撒谎的生理条件。 D) ✓ 正确 which is involved in difficult or complex thinking ↔ lots of sophisticated mental activity increased activity in their frontal parietal(颅腔壁的) control network ↔ involves lots of sophisticated mental activity 预判要的是「撒谎牵涉复杂脑活动」，D 项 involves lots of sophisticated mental activity 把原文 complex thinking 用 sophisticated mental activity 精确改写，命中预判。

In studies, he gave subjects a chance to deceive for monetary gain while examining their brains in a functional MRI machine, which maps blood flow to active parts of the brain. records.stem: Under what circumstances do people tend to lie?

options.text: When they face too much peer pressure.
When the temptation is too strong.
When the consequences are not imminent.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 Under what circumstances do people tend to lie? 问的是原文列举过的具体条件之一，答案就在原文的条件清单里。
【拆句】 Under what circumstances 作状语前置，主干 do people tend to lie；tend to do 「倾向于…」，全句无修饰从句，结构平铺无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 We are more likely to lie, when we are able to rationalise it, when we are stressed and fatigued or see others being dishonest. 我们更容易撒谎——当我们能把它合理化时，当我们承受压力或疲惫时，或者当我们看到别人也不诚实时。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文条件清单是 able to rationalise it、stressed and fatigued、see others being dishonest，没有提到 become too emotional（变得过于情绪化）。stressed 与 emotional 不是同义概念，前者特指压力疲劳，后者指情绪失控。 B) 偷换概念 原文 see others being dishonest 是「看到别人也不诚实」，重点在「他人行为示范」而非 peer pressure（同辈群体压力要求一致行为）。前者是观察学习，后者是群体强制。 C) ✓ 正确 we are able to rationalise it ↔ the temptation is too strong the inability to resist temptation ↔ the temptation is too strong 在四个选项里，只有 C 项 the temptation is too strong 能与「rationalise it」「无法抗拒诱惑」这条主线对得上；A/B/D 都不在原文条件清单内，故锁定 C。 D) 张冠李戴 原文条件清单里没有 consequences are not imminent（后果不即将到来）这一条；与「后果」相关的内容在第四段讲「不受惩罚谎言会变大」（属 50 题），但那是「不受罚的结果」，不是「撒谎的触发条件」。

options.text: When they are worn out and stressed.

【答案】 B （细节题）

【定位】 P3 And we are less likely to lie when we have moral reminders or when we think others are watching. 当我们有道德提醒、或者认为别人正在注视着我们时，我们就不那么容易撒谎。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 原文 we are stressed and fatigued 出现在 more likely to lie 的条件里——「压力疲惫」是「更易撒谎」的条件，而非「不易撒谎」。选项 worn out and stressed 把它搬到「less likely」侧，正反弄反。 B) ✓ 正确 we think others are watching ↔ under watchful eyes 预判要的是「认为有人在看」的状态，B 项 under watchful eyes 用名词化短语精确改写了 think others are watching，是同义替换中典型的「动词从句→名词短语」转化，命中预判。 C) 偷换概念 think in a rational way（理性思考）与原文 rationalise it（合理化撒谎）措辞相近、语义却相反——前者是冷静客观，后者是为撒谎找借口；并且 rationalise 在原文是 more likely 一侧的条件。 D) 偷换概念 原文 moral reminders 是「外部的道德提醒/警示」（如海报、宣誓），不是 a clear conscience（自己问心无愧）。前者是外来刺激，后者是内心状态，且原文从未涉及「良心是否干净」的判断。

records.stem: What does the author say will happen when a liar does not get punished?

options.text: They may mix lies and truths.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does the author say will happen when a liar does not get punished? 问的是原文交代过的后果，答案直接陈述于文中。
【拆句】 主干 What does the author say will happen，What 是 will happen 的主语，作 say 的宾语从句的主句主语；when a liar does not get punished 是时间状语从句，整句虽嵌套但语义清晰。

【锚点】 锚定“超重老人+减重+加蛋白”
【定位】 H 段 Starr recently conducted a small study that found that adding extra protein foods to the diet of obese older individuals who were trying to lose weight strengthened their muscles. Starr最近做了一项小研究，发现给那些想减重的肥胖老年人在饮食中加入额外蛋白质食物，强化了他们的肌肉。
【改写】 overweight seniors seeking weight loss ↔ obese older individuals who were trying to lose weight 三重身份的同义词替换 Additional protein was found to help strengthen the muscles ↔ adding extra protein foods to the diet ... strengthened their muscles 动作直接对应
【辨邻】 G G段虽然有“老年人”和“蛋白”，但缺少陈述句overweight和seeking weight loss这两个元素——陈述句明确指向“想减重的肥胖老年人”这一更窄人群，必须在H段才能完全对应。 the protein needs of an older adult actually increase

records.stem: Pipitone believes that whole foods provide the best source of protein.

【改写】 Pipitone believes ↔ she says 人名指代等价 whole foods provide the best source of protein ↔ Whole foods are always the best option rather than adding supplements 近义词替换+句式简化
【辨邻】 E E段Pipitone的核心论点是健康成人买补剂It could just be a waste of money——讲的是补剂浪费钱，而陈述句Q44的核心是“天然食物是最好的蛋白来源”——立场对象不同。 It could just be a waste of money B B段陈述的是protein is present in all foods这一分布事实，没有“天然食物是最佳来源”这种价值判断；陈述句best source强调的是“最佳”这一立场表态，必须落在D段。 protein is present in all foods

records.stem: People are advised to drink more liquid when they take in more protein.
records.explanation:
【答案】 L 段（强锚点）
【锚点】 锚定“多吃蛋白+多喝水”

【改写】 drink more liquid ↔ increase your fluid intake 动作短语同义改写 when they take in more protein ↔ if you increase protein 时间状语对应条件状语 People are advised to ↔ you also have to 建议↔要求的等价
【辨邻】 M M段焦点是肾脏负担和肾结石风险，与陈述句Q45“多喝水”的建议没有对应。 extra protein makes the kidneys work harder

records.stem: What do we learn from the passage about attitude?

options.text: It shapes our beliefs and ideologies.
It determines how we respond to our immediate environment.
It changes the way we think, feel and interact with one another.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn from the passage about attitude 问的是 attitude 这一概念的本质特征，需要在原文找一句对 attitude 功能的定义句去对答案，本质仍是细节定位，而非全篇主旨。
【拆句】 What do we learn from the passage about attitude 是疑问句结构：主语 we、谓语 learn、from the passage 表来源、about attitude 表对象，无倒装无否定，直白提问对 attitude 的认识。
【定位】 P2 We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react to the world around us. 我们用我们的态度去过滤、解读并对周围的世界作出反应。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 It shapes our beliefs and ideologies. 把 attitude 说成“塑造我们的信念和意识形态”，但原文是 attitudes…towards particular objects, people, events or ideologies，ideologies 是 attitude 的对象，不是 attitude 塑造的产物。 B) 无中生有 It improves our psychological wellbeing. 中的 psychological wellbeing 在 P2 没有对应表述，原文只说 attitude 是 one of our most powerful psychological tools，强调“工具”不是“增进健康”。 C) ✓ 正确 react to the world around us ↔ respond to our immediate environment We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react ↔ It determines how we respond It determines how we respond to our immediate environment 与定位句 We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react to the world around us. 在“施动者—动作—对象”三层均一一对应，是同义改写。 D) 偷换概念 It changes the way we think, feel and interact with one another. 把原文 react to the world around us 改写成“与彼此互动”，并加了 changes（改变）这一动词，与原文“使用 attitudes 去 react”不一致。
records.keyword_relation: react to the world around us ↔ respond to our immediate environment；We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react ↔ It determines how we respond

evidence.text: We use our attitudes to filter, interpret and react to the world around us

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：It shapes our beliefs and ideologies. 把 attitude 说成“塑造我们的信念和意识形态”，但原文是 attitudes…towards particular objects, people, events or ideologies，ideologies 是 attitude 的对象，不是 attitude 塑造的产物。
distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：It improves our psychological wellbeing. 中的 psychological wellbeing 在 P2 没有对应表述，原文只说 attitude 是 one of our most powerful psychological tools，强调“工具”不是“增进健康”。
distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：It changes the way we think, feel and interact with one another. 把原文 react to the world around us 改写成“与彼此互动”，并加了 changes（改变）这一动词，与原文“使用 attitudes 去 react”不一致。

records.stem: What can contribute to the refinement of one's attitude, according to the passage?

options.text: Their contact with the opposite gender.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What can contribute to the refinement of one's attitude 问的是“致使”项，是对原文列举式因果句的细节查找。
【拆句】 What can contribute to the refinement of one's attitude, according to the passage 主语 What、谓语 can contribute to、宾语 refinement of one's attitude；according to the passage 是范围状语；句首特殊疑问句无倒装陷阱。
【定位】 P3 As you acquire a distinctive identity your attitudes are further refined by the behavior of those with whom you identify—your family, those of your gender and culture, and the people you admire, even though you may not know them personally. 当你逐渐获得独立的身份认同，你的态度会被你所认同的那些人——你的家人、与你同性别同文化的人、以及你所敬仰的人（即便你并不与他们相识）——的行为进一步精炼。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 the people you admire ↔ Their idols' behaviors. 破折号列举中明确含 the people you admire，Their idols' behaviors. 正是它的名词化同义改写，符合预判。 B) 无中生有 Their educational level. 中的 educational level 在 P3 没有任何对应表述，全段只谈身份、性别文化、敬仰者和信息重复。 C) 与原文相反 Their contact with the opposite gender. 与原文 those of your gender and culture 方向相反——原文强调的是与“同性别同文化”的认同者，C 却换成 opposite gender。 D) 与原文相反 Their interaction with different cultures. 与原文 those of your gender and culture 也方向相反——原文是“同文化者”，D 是“与不同文化互动”。

distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：Their contact with the opposite gender. 与原文 those of your gender and culture 方向相反——原文强调的是与“同性别同文化”的认同者，C 却换成 opposite gender。

records.stem: What do many studies find about people's feelings and thoughts?

options.text: They may not suggest how a person is going to behave.
They are in a way consistent with a person's mentality.
They may not find expression in interpersonal relations.
They are in line with a person's behavior no matter what.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What do many studies find 是查找原文对“many studies 的发现”这一明确事实的陈述。
【拆句】 What do many studies find about people's feelings and thoughts 标准 wh-疑问句：助动词 do 提到主语前，主语 many studies、谓语 find、about 短语作宾语补足；结构平直无陷阱。
【定位】 P4 However, many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior. 然而，许多研究发现，感受和想法未必能预示行为。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 don't necessarily predict behavior ↔ may not suggest how a person is going to behave They may not suggest how a person is going to behave. 以 They=feelings and thoughts 为主语，把 don't necessarily predict behavior 一字不漏地等值改写，符合预判。 B) 与原文相反 They are in a way consistent with a person's mentality. 说感受/想法与“心智”在某种程度上一致，但原文 many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior 强调的是与“行为”未必一致，B 既偷换对象又调转方向。 C) 偷换概念 They may not find expression in interpersonal relations. 把原文 behavior 偷换为 interpersonal relations（人际关系），属于话题外延的偷换。 D) 与原文相反 They are in line with a person's behavior no matter what. 用 no matter what 说“无论如何都一致”，与原文 don't necessarily predict behavior 完全相反。
records.keyword_relation: don't necessarily predict behavior ↔ may not suggest how a person is going to behave

evidence.text: However, many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior

distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：They are in a way consistent with a person's mentality. 说感受/想法与“心智”在某种程度上一致，但原文 many studies have found that feelings and thoughts don't necessarily predict behavior 强调的是与“行为”未必一致，B 既偷换对象又调转方向。
distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：They may not find expression in interpersonal relations. 把原文 behavior 偷换为 interpersonal relations（人际关系），属于话题外延的偷换。
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：They are in line with a person's behavior no matter what. 用 no matter what 说“无论如何都一致”，与原文 don't necessarily predict behavior 完全相反。

records.stem: How come many people don't do what they believe is good?

options.text: They have no idea how to.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 How come many people don't do what they believe is good 是“why”的口语化变体，仍是对原文因果句的细节查找。
【拆句】 How come many people don't do what they believe is good 中 How come 后接陈述语序的从句 many people don't do what they believe is good；what 引导宾语从句作 do 的宾语，结构虽嵌套但语义直接。
【定位】 P4 That's why, for example, many say they believe in the benefits of recycling or exercise, but don't behave in line with their views, because it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea. 这就是为什么，比如说，很多人嘴上说他们相信回收或运动的好处，却没有按自己的想法去做——因为要超越仅仅“嘴上说自己相信某事是好主意”这一步，需要觉察、努力和勇气。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 They can't afford the time. 把原因归为没时间，但 because it takes awareness, effort and courage 三个名词中均不含时间因素。 B) 偷换概念 They have no idea how to. 把原因归为“不知道怎么做”，但原文 because it takes awareness, effort and courage 强调的是意志品质，而不是方法/知识。 C) 过度推断 They are hypocritical. 把“嘴上说相信但不做”推断为伪善，但原文只说需要 awareness/effort/courage 才能落实，并未对人格作伪善评价。 D) ✓ 正确 it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea ↔ They lack willpower. They lack willpower. 把原文 awareness, effort and courage 三种并列意志品质归并为上位词 willpower，并以 lack 表达“需要却没有”，是同义改写。
records.keyword_relation: it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea ↔ They lack willpower.

evidence.text: That's why, for example, many say they believe in the benefits of recycling or exercise, but don't behave in line with their views, because it takes awareness, effort and courage to go beyond merely stating that you believe something is a good idea

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：They can't afford the time. 把原因归为没时间，但 because it takes awareness, effort and courage 三个名词中均不含时间因素。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：They have no idea how to. 把原因归为“不知道怎么做”，但原文 because it takes awareness, effort and courage 强调的是意志品质，而不是方法/知识。
distractor_explanations.C: 过度推断：They are hypocritical. 把“嘴上说相信但不做”推断为伪善，但原文只说需要 awareness/effort/courage 才能落实，并未对人格作伪善评价。

records.stem: What is proposed as a strategy to change attitude?

options.text: Changing things that require one's immediate attention.
Starting to act in a way that embodies one's aspirations.
Adjusting one's behavior gradually over a period of time.
Considering ways of reducing one's psychological burdens.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What is proposed as a strategy to change attitude 问“被提出的策略是什么”，是对末段明示策略句的细节查找。
【拆句】 What is proposed as a strategy to change attitude 是被动语态特殊疑问句：What 作主语、is proposed 是被动谓语、as a strategy to change attitude 是方式状语；考生要意识到“被提出的东西＝作者推荐的策略”。
【定位】 P5 One of the most effective ways to change an attitude is to start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to. 改变态度最有效的方法之一，是从现在开始就按你希望自己已经持有的感受和想法去行动。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Changing things that require one's immediate attention. 把策略说成“去改变那些需要立即关注的事”，但 P5 没有 immediate attention 这一概念，反而强调按理想状态行动。 B) ✓ 正确 start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to ↔ Starting to act in a way that embodies one's aspirations. as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to ↔ in a way that embodies one's aspirations Starting to act in a way that embodies one's aspirations. 与 One of the most effective ways to change an attitude is to start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to. 在动作（start behaving=Starting to act）、方式（as if…the way you'd prefer to=in a way that embodies one's aspirations）两层逐对对应，是同义改写。 C) 与原文相反 Adjusting one's behavior gradually over a period of time. 用 gradually over a period of time 表“逐步”，但原文 start behaving—right now 强调“现在就开始”，方向与节奏均相反。 D) 偷换概念 Considering ways of reducing one's psychological burdens. 把策略说成“减轻心理负担”，但 Is there anything you consider a burden rather than a privilege? If so, start behaving—right now—as if the latter is the case. 不是要“减轻 burden”，而是要按 privilege 的视角去行动。
records.keyword_relation: start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to ↔ Starting to act in a way that embodies one's aspirations.；as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to ↔ in a way that embodies one's aspirations

evidence.text: One of the most effective ways to change an attitude is to start behaving as if you already feel and think the way you'd prefer to

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：Changing things that require one's immediate attention. 把策略说成“去改变那些需要立即关注的事”，但 P5 没有 immediate attention 这一概念，反而强调按理想状态行动。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：Adjusting one's behavior gradually over a period of time. 用 gradually over a period of time 表“逐步”，但原文 start behaving—right now 强调“现在就开始”，方向与节奏均相反。
distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：Considering ways of reducing one's psychological burdens. 把策略说成“减轻心理负担”，但 Is there anything you consider a burden rather than a privilege? If so, start behaving—right now—as if the latter is the case. 不是要“减轻 burden”，而是要按 privilege 的视角去行动。

records.stem: What does Greenpeace's study find about krill fishing?

options.text: It caused a great many penguins and whales to migrate.
It was depriving penguins and whales of their habitats.
It was carried out too close to the habitats of penguins and whales.
It posed an unprecedented threat to the wildlife around Antarctica.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does Greenpeace's study find about krill fishing? 直接问"研究发现什么"，指向原文中可直接抽取的事实陈述。
【拆句】 What does Greenpeace's study find about krill fishing? 是标准 wh-疑问句，主语 Greenpeace's study、谓语 find、介词短语 about krill fishing 限定范围；结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating "in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds". Greenpeace 的研究分析了该地区磷虾船的航行轨迹，发现它们越来越多地在"紧邻企鹅栖息地和鲸鱼觅食区"的水域作业。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 caused a great many penguins and whales to migrate 中"造成大量企鹅鲸鱼迁徙"在原文找不到对应——P2 只说船在栖息地附近作业，未说动物迁徙。 B) 过度推断 depriving penguins and whales of their habitats 中 deprive...of 表"剥夺"，比原文"在附近作业"严重得多；原文未说磷虾产业"夺走"栖息地。 C) ✓ 正确 in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds ↔ too close to the habitats of penguins and whales they were increasingly operating ↔ It was carried out C 把"紧邻栖息地"重写为"太靠近栖息地"，与预判完全吻合，是定位句的客观转述。 D) 范围程度偷改 posed an unprecedented threat 中 unprecedented（前所未有的）是程度副词性夸张；原文 posed a serious threat 只说"严重威胁"，未说"前所未有"。
records.keyword_relation: in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds ↔ too close to the habitats of penguins and whales；they were increasingly operating ↔ It was carried out

evidence.text: The study by Greenpeace analysed the movements of krill fishing vessels in the region and found they were increasingly operating "in the immediate vicinity of penguin colonies and whale-feeding grounds

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：caused a great many penguins and whales to migrate 中"造成大量企鹅鲸鱼迁徙"在原文找不到对应——P2 只说船在栖息地附近作业，未说动物迁徙。
distractor_explanations.B: 过度推断：depriving penguins and whales of their habitats 中 deprive...of 表"剥夺"，比原文"在附近作业"严重得多；原文未说磷虾产业"夺走"栖息地。
distractor_explanations.D: 范围程度偷改：posed an unprecedented threat 中 unprecedented（前所未有的）是程度副词性夸张；原文 posed a serious threat 只说"严重威胁"，未说"前所未有"。

records.stem: For what purpose has a global campaign been launched?

options.text: To reduce the impact of climate change on Antarctica.
To establish conservation areas in the Antarctic region.
To regulate krill fishing operations in the Antarctic seas.
To publicise the concern about the impact of krill fishing.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 For what purpose has a global campaign been launched? 问的是已发生事件的具体目的，对应原文中一句可抽取的陈述。

records.stem: What does the author say best schools should do?

Encourage students to be ambitious and help them to achieve their goals.

【定位】 P1 The best seek to alleviate the external pressures on their pupils while equipping them better to understand and handle the world outside—at once sheltering them and broadening their horizons. 最好的学校力求缓解学生面临的外部压力，同时让他们更好地理解和应对外部世界——既庇护他们，又拓宽他们的视野。

【定位】 P2 Meanwhile, pupils arrive at school hungry because their families can't afford breakfast. The Child Poverty Action Group says nine out of 30 in every classroom fall below the poverty line. records.stem: What does the author suggest can help build community spirit?

【拆句】 What 既作主句宾语又作 build 的逻辑宾语；宾语从句 What does the author suggest can help build community spirit? 读作「作者建议什么能帮助构建社区精神」即可，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 Methods such as whole-school fundraising, with the proceeds pooled, can help to extend opportunities and fuel community spirit. 诸如全校共同筹款、所得款项集中调配等做法，有助于扩大机会、并激发社区凝聚力。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文做法是 whole-school fundraising——校内为校内学生筹款，A 项把它换成 Events aiming to improve community services——为社区服务，对象/目的全错。 B) 偷换概念 原文 ingenuity 是形容学校自身的应对智慧 remarkable determination and ingenuity，B 项把它移到学生身上 fuel students' ingenuity，主语偷换且与凝聚力议题无关。 C) 无中生有 原文未提及「相互理解」，作者只讲全校共担费用的筹款机制；require mutual understanding 是凭常识脑补出的成分。 D) ✓ 正确 whole-school fundraising ↔ Activities involving all students on campus with the proceeds pooled ↔ Activities involving all students on campus 预判强调的「全校共同参与」在四个选项中仅 Activities involving all students on campus 用 all students 抓住了 whole-school 的核心范围语义。

records.stem: What do we learn about low-income parents regarding school field trips?

options.text: They want their children to participate even though they don't see much benefit.
They don't want their kids to participate but find it hard to keep them from going.
They don't want their kids to miss any chance to broaden their horizons despite the cost.
They want their children to experience adventures but they don't want them to run risks.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What do we learn about low-income parents regarding school field trips? 问的是关于低收入家长的可被原文直接陈述的客观情况。
【拆句】 主干为 What do we learn about low-income parents，介词短语 regarding school field trips 限定话题范围；读作「关于低收入家长在校外考察这事上我们知道什么」即可，无陷阱。
【定位】 P4 Even parents who can see that a trip is little more than a party or celebration may well feel guilt that their child is left behind. 即便那些清楚某次行程不过是聚会或庆祝活动的家长，也很可能因为孩子被落下而感到愧疚。

records.stem: What is the author's expectation of schools?

options.text: Bringing a community together with ingenuity.
Resolving the existing discrepancies in society.
Avoiding creating new gaps among students.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What is the author's expectation of schools? 问的是作者表态性的具体期待，可由文末作者直接陈述句定位。
【拆句】 主干 What is the author's expectation of schools，of schools 是对象状语；读作「作者对学校的期待是什么」即可，无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 Schools cannot be expected to bring together communities single-handed. But the least we should expect is that they do not foster divisions and exclude those who are already disadvantaged. 我们不能指望学校独力把不同社群凝聚起来。但我们至少该期待的是：学校不要去制造分裂、不要去把那些本已处于弱势的学生排除在外。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 原文恰恰说 Schools cannot be expected to bring together communities single-handed，A 项却把它说成期待 Bringing a community together with ingenuity。 B) 过度推断 作者只要求学校不要制造新分裂，并未要求他们 Resolving the existing discrepancies in society——解决既有社会差距已超出作者明确表态。 C) ✓ 正确 they do not foster divisions ↔ Avoiding creating new gaps among students exclude those who are already disadvantaged ↔ new gaps among students 预判强调的「避免制造新差距、排斥弱势」在选项中仅 Avoiding creating new gaps among students 以 Avoiding 显式保留了 do not 这一否定底线。 D) 无中生有 原文未要求学校对贫困生 Giving poor students preferential treatment，只要求不要排斥；preferential 这一额外优待是作者未提的成分。

records.stem: What will happen by 2100, according to a new study?

options.text: King penguins in the Antarctic will be on the verge of dying out.
Sea water will rise to a much higher level around the Antarctic.
The melting ice cover will destroy the great Antarctic wilderness.
The pristine waters around the Antarctic will disappear forever.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What will happen by 2100 是对特定时间点将发生事件的客观询问，没有 infer、suggest、imply 等推断信号词。
【拆句】 What will happen by 2100, according to a new study? 主干是 What will happen，by 2100 是时间状语，according to a new study 是来源状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Rising temperatures and overfishing in the pristine(未受污染的) waters around the Antarctic could see king penguin populations pushed to the brink of extinction by the end of the century, according to a new study. 据一项新研究，南极未受污染水域的气温上升与过度捕捞，可能使帝企鹅种群在本世纪末濒临灭绝。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 king penguin populations pushed to the brink of extinction ↔ King penguins in the Antarctic will be on the verge of dying out. 预判要的「濒临灭绝」与 on the verge of dying out 形成短语级的等值同义替换，且时间状语 by 2100 与原文一致。 B) 无中生有 Sea water will rise to a much higher level around the Antarctic. 讲的是海平面上升，原文只说 Rising temperatures（气温上升），没说海平面上升。 C) 偷换概念 The melting ice cover will destroy the great Antarctic wilderness. 说南极荒野将被冰盖融化摧毁。原文虽提到 world's last great wilderness，但说的是企鹅可能灭绝，而非荒野被毁；melting ice cover 也未在文中作为 2100 年的预测出现。 D) 与原文相反 The pristine waters around the Antarctic will disappear forever. 说南极纯净水域将永远消失。原文 pristine\(未受污染的\) waters around the Antarctic 只是被借来限定位置，根本没说这片水域会消失，反而是研究警告水域里的生物会消失。

records.stem: What do we learn from the findings of a separate study?

options.text: Shrinking krill population and rising temperatures could force Antarctic whales to migrate.
Human activities have accelerated climate change in the Antarctic region in recent years.
Industrial fishing and climate change could be fatal to certain Antarctic species.
Krill fishing in the Antarctic has worsened the pollution of the pristine waters.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn from the findings of a separate study? 问的是另一项研究的具体结论，客观转述即可。
【拆句】 What do we learn from the findings of a separate study? 主干 What do we learn，from the findings of a separate study 整体作介词短语状语，无复杂从句、无否定，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 Earlier this month a separate study found that a combination of climate change and industrial fishing is threatening the krill(磷虾) population in Antarctic waters, with a potentially disastrous impact on whales, seals and penguins. 本月早些时候另一项独立研究发现，气候变化和工业捕捞的共同作用正威胁着南极水域的磷虾种群，可能对鲸、海豹和企鹅造成灾难性影响。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 Shrinking krill population and rising temperatures could force Antarctic whales to migrate. 把鲸迁徙写成结论，但原文只说对鲸有 disastrous impact，并未说鲸会迁徙。 B) 答非所问 Human activities have accelerated climate change in the Antarctic region in recent years. 说人类活动加速了气候变化，是另一个层面的话题，原 separate study 的结论不是这个。 C) ✓ 正确 a combination of climate change and industrial fishing ↔ Industrial fishing and climate change with a potentially disastrous impact on whales, seals and penguins ↔ could be fatal to certain Antarctic species 「合力」和「灾难性影响」两个核心节点均被 C 项以同义替换形式覆盖，且范围词 certain 与原文 whales, seals and penguins 的有限枚举一致。 D) 无中生有 Krill fishing in the Antarctic has worsened the pollution of the pristine waters. 说磷虾捕捞恶化了水污染，原文从未谈水域被污染，只是用 pristine 形容尚未污染。

records.stem: What does the passage say about king penguins?

options.text: They will turn out to be the second-largest species of birds to become extinct.
Many of them will have to migrate to isolated islands in the Southern Ocean.
They feed primarily on only a few kinds of krill in the Antarctic Polar Front.
The majority of them may have to find new breeding grounds in the future.

records.stem: What happens when sea levels rise in the Antarctic?

【判型】 What happens when sea levels rise in the Antarctic? 问的是某条件发生时的直接客观后果，不涉及推断或态度。

【定位】 P3 As the ocean warms, a body of water called the Antarctic Polar Front—an upward movement of nutrient-rich sea that supports a huge abundance of marine life—is being pushed further south. This means that king penguins, which feed on fish and krill in this body of water, have to travel further to their feeding grounds, leaving their hungry chicks for longer. 随着海洋升温，名为南极极锋的水体——一股富含营养的海水上涌、支撑着大量海洋生物——正在被推向更南方。这意味着以这片水域中的鱼和磷虾为食的帝企鹅必须前往更远处觅食，使饥饿的幼鸟被独留更长时间。

records.stem: What do we learn about followers of the positive stress movement?

They derive much pleasure from living a very hectic life.

records.explanation:

【判型】 What do we learn about followers of the positive stress movement 问的是关于该群体的客观信息，没有 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。
【拆句】 题干是一般疑问式陈述句：主语 we、谓语 learn、介词短语 about followers of the positive stress movement 指明所问对象。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 People often discuss the dangers of too much stress, but lately a very different view of stress is gaining popularity: this view of stress, held by members of the positive stress movement, argues that stress might actually be beneficial. 人们常讨论压力过大的危害，但最近一种截然不同的压力观正在走红：这种观点由 positive stress movement 的成员所持，主张压力其实可能是有益的。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 sensitive to different types of stress『对不同压力敏感』全文未提；原文只说他们对压力的看法不同，不是对压力本身敏感。 B) ✓ 正确 a very different view of stress ↔ a different view on stress from the popular one members of the positive stress movement ↔ They B 选项就是 a very different view of stress 的标准转述，与预判完全吻合。 C) 偷换概念 derive much pleasure from living a very hectic life『从极忙生活中获取快乐』偷换了原文 looking for an edge in a competitive world 的概念——是『谋求优势』，不是『以忙为乐』。 D) 与原文相反 gain a competitive edge by enjoying good health『靠好身体获得竞争优势』因果倒置：原文是为求竞争优势而做极端做法，不是先有好身体再获优势。

records.stem: What does the author say sounds ironic?

options.text: Some predators may often turn out to be prey of other predators.
Hunting may also be a solution to the problem caused by hunting.
The species of prey animals continue to vary despite humans' hunting.
The number of prey animals keeps rising despite environmental change.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does the author say sounds ironic? 用 what 直接索取作者点名为讽刺的那件事，无 infer/imply/main idea 字样。
【拆句】 What does the author say sounds ironic? 是宾语前置的间接引语：what 是 sounds ironic 的逻辑主语，the author say 作插入语；还原即 the author says (that) what sounds ironic。无陷阱，但要留意它问的是"被作者认为讽刺的事"，不是"讽刺地……"。
【定位】 P1 And, ironic as it sounds, since humans have wiped out many animal predators, some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment's carrying capacity. 而且，听起来虽然讽刺：既然人类已经消灭了许多动物天敌，有人就把狩猎看作一种天然手段，用来削减那些如今繁殖数量已超过环境承载力的猎物种群。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Some predators may often turn out to be prey of other predators. 谈"天敌也是别的天敌的猎物"的食物链问题，原文只提 humans 既是 predator 又是 prey，并未讨论天敌之间的相互捕食。 B) ✓ 正确 since humans have wiped out many animal predators, some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment's carrying capacity ↔ Hunting may also be a solution to the problem caused by hunting. 预判"制造问题的手段反过来变成解决问题的手段"与 Hunting may also be a solution to the problem caused by hunting. 完全等值——problem 对应 overpopulation, solution 对应 a natural way to reduce, caused by hunting 对应 humans have wiped out predators。 C) 答非所问 The species of prey animals continue to vary despite humans' hunting. 说"猎物物种持续多样化"，原文未谈物种多样化方向；且即使为真，也回答的是"猎物物种变化"而非"作者觉得讽刺的事"。 D) 偷换概念 The number of prey animals keeps rising despite environmental change. 把原文的"超过环境承载力 (beyond the environment's carrying capacity)"偷换成"despite environmental change（不顾环境变化）"，并丢弃了"因人类消灭天敌"这层因果。

records.stem: What does Glenn Kirk think of charging hunters license fees?

options.text: It keeps game population under control.
It turns hunting into a sport of the rich.
It helps stop killing for pleasure.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does Glenn Kirk think of charging hunters license fees? 索取一个具名人物对一个具体做法的明确观点，原文必有对应表述。
【拆句】 What does Glenn Kirk think of charging hunters license fees? 中 charging hunters license fees 是动名词短语作 of 的宾语，charge sb. sth. 即"向某人收取某费"。基础薄弱考生易把 charging 误读为现在分词"正在收费的"，要看清它是名词性结构。
【定位】 P2 He adds that, despite hunters' claims that hunting keeps wildlife populations in balance, hunters' license fees are used to "manipulate a few game species into overpopulation at the expense of a much larger number of non-game species, resulting in the loss of biological diversity, genetic integrity and ecological balance." 他补充说：尽管猎人声称狩猎能让野生动物种群保持平衡，但猎人的执照费实际上被用来"操纵少数狩猎物种过度繁殖，代价是数量大得多的非狩猎物种，结果造成生物多样性、遗传完整性和生态平衡的丧失"。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 It keeps game population under control. 说"让狩猎物种数量受控"，但 Kirk 恰恰指出 license fees 是 manipulate a few game species into overpopulation——是制造过度繁殖，而非控制数量。 B) 无中生有 It turns hunting into a sport of the rich. 说"把狩猎变成富人的运动"，原文从未提及收费让狩猎变贵或仅富人可及。 C) ✓ 正确 resulting in the loss of biological diversity, genetic integrity and ecological balance ↔ It leads to ecological imbalance. 预判"执照费导致生态失衡"完整对应 It leads to ecological imbalance.，且把原文三项后果（diversity / integrity / balance）中最具概括性的 ecological balance 留作落点，正是六级正确项的典型做法。 D) 与原文相反 It helps stop killing for pleasure. 说"有助于停止为娱乐而杀"，与 Kirk 全篇的批评立场矛盾——他在 P2 上半段还指责 hunters kill for pleasure，根本不可能认为执照费能解决这件事。
records.keyword_relation: resulting in the loss of biological diversity, genetic integrity and ecological balance ↔ It leads to ecological imbalance.

evidence.text: He adds that, despite hunters' claims that hunting keeps wildlife populations in balance, hunters' license fees are used to "manipulate a few game species into overpopulation at the expense of a much larger number of non-game species, resulting in the loss of biological diversity, genetic integrity and ecological balance
