records.stem: What is the argument of the Humane Society of the United States against hunting?

options.text: Overpopulation is not an issue for most hunted animals.
Hunting deprives animal populations of their food sources.
Many birds and small animals are being irrationally killed.
Hunting is universally acknowledged as a savage behavior.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What is the argument of the Humane Society of the United States against hunting? 直接索取一个组织的反方理据。
【拆句】 What is the argument of the Humane Society of the United States against hunting? 是 What is the N? 的判断句；against hunting 修饰 argument，意为"反对狩猎的论点"。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 According to the Humane Society of the United States, the vast majority of hunted species—such as waterfowl, rabbits, upland birds and mourning doves—"provide minimal nutrition and do not require population control." 美国人道协会指出：绝大多数被猎杀的物种——例如水禽、兔子、高地鸟和哀鸽——"营养价值极低，且并不需要被控制数量"。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 the vast majority of hunted species…"…do not require population control." ↔ Overpopulation is not an issue for most hunted animals. 预判"大多数被猎物种不需控数"与 Overpopulation is not an issue for most hunted animals. 完全对应：not require control（不需要控）= overpopulation is not an issue（不存在过剩问题）。 B) 无中生有 Hunting deprives animal populations of their food sources. 说"狩猎剥夺了动物种群的食物来源"，原文 P3 全段未谈"食物来源"问题。 C) 张冠李戴 Many birds and small animals are being irrationally killed. 这种"残忍/非理性"表述属于 P2 中 Glenn Kirk 的立场（irrationally cruel），而非 P3 中 Humane Society 的论点。 D) 过度推断 Hunting is universally acknowledged as a savage behavior. 把"反方观点"夸张为"普遍公认"，universally 远超 P3 的具体表述，事实上 P2 已说明只是 some 反对者持此立场。
records.keyword_relation: the vast majority of hunted species…"…do not require population control." ↔ Overpopulation is not an issue for most hunted animals.

evidence.text: According to the Humane Society of the United States, the vast majority of hunted species—such as waterfowl, rabbits, upland birds and mourning doves—"provide minimal nutrition and do not require population control

distractor_explanations.D: 过度推断：Hunting is universally acknowledged as a savage behavior. 把"反方观点"夸张为"普遍公认"，universally 远超 P3 的具体表述，事实上 P2 已说明只是 some 反对者持此立场。

records.stem: When is hunting morally justifiable according to Gary E. Varner?

options.text: When it benefits animals and their ecosystem.
When it serves both human and animal interests.
When it is indispensable to humans' subsistence.
When it stabilizes the population of animal species.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 When is hunting morally justifiable according to Gary E. Varner? 用 when 索取一个明确条件，原文必有 Varner 给出的判定标准。
【拆句】 When is hunting morally justifiable according to Gary E. Varner? 是 when 引导的特殊疑问句，morally justifiable 是"副词+形容词"作表语，意为"在道德上可被辩护的"。结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】 P4 Hunting "designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both"—what Varner terms "therapeutic hunting"—is defensible, while subsistence and sport hunting—both of which only benefit human beings—are not. Varner 称那种"旨在保障目标物种整体福祉、其生态系统完整性、或二者兼顾"的狩猎为"治疗性狩猎"，认为它是可被辩护的；而生计性狩猎和运动性狩猎——这两者只让人类得益——则不可辩护。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both ↔ When it benefits animals and their ecosystem. 预判"为目标物种与生态系统好"与 When it benefits animals and their ecosystem. 一一对应——target species→animals, its ecosystem→their ecosystem, secure welfare/integrity→benefits。 B) 与原文相反 When it serves both human and animal interests. 把答案纳入"既为人也为动物"，但原文 Varner 明确说仅 only benefit human beings 的 subsistence/sport hunting 是不可辩护的；可辩护的那类不包含"为人类利益"。 C) 与原文相反 When it is indispensable to humans' subsistence. 直接为 subsistence hunting 辩护，而 Varner 明确把 subsistence hunting 列为"不可辩护"那一类。 D) 以偏概全 When it stabilizes the population of animal species. 只截取"控数"这一面（接近 P1 论调），而 Varner 的判据更宽——welfare、ecosystem integrity 都算；且"stabilize population"在 P4 并无对应表述。
records.keyword_relation: designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both ↔ When it benefits animals and their ecosystem.

evidence.text: Hunting "designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both"—what Varner terms "therapeutic hunting"—is defensible, while subsistence and sport hunting—both of which only benefit human beings—are not

distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：When it serves both human and animal interests. 把答案纳入"既为人也为动物"，但原文 Varner 明确说仅 only benefit human beings 的 subsistence/sport hunting 是不可辩护的；可辩护的那类不包含"为人类利益"。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：When it is indispensable to humans' subsistence. 直接为 subsistence hunting 辩护，而 Varner 明确把 subsistence hunting 列为"不可辩护"那一类。
distractor_explanations.D: 以偏概全：When it stabilizes the population of animal species. 只截取"控数"这一面（接近 P1 论调），而 Varner 的判据更宽——welfare、ecosystem integrity 都算；且"stabilize population"在 P4 并无对应表述。

records.stem: What concept are green leaders trying to promote?

options.text: Coordinated efforts of hunters and environmentalists.
A compromise between development and animal protection.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What concept are green leaders trying to promote? 索取一个具体主张，原文末段必有对应表述。
【拆句】 What concept are green leaders trying to promote? 是 what 作宾语前置的现在进行时疑问句，are trying to promote 表"正在努力推动"。注意 concept 是抽象名词，原文给的将是一个"主张/理念"而非具体行动。
【定位】 P7 Perhaps matching the trend among the public, green leaders are increasingly advocating cooperation between hunters and environmental groups: After all, both deplore urban sprawl and habitat destruction. 或许与公众的趋势相呼应，环保领袖们越来越主张猎人与环保团体之间展开合作：毕竟，双方都谴责城市无序扩张和栖息地破坏。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 Effective protection of animal habitats. 只截取末句 habitat destruction 的一个侧面，而 green leaders 推动的核心是"双方合作"——栖息地保护只是合作理由，不是他们倡导的概念。 B) 以偏概全 Strict control over urban development. 同样只截取 urban sprawl 一个侧面，且 green leaders 并未单独倡导"严控城市发展"，而是把"deplore urban sprawl"作为双方合作的共同立场。 C) ✓ 正确 green leaders are increasingly advocating cooperation between hunters and environmental groups ↔ Coordinated efforts of hunters and environmentalists. 预判"猎人与环保派联手合作"与 Coordinated efforts of hunters and environmentalists. 一一对应，且选项的抽象度（concept）正好匹配题干 What concept 的提问层级。 D) 无中生有 A compromise between development and animal protection. 引入"发展 vs 动物保护的妥协"二元对立，原文从未涉及"开发派 vs 保护派的妥协"。
records.keyword_relation: green leaders are increasingly advocating cooperation between hunters and environmental groups ↔ Coordinated efforts of hunters and environmentalists.

evidence.text: Perhaps matching the trend among the public, green leaders are increasingly advocating cooperation between hunters and environmental groups: After all, both deplore urban sprawl and habitat destruction

distractor_explanations.A: 以偏概全：Effective protection of animal habitats. 只截取末句 habitat destruction 的一个侧面，而 green leaders 推动的核心是"双方合作"——栖息地保护只是合作理由，不是他们倡导的概念。
distractor_explanations.B: 以偏概全：Strict control over urban development. 同样只截取 urban sprawl 一个侧面，且 green leaders 并未单独倡导"严控城市发展"，而是把"deplore urban sprawl"作为双方合作的共同立场。
distractor_explanations.D: 无中生有：A compromise between development and animal protection. 引入"发展 vs 动物保护的妥协"二元对立，原文从未涉及"开发派 vs 保护派的妥协"。

records.stem: Why is the obesity problem in Britain so difficult to solve?

options.text: People disagree as to who should do what.
Individuals are not ready to take their responsibilities.

records.explanation:

【定位】 P1 No one disputes the costs in quality of life and depleted health budgets of an obese population, but the quest for solutions gets diverted by ideological arguments around responsibility and choice. And the water is muddied by lobbying from the industries that profit from consumption of obesity-inducing products. 没有人否认肥胖人群在生活质量和耗损的卫生预算上的代价，但解决方案的追寻被围绕 "责任与选择" 的意识形态争论所分散；而靠售卖致胖产品获利的行业的游说，更把水搅浑了。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 Government health budgets are depleted 引自 depleted health budgets of an obese population，原文把 depleted budgets 列为肥胖造成的 "代价"（No one disputes the costs），不是问题难解的原因。 B) ✓ 正确 the quest for solutions gets diverted by ideological arguments around responsibility and choice ↔ People disagree as to who should do what B 项把定位句中 "意识形态争论 + 责任与选择" 改写为 "人们在 谁做什么 上意见不一"，正是定位句两层原因之一的同义还原，且不超出定位句范围。 C) 无中生有 Individuals are not ready to take their responsibilities 文中并无此意——P1 谈的是 "关于谁负责的争论"，并未给个人是否 ready 下结论，且 "个人不愿担责" 在末段 P5 反而被作者反驳为伪命题。 D) 偷换概念 Industry lobbying makes it hard to get healthy foods 把原文 the water is muddied by lobbying——游说让政策讨论混乱——偷换成 "游说让人难以买到健康食品"，对象与机制全错。

records.stem: What can we learn from the past experience in tackling public health emergencies?

options.text: Governments have a role to play.
Public health is a scientific issue.
Priority should be given to deprived regions.

records.explanation:

【判型】 题干 What can we learn from the past experience in tackling public health emergencies? 询问从历史经验得出的客观启示，原文有直陈句承担答案，不需要推理。
【拆句】 题干 What can we learn from the past experience in tackling public health emergencies?：主干为 "What can we learn"，from 引出来源，in tackling... 是 the past experience 的修饰成分（动名词短语作后置定语），无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 Historical precedent suggests that science and politics can overcome resistance from businesses that pollute and poison but it takes time, and success often starts small. 历史先例表明，科学与政治能够战胜来自污染和投毒企业的抵抗，但需要时间，且成功往往从小处起步。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 science and politics can overcome resistance from businesses that pollute and poison ↔ Governments have a role to play A 项 Governments have a role to play 抓住定位句的核心断言 "政治（政府）能克服行业阻力"，并以更稳健的措辞表达，预判直接对应。 B) 偷换概念 Public health is a scientific issue 用了原文出现过的 science 一词，但定位句说的是 "科学与政治共同克服阻力"，并未把 public health 定性为一个 scientific issue。 C) 以偏概全 Priority should be given to deprived areas 借自 The best results were among younger children and in more deprived areas，但那只是 Leeds 案例的结果描述，不是 "past experience" 给出的可迁移结论。 D) 与原文相反 Businesses' responsibility should be stressed 与原文 overcome resistance from businesses that pollute and poison 关系相反——原文是 "克服企业阻力"，不是 "强调企业责任"；末段才提及 private sector 需监管激励。

records.stem: What does the author imply about some critics of bans and taxes concerning unhealthy drinks?

options.text: They are not aware of the consequences of obesity.
They have not come up with anything more constructive.
They are uncomfortable with parliament's anti-obesity debate.
They have their own motives in opposing government regulation.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （推断题）
【判型】 题干 What does the author imply about some critics of bans and taxes concerning unhealthy drinks? 含 imply，作者并未直陈，需要从原文的言外之意推一步。
【拆句】 题干 What does the author imply about some critics of bans and taxes concerning unhealthy drinks?：主干 "What does the author imply"，about 引出 imply 的对象 some critics of bans and taxes；concerning 等价于 about，是该角色短语的后置修饰，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 Bans and taxes can be blunt instruments, but their harshest critics can rarely suggest better methods. These critics just oppose regulation itself. 禁令和税收可能是钝器，但它们最严厉的批评者很少能提出更好的办法。这些批评者只是反对监管本身。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 They are not aware of the consequences of obesity 文中无据——首段早已说明 No one disputes the costs，作者并未暗示批评者不知道肥胖后果。 B) ✓ 正确 their harshest critics can rarely suggest better methods ↔ They have not come up with anything more constructive B 项 They have not come up with anything more constructive 正是定位句 "很少能提出更好方法" 的一步延伸——即他们没有更具建设性的方案，未超出原文一步。 C) 张冠李戴 They are uncomfortable with parliament's anti-obesity debate 利用 Many members of parliament are uncomfortable even with their own government's anti-obesity strategy 制造熟悉感，但原文里 uncomfortable 的主语是 members of parliament，不是题干所问的 critics；且 uncomfortable 的对象是 strategy 而非 debate。 D) 过度推断 They have their own motives in opposing government regulation 把作者中性陈述 These critics just oppose regulation itself 强行升级为 "有不可告人的动机"，超出文本一步——原文只说他们反对监管本身，并未说他们有 own motives。

evidence.text: Bans and taxes can be blunt instruments, but their harshest critics can rarely suggest better methods. These critics just oppose regulation itself

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：They are not aware of the consequences of obesity 文中无据——首段早已说明 No one disputes the costs，作者并未暗示批评者不知道肥胖后果。
distractor_explanations.C: 张冠李戴：They are uncomfortable with parliament's anti-obesity debate 利用 Many members of parliament are uncomfortable even with their own government's anti-obesity strategy 制造熟悉感，但原文里 uncomfortable 的主语是 members of parliament，不是题干所问的 critics；且 uncomfortable 的对象是 strategy 而非 debate。

records.stem: Why does the author stress the relationship between poor health and inequality?

options.text: To demonstrate the dilemma of people living in deprived areas.
To bring to light the root cause of widespread obesity in Britain.
To highlight the area deserving the most attention from the public.
To justify government intervention in solving the obesity problem.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （例证目的题）
【判型】 题干 Why does the author stress the relationship between poor health and inequality? 不是问内容本身，而是问作者为何要强调这一关系——典型的写作意图/例证目的题。
【拆句】 题干 Why does the author stress the relationship between poor health and inequality?：主干 "Why does the author stress the relationship"，between... 是 relationship 的后置修饰，无陷阱；注意 stress 在此为 "强调" 而非 "压力"，是熟词僻义。
【定位】 P4 The relationship between poor health and inequality is too pronounced for governments to be passive about large-scale intervention. 贫困健康状况与社会不平等之间的关系如此显著，政府对大规模干预不能再袖手旁观。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 To demonstrate the dilemma of people living in deprived areas 利用 People living in the most deprived areas 这一句制造熟悉感，但作者写它是支撑 "政府该介入" 这一目的的论据，不是为了 "展示贫困地区的两难"。 B) 过度推断 To bring to light the root cause of widespread obesity in Britain 把 "poor health 与 inequality 的关联" 误读为 "inequality 是肥胖的根源"，原文从未给出 root cause 的因果断言。 C) 偷换概念 To highlight the area deserving the most attention from the public 把作者面向 "政府能否介入" 的论证目的偷换为 "提示公众应该关注哪里"——主体（政府→公众）和目的（合法化干预→引导关注）双双偷换。 D) ✓ 正确 too pronounced for governments to be passive about large-scale intervention ↔ To justify government intervention in solving the obesity problem the complaint about over protective government loses potency ↔ To justify government intervention in solving the obesity problem D 项 To justify government intervention in solving the obesity problem 用 justify 一词精准对应原文 "too...to be passive" 的双重否定结论与段尾 "反对论失去力量" 的支撑，是段落写作目的的精确还原。
records.keyword_relation: too pronounced for governments to be passive about large-scale intervention ↔ To justify government intervention in solving the obesity problem；the complaint about over protective government loses potency ↔ To justify government intervention in solving the obesity problem

evidence.text: The relationship between poor health and inequality is too pronounced for governments to be passive about large-scale intervention

distractor_explanations.A: 以偏概全：To demonstrate the dilemma of people living in deprived areas 利用 People living in the most deprived areas 这一句制造熟悉感，但作者写它是支撑 "政府该介入" 这一目的的论据，不是为了 "展示贫困地区的两难"。

records.stem: When will government action be effective?

options.text: When the polarised debate is abandoned.
When individuals have the incentive to act accordingly.
When the private sector realises the severity of the crisis.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 When will government action be effective? 问的是一个客观条件，原文会有直陈句，直接定位—比对即可。
【拆句】 题干 When will government action be effective? 是标准 when 一般疑问句，主语 government action，系表 will be effective，无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 Government action works when individuals are motivated to respond. 当个人有动力做出回应时，政府行动才会奏效。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 When the polarised debate is abandoned 来自 the polarised debate over public health interventions should have been abandoned long ago——这是作者对辩论本身的态度，不是 "政府行动有效" 的条件。 B) 无中生有 When ideological differences are resolved 借自 The obesity crisis will not have a solution devised by left or right ideology，但原文恰恰说不会有意识形态导向的方案，并未把 "意识形态分歧解决" 列为行动有效条件。 C) ✓ 正确 Government action works when individuals are motivated to respond ↔ When individuals have the incentive to act accordingly C 项 When individuals have the incentive to act accordingly 与定位句 when 从句逐元素对应：individuals=individuals、incentive=motivated、act accordingly=respond，且未越界。 D) 与原文相反 When the private sector realises the severity of the crisis 借自 experience indicates that the private sector needs the incentive of regulation before it starts taking public health emergencies seriously，但原文是 "私营部门需要监管激励才会重视"——政府行动是因，私营部门重视是果，选项把因果方向颠倒。

records.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the Coral Sea?

options.text: It is exceptionally rich in marine life.
It is the biggest marine protected area.
It remains largely undisturbed by humans.
It is a unique haven of endangered species.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn from the passage about the Coral Sea? 是开放式细节询问，没有 infer/imply/mainly about，落点是 "about the Coral Sea" 的客观介绍。
【拆句】 What do we learn from the passage about the Coral Sea? 主干 "What do we learn"，介词短语 "from the passage" 与 "about the Coral Sea" 都是状语，落点是对 the Coral Sea 的客观信息，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Home to virgin reefs, rare sharks and vast numbers of exotic fish, the Coral Sea is a unique haven of biodiversity off the northeastern coast of Australia. 珊瑚海拥有原始珊瑚礁、稀有鲨鱼和大量奇异鱼类，是澳大利亚东北海岸外一处独特的生物多样性天堂。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 vast numbers of exotic fish ↔ exceptionally rich in marine life a unique haven of biodiversity ↔ rich in marine life 预判落点是"生物种类极丰富"，exceptionally rich in marine life 是这条预判的直接同义表述，锁 A。 B) 偷换概念 原文 If a proposal by the Australian government goes ahead, the region will also become the world's largest marine protected area 用条件句 "if…will"，是"如果方案落地、将来成为"，而 It is the biggest marine protected area 用一般现在时把它说成既成事实。 C) 无中生有 原文只说 Coral Sea 物种丰富、政府拟设保护区，并未提及 "largely undisturbed by humans"（基本未受人类干扰）——文中反而暗示需要 restrictions or bans on fishing, mining and marine farming，存在人类活动威胁。 D) 偷换概念 原文用 rare sharks（稀有的）和 exotic fish（奇异的），强调稀有与多样；endangered species（濒危物种）比 rare/exotic 多了一层 "濒临灭绝" 的语义，超出原文程度。

distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：原文用 rare sharks（稀有的）和 exotic fish（奇异的），强调稀有与多样；endangered species（濒危物种）比 rare/exotic 多了一层 "濒临灭绝" 的语义，超出原文程度。

records.stem: What does the Australian government plan to do according to Tony Burke?

options.text: Make a new proposal to protect the Coral Sea.
Revise its conservation plan owing to criticisms.
Upgrade the established reserves to protect marine life.
Complete the series of marine reserves around its coast.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What does the Australian government plan to do according to Tony Burke? 问的是具体计划内容，是对原文事实的复述，没有 infer/imply。

records.stem: What do we learn from the conclusion of the author's review study?

options.text: More resources should be tapped for feeding the world's population.
Organic farming may be exploited to solve the global food problem.
The long-term prospects of organic farming are yet to be explored.
Organic farming is at least as promising as conventional farming.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What do we learn from the conclusion of the author's review study? 是 What 提问且指向作者明确表述过的结论，没有 infer/imply 等推断信号。
【拆句】 题干 What do we learn from the conclusion of the author's review study? 是疑问句，主干为 What do we learn，from the conclusion of the author's review study 是介词短语作状语，说明"从哪里得知"。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Organic agriculture is a relatively untapped resource for feeding the Earth's population, especially in the face of climate change and other global challenges. That's the conclusion I reached in reviewing 40 years of science comparing the long-term prospects of organic and conventional farming. 有机农业是一项相对尚未被开发利用的资源，可用于养活地球人口，尤其是在气候变化与其他全球挑战面前。这是我回顾对比有机与常规农业长期前景的 40 年科学研究后得出的结论。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文说"有机农业是一种尚未被开发的资源"，选项却把主语换成了 More resources——主体从"有机农业本身是资源"被偷换成了"应开发更多资源"，丢失了"有机"这一核心限定。 B) ✓ 正确 Organic agriculture is a relatively untapped resource for feeding the Earth's population ↔ Organic farming may be exploited to solve the global food problem especially in the face of climate change and other global challenges ↔ the global food problem 预判要求表达"有机农业可被开发利用来应对全球粮食问题"，Organic farming may be exploited to solve the global food problem 与之一一对应，是定位句的标准同义改写。 C) 与原文相反 原文 That's the conclusion I reached 表明作者已经得出结论；选项 are yet to be explored 却说"长远前景仍有待探索"，与原文完全相反。 D) 无中生有 选项 Organic farming is at least as promising as conventional farming 是"二者前景至少同等光明"的并列断言，原文结论句只说有机是"未被开发的资源"、未把二者做"at least as...as"的并列评估。

records.stem: What is the critics' argument against organic farming?

options.text: It cannot meet the need for food.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What is the critics' argument against organic farming? 直接问"具体论点是什么"，对象明确、问法直接。
【拆句】 题干 What is the critics' argument against organic farming? 主干为 What is the argument，critics' 是所有格定语，against organic farming 是介词短语作定语修饰 argument，整体说"批评者针对有机农业的论点"。
【定位】 P3 Critics have long argued that organic agriculture is inefficient, requiring more land to yield the same amount of food. It's true that organic farming produces lower yields, averaging 10 to 20 percent less than conventional. 批评者长期以来一直主张有机农业效率低下，需要更多土地才能产出同等数量的食物。事实上，有机农业的产量确实较低，平均比常规农业少 10% 到 20%。

records.stem: What does science tell us about conventional farming?

options.text: It will not be able to meet global food demand.
It is not conducive to sustainable development.
It will eventually give away to organic farming.
It is going mainstream throughout the world.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does science tell us about conventional farming? 是 What 提问，问"科学告诉我们"的明示内容，属直陈式提问。
【拆句】 题干 What does science tell us about conventional farming? 主干为 What does science tell us，about conventional farming 是介词短语作状语，限定话题范围。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 What science does tell us is that mainstream conventional farming systems have provided growing supplies of food and other products but often at the expense of other sustainability goals. 科学确实告诉我们的是：主流的常规农业体系虽提供了不断增长的食物及其他产品供给，却往往以牺牲其他可持续目标为代价。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 原文说常规农业"现在已在牺牲可持续目标"，选项 It will not be able to meet global food demand 却预言"未来无法满足全球粮食需求"，未来式预言+绝对否定均超出原文。 B) ✓ 正确 at the expense of other sustainability goals ↔ It is not conducive to sustainable development but often at the expense of other sustainability goals ↔ It is not conducive to sustainable development 预判要求表达"常规农业不利于可持续发展"，It is not conducive to sustainable development 是这一判断的标准同义改写，与定位句转折后的部分一一对应。 C) 无中生有 选项 It will eventually give away to organic farming 说常规农业"终将让位于有机农业"，文中无此预测；作者立场是"应同时考虑有机潜力"，并未断言谁取代谁。 D) 答非所问 原文用 mainstream 是为引出对常规农业的批评，选项 It is going mainstream throughout the world 却把它处理为"正在全球范围流行"，并丢掉了 but 转折后的批评内核——属答非所问。
records.keyword_relation: at the expense of other sustainability goals ↔ It is not conducive to sustainable development；but often at the expense of other sustainability goals ↔ It is not conducive to sustainable development

records.stem: Why does the author think higher prices of organic farm produce are justifiable?

options.text: They give farmers going organic a big competitive edge.
They motivate farmers to upgrade farming technology.
Organic farming costs more than conventional farming.
Organic farming does long-term good to the ecosystem.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 Why does the author think higher prices of organic farm produce are justifiable? 是 Why 提问且作者已明确写出理由，属直接细节题，不需要跨段推断。
【拆句】 题干 Why does the author think higher prices of organic farm produce are justifiable? 是 Why 引导的疑问句，含一个嵌套宾语从句 higher prices...are justifiable；理解时还原为"作者为什么认为...是合理的"。
【定位】 P9 Higher prices, called price premiums, can be justified as a way to compensate farmers for providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs. 更高的价格——称为"价格溢价"——可以被合理化解释为一种对农民的补偿，是因为他们提供了生态系统服务、避免了环境损害或外部成本。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文谈的是高价对生态贡献的补偿合理性，选项 They give farmers going organic a big competitive edge 把它换成"给做有机的农民带来巨大竞争优势"——竞争话语不是文中评价高价的角度，属偷换。 B) 无中生有 选项 They motivate farmers to upgrade farming technology 谈"高价激励农民升级技术"，文中既未把 motivate 与 higher prices 挂钩，也未提"升级技术"，属凭空生造。 C) 偷换概念 原文给出的合理化依据是"补偿生态服务+避免环境损害"，选项 Organic farming costs more than conventional farming 改为"有机生产成本比常规高"——文中并未把高价归因于生产成本对比，属偷换。 D) ✓ 正确 providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs ↔ Organic farming does long-term good to the ecosystem can be justified as a way to compensate farmers ↔ Organic farming does long-term good to the ecosystem 预判要求表达"有机农业长期上对生态有益"，Organic farming does long-term good to the ecosystem 把原文中"提供生态服务+避免环境损害"合并为"做长期好事"，与定位句因果同向。
records.keyword_relation: providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs ↔ Organic farming does long-term good to the ecosystem；can be justified as a way to compensate farmers ↔ Organic farming does long-term good to the ecosystem

evidence.text: Higher prices, called price premiums, can be justified as a way to compensate farmers for providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：原文谈的是高价对生态贡献的补偿合理性，选项 They give farmers going organic a big competitive edge 把它换成"给做有机的农民带来巨大竞争优势"——竞争话语不是文中评价高价的角度，属偷换。
distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：选项 They motivate farmers to upgrade farming technology 谈"高价激励农民升级技术"，文中既未把 motivate 与 higher prices 挂钩，也未提"升级技术"，属凭空生造。
distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：原文给出的合理化依据是"补偿生态服务+避免环境损害"，选项 Organic farming costs more than conventional farming 改为"有机生产成本比常规高"——文中并未把高价归因于生产成本对比，属偷换。

records.stem: Why are some researchers irritated at the USDA's 2016-2020 Dietary Guidelines?

options.text: It ignores the harmful effect of red meat and processed food on health.
Too much emphasis is given to eating less meat and buying local food.
The dietary recommendations are not based on medical science.
It takes no notice of the potential impact on the environment.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 Why are some researchers irritated at the USDA's 2016-2020 Dietary Guidelines? 问的是一个具体且可在原文找到一句话承载的原因，不涉及推断。
【拆句】 主干是 Why are some researchers irritated，介词短语 at the USDA's 2016-2020 Dietary Guidelines 交代被激怒的对象。be irritated at 是固定搭配，相当于「对……感到恼火」，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 But the best available science also has a lot to say about what those food choices do to the environment, and some researchers are annoyed that new dietary recommendations of the USDA (United States Department of Agriculture) released yesterday seem to utterly ignore that fact. 但同样基于最佳科学，我们对食物选择会对环境造成什么影响其实大有可谈，一些研究者对昨天发布的 USDA 新版饮食建议似乎对这一事实完全视而不见感到恼火。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 It ignores the harmful effect of red meat and processed food on health. 把第 4、5 段才出现的「红肉/加工肉对健康有害」嫁接到第 51 题，作「研究者发怒原因」，属张冠李戴。 B) 与原文相反 Too much emphasis is given to eating less meat and buying local food. 说指南「过度强调少吃肉、买本地食材」，但原文是 Nelson 抱怨这两件事 aren't in the final product，即指南没纳入这两条，方向恰好相反。 C) 与原文相反 The dietary recommendations are not based on medical science. 说指南「不基于医学科学」，但原文明确 It's all based on the best available science for leading a healthy life，指南正是建立在最佳科学之上的。 D) ✓ 正确 seem to utterly ignore ↔ takes no notice of what those food choices do to the environment ↔ the potential impact on the environment 预判「忽视环境影响」与 It takes no notice of the potential impact on the environment. 在主体与极性上完全一致，D 即定位句的标准同义改写。

evidence.text: But the best available science also has a lot to say about what those food choices do to the environment, and some researchers are annoyed that new dietary recommendations of the USDA (United States Department of Agriculture) released yesterday seem to utterly ignore that fact

records.stem: Why does the author say the USDA could have contributed a lot to lowering the climate cost through its dietary guidelines?

options.text: It has the capacity and the financial resources to do so.
Its researchers have already submitted relevant proposals.
Its agencies in charge of drafting the guidelines have the expertise.
It can raise students' environmental awareness through its programs.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 Why does the author say 问的是作者下此判断的依据，对应原文必然有一句明示性的解释。
【拆句】 主干是 Why does the author say the USDA could have contributed a lot，介词短语 to lowering the climate cost 修饰 contributed；through its dietary guidelines 交代凭借的手段。整句直白，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 The government's dietary guidelines could have done a lot to lower that climate cost. Not just because of their position of authority: The guidelines drive billions of dollars of food production through federal programs like school lunches and nutrition assistance for the needy. 政府的饮食指南本可以为降低气候成本做很多。不仅仅因为其权威地位：这些指南通过校园午餐、贫困营养援助等联邦项目，驱动着数十亿美元的食品生产。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 their position of authority ↔ the capacity drive billions of dollars of food production through federal programs ↔ the financial resources 预判的「权威+经费」两要素分别由 the capacity 与 the financial resources 接住，It has the capacity and the financial resources to do so. 是定位句两个并列原因的完整概括。 B) 无中生有 Its researchers have already submitted relevant proposals. 把「已提交相关提案」硬塞进 USDA 的能力来源，但原文没有任何「提案已提交」的信息，第 5 段虽提及科学报告，但那是顾问委员会的报告而非「USDA 的研究者已提交提案」。 C) 答非所问 Its agencies in charge of drafting the guidelines have the expertise. 说起草机构有专业能力，但题干问的是「为何 USDA 本可降低气候成本」，专业能力并非定位句给出的原因——定位句给出的是权威+经费，专业知识只是研究者已存在的事实，不是这一句话给出的本可降低气候成本的资源。 D) 以偏概全 It can raise students' environmental awareness through its programs. 把「通过联邦项目影响食品生产」窄化为「通过校园项目提高学生环保意识」。原文 school lunches 只是例子之一，且其作用是 drive billions of dollars of food production（撬动食品生产），不是提高学生环保意识。
records.keyword_relation: their position of authority ↔ the capacity；drive billions of dollars of food production through federal programs ↔ the financial resources

distractor_explanations.D: 以偏概全：It can raise students' environmental awareness through its programs. 把「通过联邦项目影响食品生产」窄化为「通过校园项目提高学生环保意识」。原文 school lunches 只是例子之一，且其作用是 drive billions of dollars of food production（撬动食品生产），不是提高学生环保意识。

records.stem: What do we learn from the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report?

options.text: Food is easily contaminated from farm to belly.
Greenhouse effect is an issue still under debate.
Modern agriculture has increased food diversity.
Farming consumes most of our natural resources.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What do we learn from the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report? 问的是该报告披露了什么事实，对应原文必有直陈句，无需推断。
【拆句】 What do we learn from the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report?：主干为 What do we learn from X，X 是一长串名词所有格嵌套：Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee 修饰 scientific report；理解时拆为「那份委员会出的科学报告」即可。
【定位】 P4 Food production is the largest user of fresh water, largest contributor to the loss of biodiversity, and a major contributor to using up natural resources. 食品生产是最大的淡水使用者、最大的生物多样性损失贡献者，也是使用自然资源的主要贡献者之一。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Food is easily contaminated from farm to belly. 说「从农场到餐桌易受污染」，但原文从未提及食品污染，只是讨论了 fuel burned in transportation, processing, refrigeration 即「运输、加工、冷藏的燃料」，属无中生有。 B) 无中生有 Greenhouse effect is an issue still under debate. 说温室效应「仍存在争议」，但原文用陈述句把 plant and animal agriculture contributes 9 percent of all the country's greenhouse gas emissions 作为既定事实，不存在「争议」层面的讨论。 C) 与原文相反 Modern agriculture has increased food diversity. 说现代农业「提高了食物多样性」，但原文明言食品生产是 largest contributor to the loss of biodiversity——是生物多样性最大损失者，方向恰好相反。 D) ✓ 正确 Food production is the largest user of fresh water ↔ Farming consumes most of our natural resources. largest contributor to using up natural resources ↔ most of our natural resources 选项 D 是定位句「农业是最大的淡水用户/生物多样性损失贡献者/自然资源耗用者」事实清单的标准上位概括，未越界、未偏题。
records.keyword_relation: Food production is the largest user of fresh water ↔ Farming consumes most of our natural resources.；largest contributor to using up natural resources ↔ most of our natural resources

evidence.text: Food production is the largest user of fresh water, largest contributor to the loss of biodiversity, and a major contributor to using up natural resources

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：Food is easily contaminated from farm to belly. 说「从农场到餐桌易受污染」，但原文从未提及食品污染，只是讨论了 fuel burned in transportation, processing, refrigeration 即「运输、加工、冷藏的燃料」，属无中生有。
distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：Greenhouse effect is an issue still under debate. 说温室效应「仍存在争议」，但原文用陈述句把 plant and animal agriculture contributes 9 percent of all the country's greenhouse gas emissions 作为既定事实，不存在「争议」层面的讨论。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：Modern agriculture has increased food diversity. 说现代农业「提高了食物多样性」，但原文明言食品生产是 largest contributor to the loss of biodiversity——是生物多样性最大损失者，方向恰好相反。

records.stem: What may account for the neglect of sustainability in the USDA's Dietary Guidelines according to the author?

options.text: Its exclusive concern with Americans' food safety.
Its sole responsibility for providing dietary advice.
Its close ties with the agriculture companies.
Its alleged failure to regulate the industries.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 account for 等于「解释、说明……的原因」，问的是一个已被点明的原因，是细节而非推断。
【拆句】 主干是 What may account for the neglect of sustainability，介词短语 in the USDA's Dietary Guidelines 限定 neglect 的发生场所，according to the author 限定信息源；情态动词 may 表「可能」，对应原文里 Possibly 一类的揣测语气。
【定位】 P7 Possibly the agencies in charge of drafting the decisions are too close to the industries they are supposed to regulate. On one hand, the USDA is compiling dietary advice. On the other, their clients are US agriculture companies. 可能起草决策的机构与它们本应监管的行业走得太近。一方面，USDA 在编制饮食建议；另一方面，它们的客户就是美国农业公司。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 Its exclusive concern with Americans' food safety. 把「指南范畴」偷换为「专注食品安全」，但原文 sustainability falls too far outside the guidelines' official scope 给出的范畴是「营养与饮食」（nutritional and dietary information），不是「食品安全」，且这是 USDA 的官方说法，而非作者认同的原因。 B) 偷换概念 Its sole responsibility for providing dietary advice. 借用 nutritional and dietary information 的措辞，但这是 USDA 官方为不谈可持续性找的借口，不是作者揣测的真原因；题干已锁定 according to the author。 C) ✓ 正确 too close to the industries ↔ close ties with the agriculture companies their clients are US agriculture companies ↔ the agriculture companies 选项 Its close ties with the agriculture companies. 是定位句揣测原因的标准名词化复述，覆盖了「USDA 与农业公司关系太近」这一核心，与作者意图完全吻合。 D) 过度推断 Its alleged failure to regulate the industries. 把原文「应监管却走得太近」推到「未能监管」的结论。原文只说关系太近、有潜在利益冲突，并未断言「已失败地未能监管」。
records.keyword_relation: too close to the industries ↔ close ties with the agriculture companies；their clients are US agriculture companies ↔ the agriculture companies

evidence.text: Possibly the agencies in charge of drafting the decisions are too close to the industries they are supposed to regulate. On one hand, the USDA is compiling dietary advice. On the other, their clients are US agriculture companies

records.stem: What should the USDA do to achieve food security according to David Wallinga?

options.text: Give top priority to things like nutrition and food security.
Endeavor to ensure the sustainable development of agriculture.
Fulfill its mission by closely cooperating with the industries.
Study the long-term impact of climate change on food production.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What should the USDA do to achieve food security according to David Wallinga? 问 Wallinga 提的具体建议，对应原文 Wallinga 的引语必有直陈，无需推断。
【拆句】 主干是 What should the USDA do，to achieve food security 为目的状语，according to David Wallinga 限定信息源。should 表「应该做什么」，提示答案是建议性陈述。
【定位】 P8 In previous guidelines, they've always been concerned with things like food security—which is presumably the mission of the USDA. You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability if you want secure food in the future. 在以往的指南中，他们一直关心食品安全这类问题——而食品安全大概也是 USDA 的使命。如果你希望未来有安全的食品，就必须切实地关心气候影响与未来的可持续性。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 Give top priority to things like nutrition and food security. 把 things like food security 和上文 nutrition 拼凑成「优先级最高」，但 Wallinga 并未说「以食品安全为最高优先级」，而是说「要想拿到食品安全这一结果，必须做可持续性」——重点是手段（可持续）而非把「食品安全/营养」当目标排序。 B) ✓ 正确 You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability ↔ Endeavor to ensure the sustainable development of agriculture. if you want secure food in the future ↔ to achieve food security 选项 Endeavor to ensure the sustainable development of agriculture. 把 Wallinga 引语后半句的条件因果（要想 X→必做 Y）翻译为目的+行动（为 X 而做 Y），与预判完全一致。 C) 与原文相反 Fulfill its mission by closely cooperating with the industries. 主张「通过密切配合产业来履行使命」，但作者第 7 段已批评 USDA 与农业公司 too close to the industries 是问题所在；Wallinga 的话也未提议进一步靠近产业，恰是反方向。 D) 过度推断 Study the long-term impact of climate change on food production. 把 Wallinga 的「关注气候影响与可持续性」推到「研究气候变化的长期影响」。原文要求是「关注+采取行动」，并非「研究学术问题」，且 study 这种行动属于学术后撤，未对接 Wallinga 的呼吁。
records.keyword_relation: You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability ↔ Endeavor to ensure the sustainable development of agriculture.；if you want secure food in the future ↔ to achieve food security

evidence.text: In previous guidelines, they've always been concerned with things like food security—which is presumably the mission of the USDA. You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability if you want secure food in the future

distractor_explanations.A: 答非所问：Give top priority to things like nutrition and food security. 把 things like food security 和上文 nutrition 拼凑成「优先级最高」，但 Wallinga 并未说「以食品安全为最高优先级」，而是说「要想拿到食品安全这一结果，必须做可持续性」——重点是手段（可持续）而非把「食品安全/营养」当目标排序。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：Fulfill its mission by closely cooperating with the industries. 主张「通过密切配合产业来履行使命」，但作者第 7 段已批评 USDA 与农业公司 too close to the industries 是问题所在；Wallinga 的话也未提议进一步靠近产业，恰是反方向。
distractor_explanations.D: 过度推断：Study the long-term impact of climate change on food production. 把 Wallinga 的「关注气候影响与可持续性」推到「研究气候变化的长期影响」。原文要求是「关注+采取行动」，并非「研究学术问题」，且 study 这种行动属于学术后撤，未对接 Wallinga 的呼吁。

records.stem: What do we learn from the passage about food consumption in India?

options.text: People's diet will not change due to the EAT-Lancet report.
Many people simply do not have access to foods they prefer.
There is a growing popularity of a cereal-heavy vegetarian diet.
Policymakers help remove the barriers to people's choice of food.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn from the passage about food consumption in India 问的是文章关于某话题告诉了我们什么事实，没有 infer 或 imply。
【拆句】 Q48 主干 What do we learn from the passage；about food consumption in India 是话题限定语，结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】 P4 In India, however, there is a vast difference between what people would wish to consume and what they have to consume because of innumerable barriers around class, religion, culture, cost, geography, etc. 然而在印度，人们想要消费的与不得不消费的之间存在巨大差异，原因是阶级、宗教、文化、成本、地理等数不清的障碍。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 People's diet will not change due to the EAT-Lancet report 谈饮食不会因 EAT 报告而改变。原文 P4 谈的是印度人想吃和能吃的差距，并未对是否会因报告改变作出预言；P2 反而暗示该报告会带来负面影响。 B) ✓ 正确 there is a vast difference between what people would wish to consume and what they have to consume ↔ Many people simply do not have access to foods they prefer because of innumerable barriers around class, religion, culture, cost, geography, etc ↔ Many people simply do not have access to foods they prefer 预判得到的想吃的不等于能吃的，等于 do not have access to foods they prefer，完全对齐。 C) 偷换概念 growing popularity of a cereal-heavy vegetarian diet 谈以谷物为主的素食日益流行。原文 Policymakers in India have traditionally pushed for a cereal-heavy 说的是政策制定者『推行』，是自上而下，不是日益流行；growing popularity 把行为主体从政策制定者偷换为民众自发追捧。 D) 与原文相反 Policymakers help remove the barriers to people's choice of food 谈决策者帮人民扫除饮食选择的障碍。原文 P4 的决策者是在吃肉人群上强推素食——是在制造或加固障碍，而非帮人扫除；方向完全反转。
records.keyword_relation: there is a vast difference between what people would wish to consume and what they have to consume ↔ Many people simply do not have access to foods they prefer；because of innumerable barriers around class, religion, culture, cost, geography, etc ↔ Many people simply do not have access to foods they prefer

evidence.text: In India, however, there is a vast difference between what people would wish to consume and what they have to consume because of innumerable barriers around class, religion, culture, cost, geography, etc

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：People's diet will not change due to the EAT-Lancet report 谈饮食不会因 EAT 报告而改变。原文 P4 谈的是印度人想吃和能吃的差距，并未对是否会因报告改变作出预言；P2 反而暗示该报告会带来负面影响。
distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：growing popularity of a cereal-heavy vegetarian diet 谈以谷物为主的素食日益流行。原文 Policymakers in India have traditionally pushed for a cereal-heavy 说的是政策制定者『推行』，是自上而下，不是日益流行；growing popularity 把行为主体从政策制定者偷换为民众自发追捧。
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：Policymakers help remove the barriers to people's choice of food 谈决策者帮人民扫除饮食选择的障碍。原文 P4 的决策者是在吃肉人群上强推素食——是在制造或加固障碍，而非帮人扫除；方向完全反转。

records.stem: What does the passage say about a plant-based diet modeled on India?

options.text: It may benefit populations whose traditional diet is meat-based.
It may be another blow to the economy in developing countries.
It may help narrow the gap between the rich and poor countries.
It may worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What does the passage say about a plant-based diet modeled on India 用 say about 问文章对某概念明说了什么，按细节题处理。
【拆句】 Q49 主干 What does the passage say；about a plant-based diet modeled on India 是话题限定语，过去分词短语 modeled on India 后置修饰 diet。无陷阱。
【定位】 P8 Which is why calls for a plant-based diet modeled on India risk offering another whip with which to beat already vulnerable communities in developing countries. 这正是为什么以印度为模板的植物基饮食呼声有可能成为又一根抽打发展中国家本已脆弱社群的鞭子。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 benefit populations whose traditional diet is meat-based 说惠及以肉食为主的人群，原文 P8 和 P9 明确这是对弱势人群的伤害，方向相反；六级常借 benefit 这种正向动词制造极性反转。 B) 偷换概念 another blow to the economy in developing countries 把打击对象从弱势社群（营养、民生）偷换成经济。原文 P8 beat 的是 vulnerable communities，不是 economy；P11 末尾的 economic cost 也不是本题定位段的论点。 C) 无中生有 narrow the gap between the rich and poor countries 谈缩小贫富国差距，原文 P8、P9 全程批评该饮食对发展中国家的伤害，从未谈缩小贫富差距，是空降话题。 D) ✓ 正确 another whip with which to beat already vulnerable communities in developing countries ↔ worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries undernourished children are known to benefit from the consumption of milk and other animal source foods ↔ worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries 预判得到的加重弱势国家营养不良，等于 worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries，完全对齐。
records.keyword_relation: another whip with which to beat already vulnerable communities in developing countries ↔ worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries；undernourished children are known to benefit from the consumption of milk and other animal source foods ↔ worsen the nourishment problem in low-income countries

evidence.text: Which is why calls for a plant-based diet modeled on India risk offering another whip with which to beat already vulnerable communities in developing countries

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：benefit populations whose traditional diet is meat-based 说惠及以肉食为主的人群，原文 P8 和 P9 明确这是对弱势人群的伤害，方向相反；六级常借 benefit 这种正向动词制造极性反转。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：another blow to the economy in developing countries 把打击对象从弱势社群（营养、民生）偷换成经济。原文 P8 beat 的是 vulnerable communities，不是 economy；P11 末尾的 economic cost 也不是本题定位段的论点。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：narrow the gap between the rich and poor countries 谈缩小贫富国差距，原文 P8、P9 全程批评该饮食对发展中国家的伤害，从未谈缩小贫富差距，是空降话题。

records.stem: How does the Indian government respond to the EAT-Lancet Commission's proposals?

options.text: It accepts them at the expense of the long-term interests of its people.
It intends them to spark conversations among all Indian stakeholders.
It gives them approval regardless of opposition from nutrition experts.
It welcomes them as a tool to address chronic hunger and malnutrition.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 How does the Indian government respond to the EAT-Lancet Commission's proposals 问政府如何回应，回应在文中有明示，是细节题而非主观态度题。
【拆句】 Q50 主干 How does the Indian government respond；to the EAT-Lancet Commission's proposals 是 respond 的介宾搭配。结构平铺直叙。
【定位】 P11 The government, however, seems to have given the report a thumbs-up. Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition through an improved access to wholesome and nutrient-dense foods, the government is opening the door for company-dependent solutions, ignoring the environmental and economic cost, which will destroy local food systems. It's a model full of danger for future generations. 然而，政府似乎对该报告点了赞。它不去通过改善人们获取健康、营养密度高的食物来解决慢性饥饿和营养不良，反而为公司依赖型方案敞开大门，忽视环境和经济代价，而这会摧毁本地食物体系。这是一个对未来世代充满危险的模式。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 given the report a thumbs-up ↔ It accepts them Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition through an improved access to wholesome and nutrient-dense foods, the government is opening the door for company-dependent solutions, ignoring the environmental and economic cost, which will destroy local food systems ↔ at the expense of the long-term interests of its people 预判得到的接受但牺牲长远利益，等于 It accepts them at the expense of the long-term interests of its people，完全对齐。 B) 张冠李戴 intends them to spark conversations 把 EAT-Lancet claimed its intention was to 的主语（EAT 委员会）安到政府头上；spark conversations 的发出者不是 Indian government。 C) 无中生有 regardless of opposition from nutrition experts 谈不顾营养专家的反对。原文 P10 提到的是被排除在外的 vocal critics of the food processing industry and food fortification strategies 和 India's farmers，并未明确说营养专家反对，且更没有说政府是不顾这些反对而通过。 D) 与原文相反 welcomes them as a tool to address chronic hunger and malnutrition 把报告说成解决饥饿与营养不良的工具，但原文 Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition 明确指出政府正是没有用它来解决这些问题；方向反转。
records.keyword_relation: given the report a thumbs-up ↔ It accepts them；Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition through an improved access to wholesome and nutrient-dense foods, the government is opening the door for company-dependent solutions, ignoring the environmental and economic cost, which will destroy local food systems ↔ at the expense of the long-term interests of its people

evidence.text: The government, however, seems to have given the report a thumbs-up. Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition through an improved access to wholesome and nutrient-dense foods, the government is opening the door for company-dependent solutions, ignoring the environmental and economic cost, which will destroy local food systems. It's a model full of danger for future generations

distractor_explanations.B: 张冠李戴：intends them to spark conversations 把 EAT-Lancet claimed its intention was to 的主语（EAT 委员会）安到政府头上；spark conversations 的发出者不是 Indian government。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：regardless of opposition from nutrition experts 谈不顾营养专家的反对。原文 P10 提到的是被排除在外的 vocal critics of the food processing industry and food fortification strategies 和 India's farmers，并未明确说营养专家反对，且更没有说政府是不顾这些反对而通过。
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：welcomes them as a tool to address chronic hunger and malnutrition 把报告说成解决饥饿与营养不良的工具，但原文 Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition 明确指出政府正是没有用它来解决这些问题；方向反转。

records.stem: What is characteristic of a chronic complainer, according to psychiatrist Eric Berne?

options.text: They only feel angry about their ill treatment and resent whoever tries to help.
They are chronically unhappy and ceaselessly find fault with people around them.
They constantly dismiss others' proposals while taking no responsibility for tackling the problem.
They lack the knowledge and basic skills required for successful conversations with their interlocutors.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What is characteristic of a chronic complainer, according to psychiatrist Eric Berne? 直接问某人观点下的某对象的特征，答案应当在原文里有逐字或同义对应。
【拆句】 题干是一个 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 What is characteristic of a chronic complainer 中 characteristic 作表语形容词，意思是"……所特有的"；尾部 according to psychiatrist Eric Berne 是状语，限定"按照谁的说法"，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 The reason, of course, is that on some level they don't want a solution; they want to be validated in their position that the world is out to get them. If they can "win" the game—dismissing every suggestion until their interlocutor gives up in annoyance—they get to feel pleasurably righteous in their resentments and excused from any obligation to change. 原因当然是，在某种程度上他们并不想要解决方案；他们想要的是自己"世界与我作对"的立场被认可。如果他们能"赢"——通过驳回每一个建议直到对话者厌烦放弃——他们就能在怨恨中感到正当的快感，并被免除任何改变的责任。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 原文只说对话者最终 gives up in annoyance（厌烦放弃），并未说抱怨者对帮忙的人怀有怨恨；resent whoever tries to help 是无根据的扩展。 B) 偷换概念 原文中的抱怨指向情境本身（their relationship, job, or other situation），不是"挑周围人毛病"；ceaselessly find fault with people around them 把抱怨对象从"处境"偷换成了"周围人"。 C) ✓ 正确 dismissing every suggestion ↔ constantly dismiss others' proposals excused from any obligation to change ↔ taking no responsibility for tackling the problem 预判要求同时含"驳回建议"与"不愿担责"两个语义；只有 They constantly dismiss others' proposals while taking no responsibility for tackling the problem. 完整覆盖了这两个语义。 D) 无中生有 原文没有任何处提到抱怨者缺乏对话的知识或技能；他们驳回建议是不愿改变，不是不会对话。lack the knowledge and basic skills 在原文找不到出处。
records.keyword_relation: dismissing every suggestion ↔ constantly dismiss others' proposals；excused from any obligation to change ↔ taking no responsibility for tackling the problem

evidence.text: The reason, of course, is that on some level they don't want a solution; they want to be validated in their position that the world is out to get them. If they can "win" the game—dismissing every suggestion until their interlocutor(对话者) gives up in annoyance—they get to feel pleasurably righteous(正当的) in their resentments and excused from any obligation to change

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：原文只说对话者最终 gives up in annoyance（厌烦放弃），并未说抱怨者对帮忙的人怀有怨恨；resent whoever tries to help 是无根据的扩展。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：原文中的抱怨指向情境本身（their relationship, job, or other situation），不是"挑周围人毛病"；ceaselessly find fault with people around them 把抱怨对象从"处境"偷换成了"周围人"。
distractor_explanations.D: 无中生有：原文没有任何处提到抱怨者缺乏对话的知识或技能；他们驳回建议是不愿改变，不是不会对话。lack the knowledge and basic skills 在原文找不到出处。

records.stem: What does the author try to illustrate with the example of the newborn on one's doorstep?

options.text: People tend to think that one should not be held responsible for others' mistakes.
It is easy to become attached to the position of overlooking one's own fault.
People are often at a loss when confronted with a number of choices.
A distinction should be drawn between responsibility and fault.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （例证目的题）
【判型】 What does the author try to illustrate with the example of the newborn on one's doorstep? 明确询问"作者用某例子要说明什么"，是典型例证目的题特征。
【拆句】 题干主干 What does the author try to illustrate，with 引出方式状语 with the example of the newborn on one's doorstep，介词 of 后接同位语说明例子内容；句子结构清晰，无从句陷阱。
【定位】 P2 For example, if I were to discover a newborn at my front door, it wouldn't be my fault, but it most certainly would be my responsibility. 举例来说，如果我在门口发现一个新生儿，这不会是我的过错，但毫无疑问会是我的责任。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文例子说的是"事情不是你的错"（自己没造成），并非"别人犯了错"；not be held responsible for others' mistakes 把 fault 错绑到"他人"身上。 B) 偷换概念 原文谈的是"易倾向于以'非我之责'为由不作为"，并非"忽视自身过错"；B 把 attached to the position 的内容偷换为 overlooking one's own fault。 C) 以偏概全 原文提到 There would be choices to make 只是顺带说明"必须选择、无法回避"，并不是说"人面对多重选择会不知所措"；C 抓住 choices 一个词放大成完全不同的论点。 D) ✓ 正确 it wouldn't be my fault, but it most certainly would be my responsibility ↔ A distinction should be drawn between responsibility and fault. responsibility/fault fallacy ↔ between responsibility and fault 例子要说明的不是"门口婴儿怎么处理"，而是"过错≠责任"这一概念区分；只有 A distinction should be drawn between responsibility and fault. 直接表达了这一区分。
records.keyword_relation: it wouldn't be my fault, but it most certainly would be my responsibility ↔ A distinction should be drawn between responsibility and fault.；responsibility/fault fallacy ↔ between responsibility and fault

evidence.text: For example, if I were to discover a newborn at my front door, it wouldn't be my fault, but it most certainly would be my responsibility

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：原文例子说的是"事情不是你的错"（自己没造成），并非"别人犯了错"；not be held responsible for others' mistakes 把 fault 错绑到"他人"身上。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：原文谈的是"易倾向于以'非我之责'为由不作为"，并非"忽视自身过错"；B 把 attached to the position 的内容偷换为 overlooking one's own fault。
distractor_explanations.C: 以偏概全：原文提到 There would be choices to make 只是顺带说明"必须选择、无法回避"，并不是说"人面对多重选择会不知所措"；C 抓住 choices 一个词放大成完全不同的论点。

records.stem: What does the author advise people to do to chronic complainers?

options.text: Stop them from going further by agreeing with them.
Listen to their complaints ardently and sympathetically.
Ask them to validate their beliefs with further evidence.
Persuade them to clarify the confusion they have caused.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author advise people to do to chronic complainers? 问的是一个具体可操作的动作建议，答案在原文里必有直接出处。
【拆句】 题干 advise sb. to do sth. 的句型变体；advise people to do 是 What 提出的疑问中心，to chronic complainers 是介词短语作动作对象状语，结构直白。
【定位】 P3 Should you find yourself on the receiving end of this kind of complaining, there's an ingenious way to shut it down—which is to agree with it, ardently. 如果你发现自己正承受这种抱怨，有一个巧妙的办法可以让它停下来——那就是热烈地表示同意。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 agree with it, ardently ↔ agreeing with them shut it down ↔ Stop them from going further 预判要求同时含"阻止抱怨"和"通过附和的方式"两层语义；只有 Stop them from going further by agreeing with them. 同时覆盖了这两层。 B) 偷换概念 原文方法是"赞同"，不是"倾听+同情"；Listen to their complaints ardently and sympathetically 把 agree 偷换为 listen，把 ardently 这一描述"赞同强度"的副词错配到"倾听"上。 C) 与原文相反 原文的策略是替对方做 validation（you're confirming them），让他自己听腻；C 反过来要求对方自己 validate，方向与作者建议相反。 D) 张冠李戴 原文没有出现"让抱怨者澄清他们造成的混乱"这一建议；confusion 一词来自 P2 But there's a confusion here，指作者自己点出的概念混淆，不是抱怨者制造的。
records.keyword_relation: agree with it, ardently ↔ agreeing with them；shut it down ↔ Stop them from going further

evidence.text: Should you find yourself on the receiving end of this kind of complaining, there's an ingenious way to shut it down—which is to agree with it, ardently

distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：原文方法是"赞同"，不是"倾听+同情"；Listen to their complaints ardently and sympathetically 把 agree 偷换为 listen，把 ardently 这一描述"赞同强度"的副词错配到"倾听"上。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：原文的策略是替对方做 validation（you're confirming them），让他自己听腻；C 反过来要求对方自己 validate，方向与作者建议相反。
distractor_explanations.D: 张冠李戴：原文没有出现"让抱怨者澄清他们造成的混乱"这一建议；confusion 一词来自 P2 But there's a confusion here，指作者自己点出的概念混淆，不是抱怨者制造的。

records.stem: What happens when chronic complainers receive over-validation?

options.text: They are motivated to find ingenious ways to persuade their interlocutor.
They are prompted to come up with ideas for making possible changes.
They are stimulated to make more complaints.
They are encouraged to start arguing back.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What happens when chronic complainers receive over-validation? 问的是某条件下出现的具体结果，答案必有原文出处。
【拆句】 题干主句 What happens，when 引导时间状语从句 when chronic complainers receive over-validation，从句主谓宾完整；结构简单。
【定位】 P3 But for another, as Gottlieb notes, people confronted with over-validation often hear their complaints afresh and start arguing back. The notion that they're utterly powerless suddenly seems unrealistic—not to mention rather annoying—so they're prompted instead to generate ideas about how they might change things. 另一方面，正如 Gottlieb 所指出的那样，被过度赞同的人往往会重新听到自己的抱怨并开始反驳。"自己完全无能为力"的念头突然变得不切实际——而且相当令人烦躁——于是他们反而被促使去想出可以怎样改变现状的办法。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 原文 ingenious way 是用来形容"应对抱怨者的方法"（Q53 答案的策略），是 listener 的策略，不是抱怨者自己的动作；A 把 ingenious 嫁接到抱怨者身上，方向错位。 B) ✓ 正确 prompted instead to generate ideas about how they might change things ↔ prompted to come up with ideas for making possible changes prompted instead ↔ prompted 预判要求答案是"想出改变现状的办法"，They are prompted to come up with ideas for making possible changes. 与原文 prompted to generate ideas 几乎逐对应——动词、宾语、目的状语全部对位。 C) 与原文相反 原文恰恰说被过度赞同后"省下了进一步的抱怨"（spared further moaning）；C 反其道而行，方向相反。 D) 以偏概全 原文 start arguing back 确实出现，但它只是因果链的中间步骤；后接 so they're prompted… 才是最终结果。D 截取中间环节作答，属于答非所问/以偏概全。

records.stem: What does the author imply social media may do to our life?

options.text: It may facilitate our interpersonal relationships.
It may filter our negative impressions of others.
It may make us feel isolated and incompetent.
It may render us vulnerable and inauthentic.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （推断题）
【判型】 What does the author imply social media may do to our life 用 imply 提问,要求从原文已有陈述向前迈一步得出结论。
【拆句】 What does the author imply social media may do to our life 是嵌套疑问:主干是 What does the author imply,后面省略了 that 的从句 (that) social media may do to our life,问的是"作者暗示社交媒体可能对我们生活做什么",结构平铺,无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Why does social media trigger feelings of loneliness and inadequacy? Because instead of being real life, it is, for the most part, impression management, a way of marketing yourself, carefully choosing and filtering the pictures and words to put your best face forward. 社交媒体为何会触发孤独感与不胜任感?因为它在很大程度上并不是真实生活,而是一种印象管理,一种自我营销的方式——刻意挑选并过滤图片和文字,以便把自己最好的一面端出来。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 facilitate our interpersonal relationships 说社媒"促进"人际关系,而首段把社媒定性为 impression management,后文一直在警示其负面后果,方向反了。 B) 偷换概念 filter our negative impressions of others 把原文"过滤自己呈现给别人的图文"偷换成"过滤我们对别人的负面印象",filter 的宾语完全错位。 C) ✓ 正确 feelings of loneliness ↔ feel isolated inadequacy ↔ incompetent 预判出的"孤立感+自觉不如人"两点恰好被 feel isolated and incompetent 一对一覆盖,无新增、无遗漏,故锁 C。 D) 偷换概念 render us vulnerable and inauthentic 把原文段二里描述"对网友坦诚会感到不安全/不真实"的状态硬安到"社交媒体对我们生活做了什么"上,主语接受方错配,且 vulnerable 与 inauthentic 在原文是被规避的状态,不是社媒造成的结果。

distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：render us vulnerable and inauthentic 把原文段二里描述"对网友坦诚会感到不安全/不真实"的状态硬安到"社交媒体对我们生活做了什么"上,主语接受方错配,且 vulnerable 与 inauthentic 在原文是被规避的状态,不是社媒造成的结果。

records.stem: What does the author say we humans have been doing to chimps?
records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say we humans have been doing to chimps? 用 What…doing 直接问一个具体行为，不含 infer/imply/main idea 等词，属常规细节题。
【拆句】 What does the author say we humans have been doing to chimps? 是双层嵌套疑问：主干是 What does the author say…？say 后面接的是宾语从句 we humans have been doing to chimps，用现在完成进行时表示“一直在做”，提示动作持续至今。we humans 是同位结构，we 与 humans 同指。
【定位】 P1 That is effectively what humans have been doing to our closest relatives—chimps(大猩猩). 那就是人类一直在对我们最近的亲戚——黑猩猩——所做的事情。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 caused our art to vanish, our music to homogenize, and our technological know-how to disappear ↔ Ruining their culture 预判“破坏黑猩猩的文化”后在四项中找含 culture 与“破坏”语义的选项，只有 Ruining their culture 同时满足两点，锁定 A。 B) 无中生有 原文谈的是文化的消亡而非物种的灭绝（extinction），首段没有任何 extinction/extinct 的措辞，Accelerating their extinction 属凭印象自造。 C) 偷换概念 原文是以“外星人对人类”类比“人类对黑猩猩”，并非说我们把黑猩猩当外星物种对待；Treating them as alien species 把比喻的本体与喻体倒置。 D) 偷换概念 原文中 homogenize 修饰的是 music（音乐），且是外星人对人类做的比喻内容；选项把它直接搬到“黑猩猩的生活习性”上，搭配错误且对象错位。

records.stem: What is the finding of Andrew Whiten's team?

options.text: Chimps demonstrate highly developed skills of communication.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What is the finding of Andrew Whiten's team? 直接问“某团队的发现是什么”，是对原文具体研究结论的客观提问，无推断词。
【拆句】 句式简单：主系表结构。What 作表语，主语 the finding 由 of 短语修饰；无从句、无否定，平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 Back in 1999, a team of scientists led by Andrew Whiten showed that chimps from different parts of Africa behave very differently from one another. 早在 1999 年，由 Andrew Whiten 领导的一个科学家团队就证明：来自非洲不同地区的黑猩猩，行为方式彼此差异显著。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 原文只说不同群体方式不同，没有评价它们的交流技能“高度发达”；highly developed skills of communication 是程度词擅自拔高。 B) 过度推断 原文只举了敲树枝、撕树叶两种方式，并未称这是“肢体语言”，更未说“重度依赖”；rely heavily upon their body language 是凭印象生造的论断。 C) 与原文相反 本段说的是黑猩猩群体内部行为有别，没有说黑猩猩与人类的行为相似；behave in ways quite similar to those of human beings 把研究结论反向编造。 D) ✓ 正确 chimps from different parts of Africa behave very differently from one another ↔ Different chimp groups differ in their way of communication Some groups would get each other's attention by rapping branches with their knuckles(指关节), while others did it by loudly ripping leaves with their teeth ↔ Different chimp groups differ in their way of communication 预判“不同地区的黑猩猩行为方式不同”后，四项里同时含“差异”与“交流/沟通”要素的只有 Different chimp groups differ in their way of communication，且有原文两处例证支撑，锁定 D。

records.stem: What does Cat Hobaiter think we should do for chimp conservation?

options.text: Try to understand our sister species' behavior in the wild.
Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community.
Study the unique characteristics of each generation of chimps.
Endeavor to restore chimp habitats to expand its total population.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What does Cat Hobaiter think we should do for chimp conservation? 问某专家的具体主张，原文有其直接引语，可一一对应，是细节题而非推断题。
【拆句】 主干 What does Cat Hobaiter think + 宾语从句 we should do…；for chimp conservation 是目的状语；think 后省略 that。
【定位】 P6 "Sometimes in the rush to conserve the species, I think we forget about the individuals," says Cat Hobaiter, a professor at the University of St. Andrews. "Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique. An event might only have a small impact on the total population of chimps, but it may wipe out an entire community—an entire culture. No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture." “在急于保育物种的时候，我们有时忘了个体，”圣安德鲁斯大学教授 Cat Hobaiter 说，“每个种群、每个社群，甚至每一代黑猩猩都是独特的。一件事情对黑猩猩总数的影响可能很小，却可能抹掉一整个社群——一整套文化。不管我们怎样恢复栖息地、支持种群增长，那种文化我们也许永远无法再造。”
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 Try to understand our sister species' behavior in the wild 与原文 we are truly getting to know our primate(灵长类) cousins 才对得上，是 Whiten 第 5 段的感慨，与 Hobaiter 立场无关。 B) ✓ 正确 I think we forget about the individuals ↔ Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique ↔ Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community 预判“按社群/个体单位保护”后，四项中只有 Make efforts to preserve each individual chimp community 准确体现 Hobaiter“不要遗忘个体/社群”的立场，锁定 B。 C) 偷换概念 原文 Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique 是说明每一代都独特、需要被保护，而非要求“研究每一代的独特特征”；Study the unique characteristics of each generation of chimps 把保护诉求歪成研究任务。 D) 与原文相反 原文 No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture 是说即便恢复栖息地、扩大种群也救不回那种文化——这是 Hobaiter 强调不足以解决问题的反例。Endeavor to restore chimp habitats to expand its total population 反而把它当作她的主张。

records.stem: What does the author suggest conservationists do?

options.text: Focus entirely on culturally-based entities rather than genetically-based ones.
Place more stress on animal traditions than on their physical conservation.
Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way.
Explore the cultures of species before they vanish.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author suggest conservationists do? 询问作者明示建议，原文末段有直白的论断句，是细节题而非主旨题。
【拆句】 主干 What does the author suggest + 宾语从句 conservationists do（do 后省略 do 的宾语，由 What 提到句首充当）；suggest 后省略 that 与 should，是英式建议句的常见省略形式。
【定位】 P8 Obviously, conservationists need to think about saving species in a completely new way—by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes. 显然，保育工作者需要以一种全新的方式去思考物种保育——既要保护动物的身体与基因，也要保护它们的传统。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 原文是 traditions as well as bodies and genes（“而且也要”），强调兼顾；Focus entirely on culturally-based entities rather than genetically-based ones 用 entirely 与 rather than 把作者立场改为“只保文化、不保基因”，方向反了。 B) 过度推断 原文用 as well as 表并列、不分主次；Place more stress on animal traditions than on their physical conservation 用 more…than 给传统加权，引入原文没有的优先级判断。 C) ✓ 正确 saving species in a completely new way ↔ Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes ↔ Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way 预判“以全新方式且兼顾两面”后，四项中只有 Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way 同时具备“novel”（新）与“all-round”（兼顾），锁定 C。 D) 答非所问 原文末段建议是“以全新方式保育”，不是“去探索文化”；Explore the cultures of species before they vanish 把 Whiten 第 5 段的感叹与作者建议混为一谈。
records.keyword_relation: saving species in a completely new way ↔ Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way；by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes ↔ Conserve animal species in a novel and all-round way

records.stem: What did a recent research paper claim?

options.text: The type of school students attend makes a difference to their future.
Genetic differences between students are far greater than supposed.
The advantages of selective schools are too obvious to ignore.
Students' academic performance is determined by their genes.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What did a recent research paper claim? 直接索取一项可在原文找到对应陈述的事实信息，没有 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。
【拆句】 主干 a recent research paper claim，是 What 作宾语前置的一般疑问句，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 This is down to "hereditarian"(遗传论的) science and a recent paper claimed "differences in exam performance between pupils attending selective and non-selective schools mirror the genetic differences between them". 这要归因于「遗传论」科学，一份最近的论文声称「选拔型学校与非选拔型学校学生之间的考试成绩差异，反映的是他们之间的基因差异」。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 The type of school students attend makes a difference to their future. 把论文的主张换成「学校类型影响前途」，而原文恰恰是说差距并非源于学校类型而是源于基因。 B) 无中生有 Genetic differences between students are far greater than supposed. 称「基因差异比想象中大得多」，但 P2 只谈差异是否反映基因，并未给出基因差异程度的比较。 C) 与原文相反 The advantages of selective schools are too obvious to ignore. 说选拔型学校优势明显，可原文恰好指出 the educational benefits of selective schools largely disappear——优势在控制变量后基本消失。 D) ✓ 正确 differences in exam performance ... mirror the genetic differences between them ↔ Students' academic performance is determined by their genes. 预判说「学业表现归因于基因」，Students' academic performance is determined by their genes. 正是这句话的同义换述，且没有添加额外信息，故锁定 D。

distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：Genetic differences between students are far greater than supposed. 称「基因差异比想象中大得多」，但 P2 只谈差异是否反映基因，并未给出基因差异程度的比较。

records.stem: What does the author think of the recent research?
records.explanation:
【答案】 A （态度题）
【判型】 What does the author think of the recent research? 是「作者怎么看」式态度题，答案不在原文事实层，而在作者评价层。
【拆句】 What does the author think of the recent research? 主干 the author think of the recent research，think of 是「对……的看法」，What 提作宾语；句子简单。
【定位】 P2 With such an assertion, the work was predictably greeted by a lot of absurd claims about "genetics determining academic success". What the research revealed was the rather less surprising result: the educational benefits of selective schools largely disappear once pupils' inborn ability and socio-economic background were taken into account. It is a glimpse of the blindingly obvious—and there's nothing to back strongly either a hereditary or environmental argument. 面对这样的论断，这项研究果然引来一大堆关于「基因决定学业成功」的荒唐说法。而研究真正揭示的其实是个相当不令人惊讶的结果：一旦把学生的先天能力和社会经济背景考虑进去，选拔型学校的教育优势就大体不复存在。这只是把显而易见的事再说一遍——对遗传论和环境论都不构成有力支持。

They are keen on changing shabby surroundings.
They add beauty and charm to the world.
They spend most of their lives drawing.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about designers and artists? 问的是我们对这群人的事实性认识。
【拆句】 What do we learn about designers and artists? 主谓宾结构 we learn what about X，关于 X 我们学到了什么，句式平直无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 There are people who don't, obviously, and thank God for that: a world without designers and artists would be a very shabby one indeed. 显然有人没有放弃画画，谢天谢地：没有设计师和艺术家的世界，将会是一个非常单调寒酸的世界。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 They are declining gradually in number. 称他们数量在逐渐减少，但 P3 只说"多数人长大后放弃画画、但有人没放弃"，未提"设计师和艺术家"的数量趋势。 B) 偷换概念 They are keen on changing shabby surroundings. 称他们热衷于改变 shabby 的环境，但原文 shabby 是用来形容"如果没有他们，世界会怎样"，是一个假设性结果，而非他们当下要改变的对象。 C) ✓ 正确 a world without designers and artists would be a very shabby one indeed ↔ They add beauty and charm to the world. 把"没有他们世界会 shabby"还原为"他们让世界不 shabby、即美丽迷人"，正好对应 They add beauty and charm to the world.。 D) 以偏概全 They spend most of their lives drawing. 称他们一生大部分时间都在画画，但 P3 只说他们没有像普通人那样停止画画，并未说他们"一生大部分时间都在画画"。
records.keyword_relation: a world without designers and artists would be a very shabby one indeed ↔ They add beauty and charm to the world.

evidence.text: There are people who don't, obviously, and thank God for that: a world without designers and artists would be a very shabby one indeed

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：They are declining gradually in number. 称他们数量在逐渐减少，但 P3 只说"多数人长大后放弃画画、但有人没放弃"，未提"设计师和艺术家"的数量趋势。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：They are keen on changing shabby surroundings. 称他们热衷于改变 shabby 的环境，但原文 shabby 是用来形容"如果没有他们，世界会怎样"，是一个假设性结果，而非他们当下要改变的对象。
distractor_explanations.D: 以偏概全：They spend most of their lives drawing. 称他们一生大部分时间都在画画，但 P3 只说他们没有像普通人那样停止画画，并未说他们"一生大部分时间都在画画"。

records.stem: What does Professor D. B. Dowd argue in his book?

options.text: Everybody is born with the capacity to draw.
Drawing is a skill that requires special training.
The value of drawing tends to be overestimated.
Drawing should be redefined as a realistic illusion.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does Professor D. B. Dowd argue in his book? 问具体某人在其书中提出的论点，属事实型细节题。
【拆句】 What does Professor D. B. Dowd argue in his book? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，argue 为关键动词，地点状语 in his book 仅作辅助定位，结构平直。
【定位】 P4 In his book, Stick Figures: Drawing as a Human Practice, Professor D. B. Dowd argues that we have misfiled the significance of drawing because we see it as a professional skill instead of a personal capacity. 在《火柴人：作为人类实践的绘画》一书中，D. B. Dowd 教授认为，我们把绘画的意义错误归类了，因为我们把它视为一种专业技能，而非一种个人能力。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 a personal capacity ↔ Everybody is born with the capacity to draw. instead of a personal capacity ↔ Everybody is born with the capacity to draw. 教授的真正主张是 instead of 后的 a personal capacity（个人能力），其语义内核即"人人都具备"——正好对应 Everybody is born with the capacity to draw.。 B) 与原文相反 Drawing is a skill that requires special training. 称绘画是需要专门训练的技能，但 we see it as a professional skill instead of a personal capacity 中"专业技能"恰恰是教授要反对的错误归类，B 选项与教授立场南辕北辙。 C) 与原文相反 The value of drawing tends to be overestimated. 称绘画的价值常被高估，但 we have misfiled the significance of drawing 中教授说的是"被错误归类"而非"被高估"，且全文基调是"绘画的价值被低估"——教授要为绘画正名。 D) 与原文相反 Drawing should be redefined as a realistic illusion. 称绘画应被重新定义为"真实幻象"，但 Rather, drawing should be recategorized as a symbolic tool 明确说应被重新归类为"符号化工具"；而 realistic illusion 是教授要反对的旧定义。
records.keyword_relation: a personal capacity ↔ Everybody is born with the capacity to draw.；instead of a personal capacity ↔ Everybody is born with the capacity to draw.

evidence.text: In his book, Stick Figures: Drawing as a Human Practice, Professor D. B. Dowd argues that we have misfiled the significance of drawing because we see it as a professional skill instead of a personal capacity

distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：Drawing is a skill that requires special training. 称绘画是需要专门训练的技能，但 we see it as a professional skill instead of a personal capacity 中"专业技能"恰恰是教授要反对的错误归类，B 选项与教授立场南辕北辙。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：The value of drawing tends to be overestimated. 称绘画的价值常被高估，但 we have misfiled the significance of drawing 中教授说的是"被错误归类"而非"被高估"，且全文基调是"绘画的价值被低估"——教授要为绘画正名。
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：Drawing should be redefined as a realistic illusion. 称绘画应被重新定义为"真实幻象"，但 Rather, drawing should be recategorized as a symbolic tool 明确说应被重新归类为"符号化工具"；而 realistic illusion 是教授要反对的旧定义。

records.stem: What have some researchers found from one study about doodling?

options.text: It is a must for maintaining a base level of brain activity.
It is the most reliable stimulant to activate the brain.
It can turn something boring into something interesting.
It helps improve concentration and memory.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What have some researchers found from one study about doodling? 问研究人员从一项具体研究中发现了什么，是事实细节。
【拆句】 What have some researchers found from one study about doodling? 主干 researchers have found what，状语 from one study 与 about doodling 双重限定研究对象，句式紧凑无陷阱。
【定位】 P6 Because of this, some believe that doodling during a boring lecture can help students pay attention. In one study, participants were asked to listen to a list of names while either doodling or sitting still. Those who doodled remembered 29 percent more of the names than those who did not. 正因如此，有人认为在乏味的讲座中涂画可以帮助学生集中注意力。在一项研究中，参与者被要求一边听一串名字一边或涂画或静坐。涂画者比不涂画者多记住 29% 的名字。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 It is a must for maintaining a base level of brain activity. 称涂画是维持大脑基线活动的必要条件（a must），但 doodling activates the brain's so-called default circuit 只说涂画"激活"默认回路，并未说它是"必需的"，且默认回路本身就是在缺乏其他刺激时维持基线活动，不依赖涂画。 B) 无中生有 It is the most reliable stimulant to activate the brain. 称涂画是激活大脑最可靠的刺激物，P6 只说"有些研究者认为"涂画能激活默认回路，从未将其与其他刺激物比较或评级。 C) 偷换概念 It can turn something boring into something interesting. 称涂画能化无聊为有趣，但 doodling during a boring lecture can help students pay attention 只说在乏味讲座中涂画能助你专注，并未说讲座因此变有趣——是"帮你听下去"，不是"让它变好玩"。 D) ✓ 正确 can help students pay attention ↔ It helps improve concentration and memory. Those who doodled remembered 29 percent more of the names than those who did not ↔ It helps improve concentration and memory. D 的两个并列成分 concentration / memory 各自由原文两句独立支撑（pay attention / remembered more），实现完整覆盖。
records.keyword_relation: can help students pay attention ↔ It helps improve concentration and memory.；Those who doodled remembered 29 percent more of the names than those who did not ↔ It helps improve concentration and memory.

evidence.text: Because of this, some believe that doodling during a boring lecture can help students pay attention. In one study, participants were asked to listen to a list of names while either doodling or sitting still. Those who doodled remembered 29 percent more of the names than those who did not
