distractor_explanations.D: 张冠李戴：Mainstream economists insist that ... compensation levels reflect the unerring judgment of market forces. 是主流经济学家的判断，且原文中"市场力量的无误判断"是指工资水平的决定方式，不是加薪的依据。

records.stem: What do we learn about things in the real world in America for the past 50 years or so?

options.text: People have failed to see a corresponding increase in wages and in productivity.
People have been disheartened by the widening gap between the haves and have-nots.
People have witnessed a tug of war between Republicans and Democrats over tax cuts.
People have seen the link disappearing between productivity and workers' well-being.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about things in the real world in America for the past 50 years or so? 问我们从原文得知的事实，原文必有对应陈述。
【拆句】 What do we learn about things in the real world in America for the past 50 years or so?——主干是 What do we learn about things，三层介词短语 in the real world/in America/for the past 50 years or so 层层限定 things；六级长题干常用这种层层限定，要逐层抓住主体（things=各种情况）。
【定位】 P12 In the real world, things are more complicated. Wages are influenced by a tug of war between employers and workers, and employers have been winning. One clear piece of evidence is the widening gap between productivity growth and wage growth since roughly 1970. Productivity has more than doubled; wages have lagged far behind. 在现实世界里，情况更复杂。工资受到雇主与工人之间拉锯战的影响，而雇主一直在胜出。一个明显的证据是，自 1970 年前后以来，生产率增长与工资增长之间的差距越来越大：生产率已经翻了一倍多，而工资远远落在后面。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 Productivity has more than doubled; wages have lagged far behind. ↔ People have failed to see a corresponding increase in wages and in productivity. the widening gap between productivity growth and wage growth ↔ a corresponding increase in wages and in productivity A 项用 failed to see a corresponding increase 表达"生产率翻倍而工资落后"的整体含义，与预判完全吻合。 B) 无中生有 原文 a tug of war between employers and workers 是劳资博弈，不是贫富分化（haves and have-nots）；且原文未提任何人 disheartened（沮丧）。 C) 偷换概念 原文 a tug of war between employers and workers 是劳资双方的拉锯战，而非两党的争斗；且原文未说民主党与共和党在减税上拉锯。 D) 过度推断 Productivity has more than doubled; wages have lagged far behind. 说的是"差距扩大"，并未说"联系消失（link disappearing）"——差距大 ≠ 联系断；且 well-being（福祉）也比 wages 范围更大。
records.keyword_relation: Productivity has more than doubled; wages have lagged far behind. ↔ People have failed to see a corresponding increase in wages and in productivity.；the widening gap between productivity growth and wage growth ↔ a corresponding increase in wages and in productivity

evidence.text: In the real world, things are more complicated. Wages are influenced by a tug of war between employers and workers, and employers have been winning. One clear piece of evidence is the widening gap between productivity growth and wage growth since roughly 1970. Productivity has more than doubled; wages have lagged far behind

distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：原文 a tug of war between employers and workers 是劳资博弈，不是贫富分化（haves and have-nots）；且原文未提任何人 disheartened（沮丧）。
distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：原文 a tug of war between employers and workers 是劳资双方的拉锯战，而非两党的争斗；且原文未说民主党与共和党在减税上拉锯。
distractor_explanations.D: 过度推断：Productivity has more than doubled; wages have lagged far behind. 说的是"差距扩大"，并未说"联系消失（link disappearing）"——差距大 ≠ 联系断；且 well-being（福祉）也比 wages 范围更大。

records.stem: What would we expect an editorial board of an academic journal to exhibit in view of its important responsibilities?
records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What would we expect an editorial board of an academic journal to exhibit in view of its important responsibilities? 问的是「鉴于职责，应当呈现什么」，是原文一句话可以直接回答的事实，不含 infer/imply。
【拆句】 题干主干是 What would we expect an editorial board…to exhibit，what 作 exhibit 的宾语前置；in view of its important responsibilities 是介词短语作原因状语，可剥离。剥离后等价于 We expect an editorial board to exhibit what?，结构平铺，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 You'd hope, then, that journals would do everything they can to establish a diverse editorial board, reflecting a variety of voices, experiences, and identities. 那么，你会希望期刊竭尽所能去建立一个多元化的编委会，从而反映各种各样的声音、经验与身份。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 全文没有任何句子提到「洞察力」相关概念，Insight 是从职责一词主观联想出来的属性。 B) 偷换概念 原文谈的是编辑的「身份多样性」而非「专业能力」；编辑工作虽要求专业，但全文没有任何一句强调专业能力，Expertise 是属性偷换。 C) 无中生有 全文未出现「诚信／正直」相关讨论，Integrity 同样是从「重要职责」一词联想出的主观属性。 D) ✓ 正确 diverse editorial board ↔ Diversity 预判语义「多元」与 Diversity 完全同义，其它三项均无对应原文支撑，锁定 D。

evidence.text: You'd hope, then, that journals would do everything they can to establish a diverse editorial board, reflecting a variety of voices, experiences, and identities

distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：原文谈的是编辑的「身份多样性」而非「专业能力」；编辑工作虽要求专业，但全文没有任何一句强调专业能力，Expertise 是属性偷换。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：全文未出现「诚信／正直」相关讨论，Integrity 同样是从「重要职责」一词联想出的主观属性。

records.stem: What do we learn from the findings of a new study in Nature Neuroscience?

options.text: The majority of top psychology and neuroscience journals reflect a variety of voices, experiences and identities.
The editorial boards of most psychology and neuroscience journals do influence the direction their field takes.
The editorial boards of the most important journals in psychology and neuroscience are male-dominated.
The majority of editors in top psychology and neuroscience journals have relevant backgrounds.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn from the findings of a new study in Nature Neuroscience? 问的是研究本身陈述了什么，原文有直陈句，不需要跨段推断。
【拆句】 题干主干 What do we learn from the findings…?，what 作 learn 的宾语前置；from the findings of a new study in Nature Neuroscience 是 of 套 of 的多层介词结构，但只是限定 findings 来源，对理解无障碍。
【定位】 P2 The team finds that the majority of editors in top psychology and neuroscience journals are male and based in the United States: a situation that may be amplifying existing gender inequalities in the field and influencing the kind of research that gets published. 研究团队发现，顶级心理学与神经科学期刊的大多数编辑是男性，且在美国工作——这种状况可能正在放大该领域既有的性别不平等，并影响着哪些研究得以发表。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 reflect a variety of voices, experiences and identities 是 P1 中作者「期望」的状态，而 P2 恰恰指出现实并非如此——选项把「期待」当成「现实」，方向完全反了。 B) 答非所问 do influence the direction their field takes 借用 influencing the direction that a field takes，但那是 P1 描述「编辑职责」的总论，不是 P2 的「研究发现」；题干问 findings of a new study，本选项答的是 P1 的背景，与 52 题问的范围错位。 C) ✓ 正确 the majority of editors in top psychology and neuroscience journals are male ↔ The editorial boards of the most important journals in psychology and neuroscience are male-dominated. top psychology and neuroscience journals ↔ the most important journals in psychology and neuroscience 「顶级=最重要」「以男为主=男性主导」两组同义替换都成立，C 是定位句的精确同义复述。 D) 无中生有 全文没有任何句子谈及编辑的「相关背景／资质」是否充足；P2 谈的是性别和国籍分布，不是专业相关性，have relevant backgrounds 凭空冒出。
records.keyword_relation: the majority of editors in top psychology and neuroscience journals are male ↔ The editorial boards of the most important journals in psychology and neuroscience are male-dominated.；top psychology and neuroscience journals ↔ the most important journals in psychology and neuroscience

evidence.text: The team finds that the majority of editors in top psychology and neuroscience journals are male and based in the United States: a situation that may be amplifying existing gender inequalities in the field and influencing the kind of research that gets published

records.stem: What can we infer from the conclusion drawn by the team of the new study on the basis of their findings?

options.text: Women's views are underrepresented in the editorial boards of top psychology and neuroscience journals.

records.stem: What does the author suggest we do instead of simply blaming the inequality of editorial boards on tradition?

options.text: Strike a balance between male and female editors.

Enlarge the body of female academics.

【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author suggest we do instead of simply blaming the inequality of editorial boards on tradition? 问作者明确建议什么，原文有 Rather than… we should… 的直陈句，是细节题而非主旨题。

【定位】 P7 Instead, there are structural reasons that women are disadvantaged in science. Women receive lower salaries and face greater childcare demands, for instance, which can result in fewer publications and grants—the kinds of things that journals look for when deciding who to appoint. Rather than simply blaming the inequality of editorial boards on tradition, we should be actively breaking down these existing barriers. 实际上，是结构性的原因让女性在科学界处于不利地位。例如，女性薪资更低、育儿负担更重，这会导致她们论文与基金更少——而这些恰恰是期刊在选拔编辑时所看重的。与其简单地把编委会的不平等推给传统，不如主动去拆除这些既有的壁垒。

Archaeologists don't want artifacts ending up in a private collection instead of taking humanity on a journey of understanding. 把文物标上虚高的价格，而不是把它们看作超越任何价格的文化与历史财富，是令许多考古学家恼火的事。对考古学家来说，沉船里的一切都意义重大——头发、织物、报纸残片、老鼠骨——一切都饱含信息。考古学家不愿文物落入私人收藏，而非带领人类踏上一段理解之旅。

records.stem: What do we learn about singer and actress Selena Gomez in the past four and a half years?

options.text: She has had worsening mental problems.
She has won Instagram's most followers.
She has refrained from using social media.
She has succeeded in a bid on the internet.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about singer and actress Selena Gomez in the past four and a half years? 指向「她过去四年半发生了什么」这一具体事实，没有 infer/imply/mainly。
【拆句】 What do we learn about singer and actress Selena Gomez in the past four and a half years? 是一般疑问句，主干 What do we learn；介词短语 in the past four and a half years 作时间状语，限定考察范围。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health 远离社交媒体是我为心理健康做过的最好的决定。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 原文说她远离社媒是为改善心理健康（the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health），而 She has had worsening mental problems 把「为改善心理健康」反过来说成「心理问题加重」，与原文方向相反。 B) 偷换概念 原文说她「在 2016 年成为 Instagram 关注最多的用户」（she became Instagram's most followed user in 2016），是过去某一时点的事实；She has won Instagram's most followers 用现在完成时把这件 2016 年的事说成「过去四年半内取得」，与题干 in the past four and a half years 不符。 C) ✓ 正确 Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health ↔ She has refrained from using social media 预判「远离社媒」与 She has refrained from using social media 完全吻合，且原文-选项之间的替换属于六级阅读高频同义替换模式。 D) 偷换概念 原文 in a bid to improve her mental health 中 bid 意为「努力、尝试」（熟词僻义），整个短语意为「为改善心理健康所作的努力」；She has succeeded in a bid on the internet 把 bid 当作「竞拍」用，与原文意思完全两回事。

records.stem: Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege?

options.text: Most people find it subtle and complicated to give up using the internet.
Most people can hardly ditch the web while avoiding hate and comparisons.
Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation.
Most people have been seriously addicted to the web without being aware of it.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege? 已把结论摆出，要在原文找直接给出的原因，属于原因型细节题。
【拆句】 Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege? 主干 does opting out become a matter of privilege；动名词短语 actively opting out of using the internet 作主语；a matter of privilege 是表语。Why 直接问原因。
【定位】 P3 The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection. Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege. 我们社会日益数字化意味着——从交一笔煤气费、规划一条去朋友家的路线，甚至打一通电话——一切都受制于你的网络连接。主动选择不使用互联网由此变成一种特权。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 Most people find it subtle and complicated to give up using the internet 改写自 Ditching the web at large, however, is a far more subtle and complicated prospect，描述的是「难度」，并未回答题干「为何成为特权」。 B) 张冠李戴 Most people can hardly ditch the web while avoiding hate and comparisons 把「避开仇恨与攀比」塞给「为何不上网是特权」这一问题；但 The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down 讲的是 Gomez 远离社媒后的结果，与 Q47 的因果无关。 C) ✓ 正确 The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection ↔ Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation Could you get by without using the internet for four and a half years? ↔ Most people can hardly get by without the internet 预判的因果（数字化 → 离不开网 → 不上网成特权）与 Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation 一一对应。 D) 无中生有 Most people have been seriously addicted to the web without being aware of it 拿 like "an addict" 套到「普通人不自觉成瘾」上，但原文只说 Gomez 自己感觉像 addict，并没有「普通人不自觉成瘾」这一论断，且与 Q47 因果无关。
records.keyword_relation: The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection ↔ Most people can hardly get by without the internet due to growing digitisation；Could you get by without using the internet for four and a half years? ↔ Most people can hardly get by without the internet

evidence.text: The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying a gas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone call is at the mercy of your internet connection. Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege

distractor_explanations.B: 张冠李戴：Most people can hardly ditch the web while avoiding hate and comparisons 把「避开仇恨与攀比」塞给「为何不上网是特权」这一问题；但 The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down 讲的是 Gomez 远离社媒后的结果，与 Q47 的因果无关。

records.stem: Why does the author say "witnessing companies…feels particularly irritating"(Lines 2-4, Para. 6)?

options.text: The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse.
The concept of the metaverse is believed to be still quite illusory.
School children would be drawn farther away from the real world.
Most families in the UK do not have stable broadband connections.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （推断题）
【判型】 Why does the author say "witnessing companies…feels particularly irritating" 问的是作者使用此评价语背后的逻辑，需要把「为何 irritating」这层因果挖出来。
【拆句】 Why does the author say "witnessing companies…feels particularly irritating"(Lines 2-4, Para. 6)? Why 引导主干，宾语从句 the author say + 直接引语；括号 (Lines 2-4, Para. 6) 是定位说明。直接引语本身是动名词短语作主语 + feels 系动词 + irritating 表语。
【定位】 P6 The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes. Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Facebook championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating. 英国的数字鸿沟在过去两年里加剧，导致较贫困家庭家中没有宽带。数字排斥是英国社会整体公平的一大威胁，因此当学童正为完成作业犯难时，看到 Facebook 之类的公司还在把元宇宙鼓吹成下一个伟大前沿，就让人尤其感到刺目。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years ↔ The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework ↔ due to the metaverse 预判「鼓吹元宇宙会加深数字鸿沟」与 The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse 完全对应，且推断只走一步，未越界。 B) 无中生有 The concept of the metaverse is believed to be still quite illusory 评价的是「元宇宙是否虚幻」，原文只用 the next great frontier 描述公司的宣传口径，并未对 metaverse 概念本身的「虚幻与否」作判断。 C) 答非所问 School children would be drawn farther away from the real world 把焦点放在「学童被拉离现实世界」，但原文中学童的位置是 struggling to complete their homework——他们是因为没有宽带连作业都做不了，而不是被元宇宙拉离现实。 D) 以偏概全 Most families in the UK do not have stable broadband connections 把原文 leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes 的「较贫困家庭」扩大为「大多数家庭」；同时这只是引发 irritating 的背景之一，而不是作者觉得 irritating 的核心原因。
records.keyword_relation: The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years ↔ The UK digital divide would further worsen due to the metaverse；championing the metaverse(元宇宙) as the next great frontier when school children are struggling to complete their homework ↔ due to the metaverse

records.stem: What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms?

options.text: They are conducive to promoting societal equality.
They help many people feel connected with others.
They provide a necessary device for a digital detox.
They create a virtual community on the internet.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms? 问的是作者明确提示要记住的事实，对应原文一处明确陈述。
【拆句】 What is worth bearing in mind concerning social media platforms? 主干 What is worth bearing in mind；动名词短语 bearing in mind 作 worth 的宾语；介词短语 concerning social media platforms 限定话题。结构清晰无陷阱。
【定位】 P7 Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed. 因此，值得记住的是：虽然删除所有社交媒体账号无疑会让一些人感觉好得多，但许多其他人则从共享平台所孕育的强烈社群感中获益。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 They are conducive to promoting societal equality 借用了上一段 wider societal equality in the UK 的高敏感词 societal equality，但原文是说「数字排斥威胁公平」，并未说社交媒体平台「促进」公平。 B) ✓ 正确 many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed ↔ They help many people feel connected with others 预判的「连接感」和 They help many people feel connected with others 完美对应，且 They 指代 social media platforms / sharing platforms。 C) 与原文相反 They provide a necessary device for a digital detox 颠倒了原文逻辑：even the concept of a digital detox(戒瘾) requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from 说的是「做数字戒瘾本身就要先有设备和网络」，设备/网络是 digital detox 的前提，而非由社交媒体平台提供。 D) 偷换概念 They create a virtual community on the internet 用 virtual community 偷换原文的 strong sense of community。原文强调的是「社群归属感」（用户主观感受），而 virtual community 指「线上社群」这一实体，重点偏离；并且原文用 breed（孕育）描述的是「感受」被催生，而非「社群」被创造。

records.stem: What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion?
records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion? 问作者明示的观点，且原文有 crucial 一句直接对应，归为细节题。
【拆句】 What does the author think is really important for those living in digital exclusion? What 作 think 后宾语从句的主语；is really important 是表语；介词短语 for those living in digital exclusion 限定对象，其中 living in digital exclusion 是现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 those。
【定位】 P8 It's crucial that people who feel that social media is having a detrimental effect on their mental health are allowed to switch off and for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place. 至关重要的是：让那些觉得社交媒体正在损害自己心理健康的人能够「关掉」，也要让那些深陷数字排斥的人首先能够「打开」。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place ↔ Having access to the internet greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need ↔ Having access to the internet 预判「先能联网」与 Having access to the internet 完全对应，且与同段两处描述都能挂上。 B) 偷换概念 Edging further towards web 3.0 改自 Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web 3.0，但 edge further towards web 3.0 在原文是描述时代背景，而非「对数字排斥者真正重要的事」。 C) 以偏概全 Getting more educational resources 把原文 greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live 中的 resources 缩到「教育资源」。原文 resources 指的是「用于提供网络连接的资源」，learn 只是 connectivity 的用途之一。 D) 与原文相反 Opening more social media accounts 与全文论调（提醒社媒对心理健康有害、Gomez 主动远离社媒）相反；原文要那些 digital exclusion 的人 switch on 的是「网络连接」，并非「更多社媒账号」。

records.stem: What does the author think is easy to see in many areas of contemporary life?

options.text: The disagreement on the inevitability of competition.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干What does the author think is easy to see in many areas of contemporary life?问的是作者在"当代生活的许多领域"中明确认为容易见到的东西，属于对原文某一具体表述的复述题，没有 infer/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。
【拆句】 Q51主干是 What ... is easy to see；the author think 是插入的宾语从句性插入语，问的实际是 What is easy to see；in many areas of contemporary life 是地点状语，限定范围。句式平铺，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life. 不管竞争是什么（天生还是习得），你都不得不承认竞争正在学术界以及当代生活的许多其他领域中所产生的影响。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 The disagreement on the inevitability of competition.借的是Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to whether competition is a learned or a genetic component of human behavior这一句，但原文说"心理学家一直有分歧"，而题干问的是"你不得不看到"的东西，把分歧与显而易见混为一谈；而且原文的分歧点是 learned or genetic（天生还是习得），不是 inevitability（必然性），偷换了概念。 B) 无中生有 The consequence of psychological investigation.中 psychological investigation 在P1里找不到对应——第 1 段只提到 psychologists in disagreement，没有提任何 investigation 的 consequence；且 consequence（后果）也不是原文 effect 的对应词。属凭空捏造。 C) 张冠李戴 The effect of human drives.借了human drives这个词，但 human drives 出现在第 2 段心理学内部解释里，是"竞争"的原因之一；题干问的是"在当代生活各领域中容易见到的东西"，对应第 1 段尾句，而非第 2 段。属张冠李戴。 D) ✓ 正确 the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life ↔ The impact of competition. 预判落在"竞争在当代生活中产生的影响"上，The impact of competition.就是它的最简同义改写，词义、对象、范围都对得上。

records.stem: According to psychology, what do people strive to do following the initial stage of their life?

options.text: Fulfill individual needs without incurring adverse effects of human drives.
Indulge in cultural pursuits while keeping their base impulses at bay.
Gain extensive recognition without exposing pure indulgence.
Satisfy their own desires while observing social conventions.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干According to psychology, what do people strive to do following the initial stage of their life?问"心理学认为人在初始阶段之后努力做什么"，要的是具体行为描述，属于细节题。
【拆句】 Q52主干是 what do people strive to do；According to psychology 是来源状语；following the initial stage of their life 是介词短语作时间状语。strive to do = 努力去做，注意题干问的是"努力的内容"而不是"努力的结果"。
【定位】 P2 Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence. 在那之后，我们便受制于一场拉锯战——一边是我们自我满足的本能冲动，另一边是禁止纯粹放纵的社会与文化规范。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Fulfill individual needs without incurring adverse effects of human drives.把原文中的两个对立面（本能冲动 vs 社会规范）改写成"满足需求且不引发本能冲动的负面效应"——但原文里 human drives 本身是积极的追求自我满足的力量，不是"会带来负面后果的东西"；且原文中真正的对立面是 social/cultural norms，与 human drives 无关。属与原文相反兼偷换概念。 B) 与原文相反 Indulge in cultural pursuits while keeping their base impulses at bay.中"沉湎于文化追求、压制本能冲动"完全把原文反过来——原文说的是文化规范禁止放纵、人的本能冲动想要放纵；选项却说人沉湎在文化里、压制本能。属与原文相反。 C) 张冠李戴 Gain extensive recognition without exposing pure indulgence.把"获得广泛认可"放在答案核心——但 recognition 对应的是we compete for the attention of our parents的初始阶段，是题干所问"之后"的前一阶段，时段错位；且 extensive（广泛）也是对 attention of our parents 的过度扩大。属张冠李戴。 D) ✓ 正确 base impulses for self-fulfillment ↔ Satisfy their own desires social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence ↔ while observing social conventions 预判要求同时包含"追求自我欲望"和"受社会规范约束"两端，且两端关系是同时进行的"边追求边受约束"；Satisfy their own desires while observing social conventions.的 while 把两端缝在一起，与原文 a battle between ... and ... 等值。

records.stem: What do we learn about the "natural world" characterized by Thomas Hobbes?

options.text: It gets misrepresented by philosophers and anthropologists.
It gets distorted in Darwin's The Origin of Species.
It is free from the rational intervention of humans.
It is the pre-rational world rarely appreciated nowadays.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干What do we learn about the "natural world" characterized by Thomas Hobbes?问"我们从原文中了解到 Hobbes 所刻画的自然世界是什么"，要的是对术语含义的复述，属于细节题。
【拆句】 Q53主干是 What do we learn about the "natural world"；characterized by Thomas Hobbes 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 natural world，含义="由 Hobbes 所刻画的"。这里要扣的是 Hobbes 给 natural world 下的定义，不是后人的评价。
【定位】 P3 Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the "natural world," that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being "nasty, brutish, and short." Thomas Hobbes 这位 17 世纪的大哲学家，最为人记得的或许是他对"自然世界"——也就是人类意志介入之前的世界——的刻画："令人厌恶、野蛮且短暂"。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 It gets misrepresented by philosophers and anthropologists.说自然世界被哲学家和人类学家"歪曲表述"——但原文只说 Hobbes 这一形象"被达尔文的工作强化"（reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work），后来又说当代人类学研究"质疑了这一观点"（questioned），并没有说 Hobbes 关于 natural world 的描述被哲学家和人类学家共同歪曲。属无中生有。 B) 与原文相反 It gets distorted in Darwin's The Origin of Species.说自然世界在达尔文的书里被歪曲——但原文是This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work，达尔文是"加强"而非"歪曲"，方向相反。属与原文相反。 C) ✓ 正确 the world before the imposition of the will of humanity ↔ It is free from the rational intervention of humans. 预判要求答案体现"无人类理性介入"这一特征；It is free from the rational intervention of humans.正是同位语的直接同义改写——free from 完美匹配 before（按时间顺序的不及）。 D) 与原文相反 It is the pre-rational world rarely appreciated nowadays.说 pre-rational world"当今很少受到欣赏"——但原文紧接着说This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held，明确说这一形象"仍被广泛持有"，与选项的 rarely 完全对立。属与原文相反。

records.stem: What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion in The Origin of Species?

options.text: All species inherently depend on others for survival.
Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.
Competition weighs as much as cooperation as a survival strategy.
The strongest species proves to be the fittest in natural selection.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （推断题）
【判型】 题干What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion in The Origin of Species?用 conclude from 引导，要求从达尔文的断言中得出结论，属于"一步推断题"。
【拆句】 Q54主干是 What can we conclude from Darwin's assertion；in The Origin of Species 是地点状语限定该断言出自哪本书。conclude from 重在"从断言本身推出"，所以答案必须紧贴 Darwin 那句原话，不能拿别的句子做依据。
【定位】 P3 Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation. 达尔文在《物种起源》中断言：他所描述的那些斗争应当被视为隐喻，完全可以涵盖依赖与合作。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 All species inherently depend on others for survival.中 All species（所有物种）+ inherently（天生地）是绝对化用语；原文只是说"斗争可以包含依赖与合作"，并未推出"所有物种都天生依赖他者才能生存"。属过度推断。 B) ✓ 正确 the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation ↔ Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support. 预判说斗争不排斥互助；Struggles for survival do not exclude mutual support.中 do not exclude 与原文 could include 等值，mutual support 概括 dependence and cooperation，逻辑等值、范围一致。 C) 过度推断 Competition weighs as much as cooperation as a survival strategy.中"竞争与合作作为生存策略权重相当"，把两者并列等值——但原文只说斗争"可以包含"合作，并未在"权重相当"的层面比较两者；权重比较是凭空引入。属过度推断。 D) 偷换概念 The strongest species proves to be the fittest in natural selection.说"最强的物种被证明是最适合的"——但原文的关键点是"survival of the fittest 这个短语达尔文自己从未使用"，且本句要的是"Darwin's assertion"（达尔文的断言），不是社会上对"适者生存"的概括；况且 fittest 也不等于 strongest，原文专门指出自然选择并不暗示竞争才是最优策略。属偷换概念。

records.stem: What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach after studying dozens of different cultures?

options.text: It is characteristic of humans to be competitive.
Americans are uniquely opposed to cooperation.
Competition is relatively more prevalent in Western societies.
People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach after studying dozens of different cultures?问"Mead 得出了什么结论"，是对原文最后一句明文表达的结论的复述，属于细节题。
【拆句】 Q55主干是 What conclusion did Margaret Mead reach；after studying dozens of different cultures 是时间状语。注意问的是"Mead 的结论"，所以答案必须是 Mead's final conclusion 那一句的同义改写，而不是 Mead 研究过程的具体发现（那是中间结论，不是 final conclusion）。
【定位】 P4 After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead's final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it. 在研究了数十个这样的文化之后，Mead 的最终结论是：竞争性是人类行为中由文化塑造出的一面；它在某个具体社会中的普遍程度，取决于该社会对它的评价。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 It is characteristic of humans to be competitive.说"竞争是人类的天性"——但这正是 Mead 想要驳斥的观点，Mead 的结论恰恰相反：竞争性不是天生的，而是文化塑造的。属与原文相反。 B) 偷换概念 Americans are uniquely opposed to cooperation.说美国人"独一无二地反对合作"——但原文是Americans uniquely praise competition as natural, inevitable, and desirable，说美国人独一无二地"赞美竞争"，并未说他们反对合作；"赞美 X"与"反对 Y"不可直接对调。属偷换概念。 C) 过度推断 Competition is relatively more prevalent in Western societies.说"竞争在西方社会中相对更普遍"——但 Mead 的最终结论是"竞争普遍程度取决于社会评价"，并未把社会分成"西方/非西方"两类、也未声称"竞争在西方更普遍"是普遍规律。属过度推断兼以偏概全。 D) ✓ 正确 competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior ↔ People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound. its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it ↔ actually culture-bound 预判要求答案体现"竞争性受文化决定"；People's attitude towards competition is actually culture-bound.中 culture-bound 直接等值于 culturally created，是 Mead 结论的最简同义改写。

records.stem: How can research serve its full purpose according to the author?

【拆句】 题干 How can research serve its full purpose according to the author? 是一个标准 How 类疑问句：情态动词 can 提到主语 research 前，谓语 serve 带宾语 its full purpose；according to the author 是状语，只是限定信息来源，不影响理解。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 For research to serve its full purpose, the results must leave the confines of research laboratories and academic journals. 要让研究充分发挥其作用，研究结果必须走出实验室和学术期刊的范围。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 With researchers being aware of public interests 说"研究者要意识到公众利益"，原文从未谈论"研究者的觉察"这一前提，P1 强调的是"传播"而非"觉察"。 B) 与原文相反 With its findings published in prominent journals 把"发表在顶级期刊上"当作答案，但 P1 恰恰指出"必须离开学术期刊"——发表在顶级期刊只是 P4 中讲到的研究者评职称的手段，与"研究发挥充分作用"相反。 C) 张冠李戴 With researchers creating products that enhance social development 把 creating products and innovations that enhance development 这句"研究的目标之一"挪用来作为"研究发挥作用的方式"——这是研究的目的描述，不是 serve its full purpose 的条件。 D) ✓ 正确 the results must leave the confines of research laboratories and academic journals ↔ With its findings properly communicated beyond the academic circle 选项 With its findings properly communicated beyond the academic circle 用同义替换还原了预判的"研究结果必须走出学术圈"，是定位句的标准转述。

【定位】 P3 Even articles freely available are usually written in academic language incomprehensible to the average reader. 即便那些免费可读的文章，通常也是用普通读者无法理解的学术语言写成。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 academic language incomprehensible to the average reader ↔ They cannot understand the academic language used for reporting these results 选项 They cannot understand the academic language used for reporting these results 是定位句"X 对 Y 不可理解"到"Y 不能理解 X"的标准视角转换，与预判完全吻合。 B) 无中生有 They feel intimidated by the jargon researchers use to describe their findings 中 feel intimidated（感到畏惧）原文从未提及；jargon（行话）原文也未出现这个词。 C) 偷换概念 They do not attend conferences where these results are freely available 把 freely available 从"免费可读"偷换为"会议上免费提供"；原文是说"少数期刊允许人人阅读，即便免费可读也用艰涩语言"，不是说在 conferences 上免费提供。 D) 答非所问 They have few chances to locate the journals that publish these findings 说"普通读者找不到这些期刊"，但原文 But few journals allow everybody to read the findings 说的是"少数期刊允许所有人阅读"——即"读到"的问题，而非"找到"的问题；且题干问的是 difficult to access the results（读懂结果），不是 difficult to locate the journals（找到期刊）。

records.stem: What is one of the reasons some researchers won't prioritise communicating their findings to the public?

options.text: They can thrive on the papers published.
Their top consideration is to win tenure
Their main goal is gaining recognition in their field.
They have to struggle to reach out to the community.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What is one of the reasons some researchers won't prioritise communicating their findings to the public? 直接问"原因之一"，要求从原文找明示因果句。
【拆句】 题干 What is one of the reasons some researchers won't prioritise communicating their findings to the public? 主干是 What is one of the reasons...；reasons 后的 some researchers won't prioritise... 是省略 that 的定语从句修饰 reasons；communicating 后的 their findings to the public 是 V-ing 短语的双宾语结构。结构略长但语义清晰。
【定位】 P4 For researchers in the tenure-track system, their main goal is winning tenure, which in part can be achieved by getting a number of papers published in prominent journals. Pressures like this mean community-level outreach is not prioritised. 对处在终身教职轨制度中的研究者来说，他们的主要目标是获得终身教职，而获得终身教职部分可以通过在顶级期刊上发表若干论文实现。诸如此类的压力意味着面向社区层面的对外传播不被优先考虑。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 They can thrive on the papers published 说"他们靠发表的论文茁壮成长"——题干问的是"为什么不优先对外传播的原因"，A 描述的是"发文的结果/好处"，而非"不愿对外传播的原因"，且 thrive on 的积极语义与原文"压力"对应不上。 B) ✓ 正确 their main goal is winning tenure ↔ Their top consideration is to win tenure 选项 Their top consideration is to win tenure 是定位句 their main goal is winning tenure 几乎逐词的同义替换，且与预判"首要目标是 tenure"完全一致。 C) 无中生有 Their main goal is gaining recognition in their field 把研究者目标改成"在领域内获得认可"——原文 their main goal is winning tenure 明确写的是 winning tenure（拿到终身教职），不是 recognition；这是把因果中段的"靠发文"过度泛化为"求认可"。 D) 与原文相反 They have to struggle to reach out to the community 说"他们必须努力对外传播"，但原文 community-level outreach is not prioritised 是说"不优先做"——不是"努力做"，方向完全相反。

records.stem: How can sharing findings benefit researchers themselves?

options.text: By helping them to identify new research directions.
By enabling them to understand crises plaguing society.
By enabling them to effectively address social discrepancies.
By helping them to forge ties with government agencies.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 How can sharing findings benefit researchers themselves? 问"如何受益"，需要在原文找具体受益机制的陈述。
【拆句】 题干 How can sharing findings benefit researchers themselves? 主干 sharing findings 作主语（动名词短语），benefit 是及物动词，researchers themselves 是宾语+反身代词强调。themselves 是理解关键，标明"受益方是研究者自己"。
【定位】 P7 Engaging with other researchers and the public can lead to unexpected new connections and new ideas that could suggest fruitful new directions for research. 与其他研究者及公众的互动可能催生意想不到的新联系和新想法，进而可能指明富有成果的新研究方向。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 could suggest fruitful new directions for research ↔ By helping them to identify new research directions 选项 By helping them to identify new research directions 是定位句 could suggest fruitful new directions for research 的同义改写，且 By Ving 结构正好回应题干 How。 B) 张冠李戴 By enabling them to understand crises plaguing society 借用了 respond to crises that plague society 的措辞——但 P6 讲的是"分享有助于其他主体（家庭、社区、政策制定者等）理解危机"，受益者并非"研究者自身"；与题干 researchers themselves 错位。 C) 张冠李戴 By enabling them to effectively address social discrepancies 借用 addressing certain social discrepancies 的措辞——同样是 P6 讲对社会的好处，而非对研究者自身的好处；与题干 themselves 错位。 D) 无中生有 By helping them to forge ties with government agencies 说"帮助他们与政府机构建立关系"——原文虽提过 government agencies（P6 列举受益方时），但从未把"与政府机构结盟"作为研究者自身的受益方式。

records.stem: Why are researchers advised to engage the services of professional writers or communication officers?

options.text: To satisfy ethics committees' mandatory requirements of researchers.
To translate their study into languages accessible to readers overseas.
To make their publications correctly understood by the public.
To render their findings acceptable by prominent journals.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 Why are researchers advised to engage the services of professional writers or communication officers? 问"为何建议聘请"，需要从原文找明示的目的或结果状语。
【拆句】 题干 Why are researchers advised to engage the services of professional writers or communication officers? 是被动语态：are advised to do（被建议做）；engage 在此为正式词义"聘请"；professional writers or communication officers 是并列名词词组。结构清晰，注意 engage 不是"参与"而是"聘用"。
【定位】 P11 But this can be resolved by researchers engaging the services of professional writers or communication officers to help with translating their study into more accessible language and share it widely with media outlets and the public. 但这可以通过研究者聘请专业写手或传播官来解决，让他们帮助把研究"翻译"成更通俗易懂的语言，并广泛地向媒体和公众分享。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 To satisfy ethics committees' mandatory requirements of researchers 把 ethics committees should make it mandatory 这一伦理委员会的强制要求挪用来作为聘请写手的目的；但 P10 与 P11 是两个独立建议——伦理委员会强制研究者分享是一回事，聘请写手帮助翻译是另一回事，两者目的不同。 B) 偷换概念 To translate their study into languages accessible to readers overseas 把 more accessible language 偷换为 languages accessible to readers overseas（让海外读者读懂）——原文从未提及 overseas / readers abroad 等概念，只说"通俗易懂"，不涉及外语翻译。 C) ✓ 正确 to help with translating their study into more accessible language ↔ To make their publications correctly understood by the public There could be misunderstanding of the findings presented by the researcher because of technical terms. ↔ correctly understood by the public 选项 To make their publications correctly understood by the public 是 P11 整段问题（误解）与解决（翻译成通俗语言）的目的合成，与预判完全吻合。 D) 与原文相反 To render their findings acceptable by prominent journals 说"让顶级期刊接受研究"——这是 P4 中谈到的另一动机（评 tenure 时投顶级期刊），且 P1 明确批判"留在期刊里就发挥不了作用"；聘请写手的目的恰恰是"走出期刊面向公众"，方向相反。

evidence.text: But this can be resolved by researchers engaging the services of professional writers or communication officers to help with translating their study into more accessible language and share it widely with media outlets and the public

records.stem: What do we learn about spiders in the UK since the middle ages?

options.text: They have adversely impacted crop growth.
They have been a constant reminder of bad luck.
They have made their presence felt when spinning webs.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about spiders in the UK since the middle ages? 用 What do we learn about 引出，问的是关于某对象的客观事实，没有 infer/imply/suggest 等推断信号
【拆句】 题干主句是 What do we learn about spiders in the UK since the middle ages，主干是 What do we learn about X，X 是 spiders in the UK，后面 since the middle ages 是表时间起点的介词短语，整体平铺直叙、无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 But they are a constant source of human anxieties—with a cultural association with witches and wickedness dating back to the middle ages. 但它们一直是人类焦虑的来源——与女巫和邪恶的文化关联可追溯至中世纪。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 a cultural association with witches and wickedness ↔ generally misconceived its prevalence appears unrelated to any rational assessment of risk ↔ misconceived 预判落在蜘蛛被文化误解上，A They have been generally misconceived 用 misconceived 概括了原文女巫、邪恶等不实联想，与预判完全对应，是定位句的高度抽象同义替换。 B) 与原文相反 B 选项 They have adversely impacted crop growth 称蜘蛛对农作物生长有不利影响，但原文 Farmland species perform valuable ecosystem services, by preying on insects that are our competitors for crops 明确说农田蜘蛛吃掉与人类争粮的昆虫，是有利的；B 把有利说成有害，与原文相反。 C) 偷换概念 C 选项 They have been a constant reminder of bad luck 说蜘蛛是坏运气的提醒，但原文说的是与女巫、邪恶（witches and wickedness）的文化关联，witches/wickedness 是邪恶/巫术，不等于坏运气（bad luck）；二者是不同的文化概念，C 偷换了概念。 D) 答非所问 D 选项 They have made their presence felt when spinning webs 取自首段 Spiders make their presence felt in late August and through early autumn，讲的是晚夏初秋的自然现象，与题干 since the middle ages 的时间范围毫无关系；属答非所问。

records.explanation:

【拆句】 题干主干是 What have spiders been associated with，spiders 为主语，谓语为现在完成时被动 have been associated with，介词 with 后的宾语正是要回答的内容；in the UK 是地点状语，for centuries 是时间状语，结构清晰。

records.stem: What partly accounts for the reduction in spiders' food supply?

options.text: The long tradition of collecting insects.
The extinction of a lot of wildlife

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What partly accounts for the reduction in spiders' food supply? 用 What accounts for 直接问原因，是典型的因果型细节题，不是推断
【拆句】 题干主干是 What partly accounts for X，partly 修饰 accounts for，X 为名词短语 the reduction in spiders' food supply，其中 spiders' 是所有格修饰 food supply；句子结构简单，重点是 partly 这一限定词。
【定位】 P4 A recent landmark study identified a 75% fall in insect populations between 1989 and 2016, with pesticide use thought to be to blame along with the destruction of wild areas for development. 近期一项标志性研究发现，1989 到 2016 年间昆虫种群下降了 75%，元凶是杀虫剂使用以及为开发而破坏野生区域。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 A The long tradition of collecting insects 取自 British butterflies are the most studied group of insects in the world, due to the long tradition of collecting and observing them，那里讲的是蝴蝶被研究多的原因，与蜘蛛食物减少没有任何因果关系；A 答非所问。 B) 无中生有 B Fast reproduction of their competitors 称蜘蛛竞争者快速繁殖导致食物减少；但原文 preying on insects that are our competitors for crops 说的是昆虫是人类的庄稼竞争者，主体是人类的庄稼竞争者，并非蜘蛛的竞争者；且原文从未提及 fast reproduction；属无中生有。 C) ✓ 正确 pesticide use ↔ Chemicals used for killing insects thought to be to blame ↔ Chemicals used for killing insects 由预判 杀虫剂，C Chemicals used for killing insects 是 pesticide 的标准释义，是定位句最直接的同义替换，无任何外加信息。 D) 过度推断 D The extinction of a lot of wildlife 称大量野生动物灭绝；原文说的是 the destruction of wild areas for development——破坏野生区（栖息地），不是野生动物灭绝；二者范围与程度都不同，D 过度推断。

records.stem: What does the passage say is conservationists' biggest worry?

options.text: A variety of spiders are threatened due to pollution of marshes and wasteland.
Certain species of spiders are endangered due to loss of their natural homes.
An increasing number of spiders are being killed by deadly pesticides.
More and more spider species are found losing their ability to migrate.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What does the passage say is conservationists' biggest worry? 用 What does the passage say 直接问文中陈述的事实/观点，是细节题
【拆句】 题干是嵌套疑问句：主干 What does the passage say is X，间接引语 the passage say (that) X is conservationists’ biggest worry 被改写成 What...is...的疑问形式；要回答的是 What 所代的 X，即保护者最担心的事，结构稍复杂但无陷阱。
【定位】 P4 But conservationists are most concerned about those varieties that are threatened due to habitat loss and fragmentation, which makes it impossible for them to migrate. 但保护者最担忧的是那些因栖息地丧失与碎片化而受威胁的物种，这种碎片化使得它们无法迁徙。

records.stem: What wish does the author express close to the end of the passage?

options.text: More people would recognise spiders' unique status in the ecosystem.
People would show greater enthusiasm for spiders than for butterflies.
There would be sufficient corridors for spiders to move along.
There would be more people appreciating spiders' splendour.

records.explanation:

【定位】 P2 Second, the company's culture needs to make them feel safe to speak up. 第二，公司的文化需要让他们觉得发声是安全的。

options.text: The more people are around, the more they need to worry about their personal safety.

The more people idling around on the street, the more likely they need taking care of.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （词义句意题）
【判型】 What does the author mean by 是经典的释义提问框架，答案为原文对该术语的同义解释。
【拆句】 主干 What does the author mean by，by 后跟引号词作宾语，括号内 (Para. 3) 为定位提示。结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 Basically, the larger the crowd, the more people assume that someone else will take care of it—meaning no one effectively intervenes or acts in a moment of need. 基本上，人群越大，越多人就假定别人会处理这事——也就是说，在需要出手时反而无人有效干预或行动。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 they need to worry about their personal safety 把原文「无人干预他人」的话题偷换成「担心自身安全」，自身安全在 P3 里根本未提及。 B) 答非所问 The more people who witness an event, the less likely anyone will venture to 后半句 venture to 后无宾语，句子残缺；即便补全也只是 the more people who witness an event, the less likely anyone in that group is to help the victim 的 bystander effect 释义，而题干问的是 diffusion of responsibility 这一更深层心理机制，对应的是 P3 后半句而非这句。 C) 偷换概念 people idling around on the street 把原文 stand idly by 的「袖手旁观者」读成「街上闲逛的人」，并称他们「需要被照顾」，与 diffusion of responsibility 的心理机制无关。 D) ✓ 正确 the larger the crowd, the more people assume that someone else will take care of it ↔ The more people are around, the less chance someone will step forward to intervene 选项 D 的两段比较级与原文的两段比较级一一对应：人多→人多假定→更少人出手干预，与预判「越多越没人挺身而出」严丝合缝，故锁定 D。

records.stem: What happens when unsafe behavior at the workplace is not addressed by the leaders?

options.text: No one will intervene when they see similar behaviors.
Everyone will see it as the easiest way to deal with crisis.
Workers have to take extra caution executing their duties.
Workers are left to take care of the emergency themselves.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What happens when unsafe behavior at the workplace is not addressed by the leaders? 问「当条件 X 成立时结果是什么」，答案为原文明文给出的客观后果。
【拆句】 主干 What happens when，when 引导时间/条件状语从句，从句主语 unsafe behavior at the workplace，谓语为被动语态 is not addressed by the leaders。注意被动否定结构，主体是「领导层不去处理」。
【定位】 P5 When a group of employees sees unsafe behavior not being addressed at a leadership level it creates the precedent that this is how these situations should be addressed, thus defining the safety culture for everyone. 当一群员工看到领导层不处理不安全行为时，就会形成「这类情况就该这样处理」的先例，从而为所有人定义了安全文化。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 it creates the precedent that this is how these situations should be addressed ↔ No one will intervene when they see similar behaviors 结合上下文（领导没干预+形成先例），先例的具体内容就是「对类似行为不干预」，选项 A 正是该先例的客观转述，故锁定 A。 B) 过度推断 原文只说形成「该这样处理」的先例，并未评价它是 the easiest way；且「危机处理」角度也是 crisis 强加的描述。 C) 无中生有 Workers have to take extra caution 在原文中找不到根据，原文是说大家集体不干预，并非「工人变得更小心」。 D) 与原文相反 Workers are left to take care of the emergency themselves 说工人会自己去处理紧急情况，而 P5 的逻辑是「没人去处理」，方向完全相反。

evidence.text: When a group of employees sees unsafe behavior not being addressed at a leadership level it creates the precedent that this is how these situations should be addressed, thus defining the safety culture for everyone

distractor_explanations.B: 过度推断：原文只说形成「该这样处理」的先例，并未评价它是 the easiest way；且「危机处理」角度也是 crisis 强加的描述。

records.stem: What is the ultimate reason workers won't act when they see unsafe operations?

options.text: Preference of deferring the action to others.
Fear of being isolated by coworkers.
Fear of having to do more work.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What is the ultimate reason workers won't act when they see unsafe operations? 直问最终原因，答案为原文一句明文判断，非推断。
【拆句】 主干 What is the ultimate reason，后接省略了 why/that 的定语从句 workers won't act，再嵌套时间状语从句 when they see unsafe operations。注意「won't act」等价于「don't intervene」。
【定位】 P6 Fear is the ultimate factor in not intervening. There is a fear of penalty, a fear that they'll have to do more work if they intervene. 恐惧是不干预的最终因素。存在对惩罚的恐惧，以及对「一旦干预就得做更多工作」的恐惧。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 Preference of deferring the action to others 对应 they tend to prefer to defer that action to someone else for all future situations，但这是 Unsuccessful attempts in the past（过去失败经验）的副产品，是 another strong contributing factor，不是 ultimate factor。 B) 无中生有 Anticipation of leadership intervention 在 P6 没有依据。文中 P4 P5 提到 leadership 不干预，但谈的是「领导自己不出手」形成先例，而非「员工等领导干预」。 C) 无中生有 Fear of being isolated by coworkers 中「被同事孤立」在 P6 罗列的几种 fear（penalty / do more work / unsuccessful attempts）中并无对应。 D) ✓ 正确 a fear that they'll have to do more work if they intervene ↔ Fear of having to do more work 原文罗列了两类 fear，选项 D 把第二类「怕多干活」原样收纳，与预判完全一致，故锁定 D。

【拆句】 主干 What is critical to ensuring workplace safety?，critical to 后接动名词短语 ensuring workplace safety 作介词宾语。注意 to 是介词不是不定式，故跟动名词。结构无陷阱。
【定位】 P8 Supervisors also play a critical role. Even if a competent person isn't required, supervisors need a broad set of skills to not only identify and alleviate workplace hazards but also build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening and open communication among them. 主管也起着至关重要的作用。即便不需要专门的胜任人员，主管也需要一整套技能，既要能识别和消除职场隐患，也要在团队中营造支持干预和坦诚沟通的安全氛围。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Workers be trained to operate their equipment properly 中「培训工人正确操作设备」在原文中无对应；without the proper equipment 谈的是「没有合适设备」，与「培训操作设备」不是一回事。 B) 过度推断 Workers exhibiting at-risk behavior be strictly disciplined 中「对有风险行为的工人进行严厉惩戒」，P6 只是说工人怕 penalty，不代表全文主张要 strictly discipline，原文并未把「严厉惩戒」作为确保安全的做法。 C) ✓ 正确 build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening ↔ Supervisors create a safety environment for timely intervention 主语对位（Supervisors↔Supervisors）、动作对位（build↔create）、对象对位（safety climate↔safety environment）、目的对位（supports intervening↔for timely intervention），与预判一致，故锁定 C。 D) 以偏概全 Supervisors conduct effective communication with frontline workers 抓住了 open communication，但漏掉原文核心 build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening——主管的关键不仅是沟通，而是建立支持干预的安全氛围；且 communication with frontline workers 把原文 open communication among them（团队内部沟通）偷换为「主管与一线工人之间的沟通」，对象错位。

records.stem: What accounts for the divide within the scientific community about nuclear energy?

options.text: Attention to combating human-made climate change.
Emphasis on protecting wildlife and natural ecosystems.
Evolution of the term "green energy" over the last century.
Adherence to different interpretations of environmentalism.

【判型】 What accounts for the divide within the scientific community about nuclear energy? 问的是"分裂的原因是什么"，是对原文具体因果关系的客观追问。

【选项】 A) 以偏概全 Attention to combating human-made climate change 只对应 P1 里 environmentalist 的"第二种含义"，不是"两种含义的差异"。 B) 以偏概全 Emphasis on protecting wildlife and natural ecosystems 只对应 P1 里 environmentalist 的"第一种含义"，同样只覆盖单侧。 C) 偷换概念 原文谈的是 The term "environmentalist" 在 21 世纪的演变，Evolution of the term "green energy" over the last century 把术语换成了 green energy、时间换成了 the last century。 D) ✓ 正确 The distinction between these two strands of environmentalism ↔ Adherence to different interpretations of environmentalism 预判要求答案体现"对环保主义的不同理解→科学界分裂"这一因果链，Adherence to different interpretations of environmentalism 是四项中唯一精准覆盖该因果的表述。

Indeed, it can be one of the most challenging aspects I work on with clients who have lost or been forced into changing their jobs. This loss provokes an identity crisis much greater than the loss of the job itself. 「没有了工作，我就不知道自己是谁」——这话在我办公室的椅子上不止一次被来访者说出。事实上，与那些失去或被迫更换工作的来访者一起处理这种感受，是我工作中最具挑战的部分之一。这种失落所引发的身份危机，要远远大于失业本身。

records.stem: The alien finds the audience in the movie theatre clearly in a state of ______.
records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 The alien finds the audience in the movie theatre clearly in a state of ______ 问的是外星人眼中观众的客观状态，无 infer/imply/mainly 等抽象信号，是单点事实细节。
【拆句】 Q46 句子主干是 The alien finds the audience ... in a state of ______，find sb. in a state of ... 是「发现某人处于某种状态」的复合宾语结构；clearly 修饰整个判断，强调状态显而易见；in the movie theatre 是 audience 的后置定语，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 They are clearly in a state of high arousal. Their heart rate is elevated, they occasionally glance around nervously, and they sometimes jump collectively in their seats, and emit high-pitched warning calls. 他们显然处于一种高度唤起的状态。心率加快，偶尔紧张地四下张望，时不时在座位上一齐惊跳，并发出尖叫般的警示声。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 total mindfulness 指「完全的正念/平静专注」，与 high arousal 描绘的生理躁动完全相反。 B) ✓ 正确 high arousal ↔ extreme excitement Their heart rate is elevated ... jump collectively ... emit high-pitched warning calls ↔ extreme excitement 预判语义「高度兴奋」与 extreme excitement 在程度词 extreme=high、情绪词 excitement=arousal 两个维度上完全对位。 C) 无中生有 spiritual elevation 指「精神升华」，原文只描写心率 elevated 这种生理升高，未提及任何精神层面的升华。 D) 偷换概念 intense curiosity 把状态偷换成「强烈好奇」；但原文是因恐怖剧情引发的恐惧式高唤起，不是认知性好奇。
records.keyword_relation: high arousal ↔ extreme excitement；Their heart rate is elevated ... jump collectively ... emit high-pitched warning calls ↔ extreme excitement

evidence.text: They are clearly in a state of high arousal. Their heart rate is elevated, they occasionally glance around nervously, and they sometimes jump collectively in their seats, and emit high-pitched warning calls

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：total mindfulness 指「完全的正念/平静专注」，与 high arousal 描绘的生理躁动完全相反。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：spiritual elevation 指「精神升华」，原文只描写心率 elevated 这种生理升高，未提及任何精神层面的升华。
distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：intense curiosity 把状态偷换成「强烈好奇」；但原文是因恐怖剧情引发的恐惧式高唤起，不是认知性好奇。

records.stem: Why do many people seek out scary entertainment, according to the author's research?

options.text: They gain experience in overcoming horror in real life.
They find joy in going through simulated horrible experiences.
They have learned from hide-and-seek as kids the thrill involved.
They have evolved to gain pleasure in escaping life-threatening situations.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 according to the author's research 把答案限制为作者研究中的一个具体结论，问的是事实层面的原因而非整体主旨，属细节题。
【拆句】 Q47 主句 Why do many people seek out scary entertainment 是标准 Why 一般疑问句；according to the author's research 是插入语，提示信源限定；seek out 是「主动去寻找」，与原文 voluntarily expose / seek out 同义，注意主动义。
【定位】 P8 My research suggests that we humans evolved to find pleasure in situations that allow us to experience negative emotions in a safe context. 我的研究表明，人类在进化中学会了在能让我们于安全语境下体验负面情绪的情景中获得快感。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 They gain experience in overcoming horror in real life 把「安全语境的模拟体验」偷换成「现实生活中克服恐怖」，与原文 safe context 矛盾。 B) ✓ 正确 find pleasure ↔ find joy experience negative emotions in a safe context ↔ going through simulated horrible experiences They find joy in going through simulated horrible experiences 两端都吻合预判：joy=pleasure、simulated horrible experiences=negative emotions in a safe context。 C) 以偏概全 They have learned from hide-and-seek as kids the thrill involved 拿一个例证 hide-and-seek 当原因，又把 pleasure 改成 thrill；hide-and-seek 是论据而非原因，本身不能解释成年人为何看恐怖片。 D) 偷换概念 They have evolved to gain pleasure in escaping life-threatening situations 把「在安全语境下体验负面情绪」偷换成「在逃离致命威胁中获得快感」——原文是模拟、非真威胁；evolved、pleasure 借词制造伪等值。
records.keyword_relation: find pleasure ↔ find joy；experience negative emotions in a safe context ↔ going through simulated horrible experiences

evidence.text: My research suggests that we humans evolved to find pleasure in situations that allow us to experience negative emotions in a safe context

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：They gain experience in overcoming horror in real life 把「安全语境的模拟体验」偷换成「现实生活中克服恐怖」，与原文 safe context 矛盾。
distractor_explanations.C: 以偏概全：They have learned from hide-and-seek as kids the thrill involved 拿一个例证 hide-and-seek 当原因，又把 pleasure 改成 thrill；hide-and-seek 是论据而非原因，本身不能解释成年人为何看恐怖片。
distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：They have evolved to gain pleasure in escaping life-threatening situations 把「在安全语境下体验负面情绪」偷换成「在逃离致命威胁中获得快感」——原文是模拟、非真威胁；evolved、pleasure 借词制造伪等值。

records.stem: What do children learn from hide-and-seek?

options.text: How to avoid falling prey to an attacker.
How to simulate a predator-prey interaction.
How to keep themselves from catastrophic errors.
How to turn a dangerous scenario into a safe one.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What do children learn from hide-and-seek 问的是一个可在原文一句话里找到的具体收获，属典型细节题。
【拆句】 Q48 主干 What do children learn from hide-and-seek 是标准 wh- 疑问；learn from 是「从……中学到」，要求原文有相应的因果或收获句，无陷阱。
【定位】 P9 This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey, and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario. 这种模拟向孩子提供了关于「如何避免成为猎物」的关键信息，孩子往往觉得这种活动极其令人满足，大概是因为它让他们在安全条件下体验了一种潜在的灾难性情境。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 how to avoid becoming prey ↔ How to avoid falling prey to an attacker The kid hides and the adult pretends to be a predator ↔ an attacker How to avoid falling prey to an attacker 是预判的近乎逐字改写，avoid 对 avoid、falling prey 对 becoming prey、attacker 对 predator。 B) 答非所问 How to simulate a predator-prey interaction 学的是「如何模拟捕食情境」，但原文说「这场模拟（this simulation）」是大人创造的，孩子从中学到的是避险知识，而不是模拟技巧本身。 C) 无中生有 How to keep themselves from catastrophic errors 凭空造出「灾难性错误」一说；原文只有 catastrophic scenario「灾难性情境」，且讨论的是体验该情境而非「避免错误」。 D) 偷换概念 How to turn a dangerous scenario into a safe one 把原文「在安全条件下体验潜在的灾难性情境」偷换成「把危险情境变安全」——原文的 safe 是体验时的环境条件，并非孩子把危险情境改造成了安全情境。
records.keyword_relation: how to avoid becoming prey ↔ How to avoid falling prey to an attacker；The kid hides and the adult pretends to be a predator ↔ an attacker

evidence.text: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey, and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario

distractor_explanations.B: 答非所问：How to simulate a predator-prey interaction 学的是「如何模拟捕食情境」，但原文说「这场模拟（this simulation）」是大人创造的，孩子从中学到的是避险知识，而不是模拟技巧本身。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：How to keep themselves from catastrophic errors 凭空造出「灾难性错误」一说；原文只有 catastrophic scenario「灾难性情境」，且讨论的是体验该情境而非「避免错误」。
distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：How to turn a dangerous scenario into a safe one 把原文「在安全条件下体验潜在的灾难性情境」偷换成「把危险情境变安全」——原文的 safe 是体验时的环境条件，并非孩子把危险情境改造成了安全情境。

records.stem: Why is horror gratifying to many people?

options.text: It reminds them of an ancient set of biological defence mechanisms.
It triggers their imagination to travel into dangerous virtual worlds.
It allows them to learn what fear feels like and how to tackle it.
It activates their evolved fear system and their unique fantasy.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 Why is horror gratifying to many people 问的是可在一句原文中找到的因果细节，作者给出明确的 because 句，非整体主旨。
【拆句】 Q49 主干 Why is horror gratifying to many people 是 be + adj. 的因果疑问句；gratifying 是现在分词作表语，等同 pleasing，要在原文找其同义表达 pleasurable，无结构陷阱。
【定位】 P11 Horror is pleasurable to many people because it lets us play with negative emotions and develop coping strategies. We learn what it feels like to be truly afraid, and we learn how to handle negative emotion. 对许多人而言，恐怖之所以令人愉悦，是因为它让我们演练负面情绪并发展出应对策略。我们由此了解真正害怕的感觉，也学会如何处理负面情绪。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 It reminds them of an ancient set of biological defence mechanisms 把「让我们演练负面情绪」偷换成「让我们想起远古防御机制」——原文是「利用」(exploiting) 防御机制，而不是「使我们回忆起」。 B) 答非所问 It triggers their imagination to travel into dangerous virtual worlds 描述的是恐怖如何作用（机制），而非「为什么令人满足」（原因）；机制 vs 原因不同问，且 P12 的话题是 how，不是 why。 C) ✓ 正确 We learn what it feels like to be truly afraid ↔ learn what fear feels like develop coping strategies ... learn how to handle negative emotion ↔ how to tackle it learn what fear feels like and how to tackle it 用并列结构同时覆盖预判的两层「体验」和「应对」，是原文最完整的同义改写。 D) 答非所问 It activates their evolved fear system and their unique fantasy 是把 P12 机制段的两个核心要素「evolved fear system」与「imagination」拼起来，依旧回答的是「机制」而非「为什么令人满足」。
records.keyword_relation: We learn what it feels like to be truly afraid ↔ learn what fear feels like；develop coping strategies ... learn how to handle negative emotion ↔ how to tackle it

evidence.text: Horror is pleasurable to many people because it lets us play with negative emotions and develop coping strategies. We learn what it feels like to be truly afraid, and we learn how to handle negative emotion

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：It reminds them of an ancient set of biological defence mechanisms 把「让我们演练负面情绪」偷换成「让我们想起远古防御机制」——原文是「利用」(exploiting) 防御机制，而不是「使我们回忆起」。
distractor_explanations.B: 答非所问：It triggers their imagination to travel into dangerous virtual worlds 描述的是恐怖如何作用（机制），而非「为什么令人满足」（原因）；机制 vs 原因不同问，且 P12 的话题是 how，不是 why。
distractor_explanations.D: 答非所问：It activates their evolved fear system and their unique fantasy 是把 P12 机制段的两个核心要素「evolved fear system」与「imagination」拼起来，依旧回答的是「机制」而非「为什么令人满足」。

records.stem: What will one experience if they watch a horror film through without being hurt?

options.text: A strong sense of clear relevance.
A profound sense of good fortune.
A profound sense of intense relief.
A strong sense of being in control.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What will one experience 询问的是一段可被定位的具体心理体验，原文末段以 you'll probably experience 直接给出，按细节题处理。
【拆句】 Q50 主干 What will one experience 是宾语前置的 wh- 疑问；if they watch a horror film through without being hurt 是条件状语从句，through 是副词「自始至终」，without being hurt 是被动动名词作伴随状语；they 指代 one，无指代陷阱。
【定位】 P13 If you make it through the film in one piece, you'll probably experience a strong sense of mastery, a sense that you were able to make it through an appalling experience. 如果你能毫发无损地撑过这部电影，你大概会体验到一种强烈的掌控感——一种自己能挺过令人毛骨悚然之体验的胜任感。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 A strong sense of clear relevance 摘取原文末句 critically relevant 中 relevant 的衍生形态，把后置的 critically relevant 偷换为 clear relevance；原文是说「处理恐惧的能力未来可能会变得至关重要」，并非「看完后体验到清晰的相关感」。 B) 无中生有 A profound sense of good fortune 描述「幸运感」，原文从未提及；作者强调的是因撑过而获得的胜任感，而非「庆幸自己运气好」。 C) 无中生有 A profound sense of intense relief 描述「释然感」，原文没有任何「relief/放松」语义；mastery 强调的是控场，而非紧张消退。 D) ✓ 正确 a strong sense of mastery ↔ A strong sense of being in control a sense that you were able to make it through an appalling experience ↔ being in control strong sense of 对原文原词，mastery 与 being in control 是同义场最佳对应，D 字面命中预判。
records.keyword_relation: a strong sense of mastery ↔ A strong sense of being in control；a sense that you were able to make it through an appalling experience ↔ being in control

evidence.text: If you make it through the film in one piece, you'll probably experience a strong sense of mastery, a sense that you were able to make it through an appalling experience

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：A strong sense of clear relevance 摘取原文末句 critically relevant 中 relevant 的衍生形态，把后置的 critically relevant 偷换为 clear relevance；原文是说「处理恐惧的能力未来可能会变得至关重要」，并非「看完后体验到清晰的相关感」。
distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：A profound sense of good fortune 描述「幸运感」，原文从未提及；作者强调的是因撑过而获得的胜任感，而非「庆幸自己运气好」。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：A profound sense of intense relief 描述「释然感」，原文没有任何「relief/放松」语义；mastery 强调的是控场，而非紧张消退。

records.stem: What do we learn about beauty in the digital arena?

options.text: It dictates the taste of digital media.
It has been in the making for years.
It has ushered in a new awakening.
It is defined by social media.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What do we learn about beauty in the digital arena 是问"关于 X 我们了解到什么",指向原文对 X 的客观陈述。
【拆句】 Q51 是一个简单的 wh-疑问句,主干 What do we learn (about X),about 短语作 learn 的状语,整句无从句、无否定,无理解陷阱。
【定位】 P1 But in the digital arena, social media determines what is considered beautiful. 但在数字领域,是社交媒体决定了什么才被认为是美的。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 It dictates the taste of digital media 让"美"反过来去 dictate digital media,原文是 social media 在 determine beauty,主客被掉换。 B) 张冠李戴 It has been in the making for years 谈的是"已经酝酿多年",原文只说 dictated to us for years 的是"physical world 的旧美标准",并非 beauty in the digital arena 本身。 C) 张冠李戴 It has ushered in a new awakening 说"数字领域的美开启了新觉醒",但原文 An awakening has been taking place in the physical world 明确把觉醒放在 physical world,而非 digital arena。 D) ✓ 正确 social media determines what is considered beautiful ↔ It is defined by social media It is defined by social media 几乎就是预判句"美由社交媒体决定"的英文被动版,正中定位句 social media determines what is considered beautiful 的核心信息。
records.keyword_relation: social media determines what is considered beautiful ↔ It is defined by social media

evidence.text: But in the digital arena, social media determines what is considered beautiful

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：It dictates the taste of digital media 让"美"反过来去 dictate digital media,原文是 social media 在 determine beauty,主客被掉换。
distractor_explanations.B: 张冠李戴：It has been in the making for years 谈的是"已经酝酿多年",原文只说 dictated to us for years 的是"physical world 的旧美标准",并非 beauty in the digital arena 本身。
distractor_explanations.C: 张冠李戴：It has ushered in a new awakening 说"数字领域的美开启了新觉醒",但原文 An awakening has been taking place in the physical world 明确把觉醒放在 physical world,而非 digital arena。

records.stem: What does the passage say about beauty in the physical world?

options.text: Women are under constant pressure to keep up with beauty models.
Women are encouraged to pursue a beauty ideal that has never existed.
A fight is going on to remove pressure on women to conform to an absurd beauty ideal.
Media outlets have begun to present as beauty models trendy women without any makeup.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does the passage say about beauty in the physical world 直接问"文章对 X 怎么说",取的是原文事实陈述。
【拆句】 Q52 主干 What does the passage say (about X),about 短语后置作 say 的状语,无从句、无否定,理解无障碍。
【定位】 P2 In the physical world, the struggle goes against the underlying pressure exerted on women to conform to an unrealistic beauty ideal. 在现实世界里,这场斗争所反对的是施加在女性身上、要求她们顺从一种不切实际的美标准的潜在压力。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Women are under constant pressure to keep up with beauty models 强调女性"持续被施压",方向恰好与原文的"对抗这种压力"相反,文章重点在抗争,而非顺从。 B) 无中生有 Women are encouraged to pursue a beauty ideal that has never existed 中的 encouraged to pursue 在原文找不到对应——原文谈的是被施压,而非被鼓励;"never existed"也并非原文 unrealistic 的等值表达。 C) ✓ 正确 the struggle goes against the underlying pressure exerted on women to conform to an unrealistic beauty ideal ↔ A fight is going on to remove pressure on women to conform to an absurd beauty ideal A fight is going on to remove pressure on women to conform to an absurd beauty ideal 把"正在进行抗争"+"对象是施加在女性身上的、要她们顺从荒谬美标准的压力"两层全保留,正是预判内容。 D) 偷换概念 Media outlets have begun to present as beauty models trendy women without any makeup 把媒体改变形象人选(那些"不符合所谓理想身材"的女性)与 influencers 不化妆自拍混在一起,且原文是 influencers 上传素颜照,不是 media outlets 把"时尚的不化妆女性"包装成 beauty models。

options.text: It is bound to mar the traditional rural life.
It adversely impacts rural social stability.
It is detrimental to rural preservation.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author think of rich urban residents buying a second home in the countryside? 问的是作者对这一具体行为的明确评价，答案出现在原文同一段的总结句。
【拆句】 rich urban residents buying a second home in the countryside 中 buying 是现在分词作 residents 的后置定语，相当于「买第二套乡村房的城市富人」；定语稍长但不绕。
【定位】 P4 A solution has yet to be found for this challenge, for market forces are further forcing residents out of the countryside. For those who believe in rural preservation, this is deplorable. 这一难题尚无解决方案，因为市场力量正在进一步把居民赶出乡村。对那些信奉乡村保护的人而言，这是令人痛心的。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 P4 谈的是房价与本地居民问题，并未提及 traditional rural life 是否被破坏；考生易把第二段提到的「亲密社区/简单生活」的传统印象嫁接到此，但原文未在 P4 谈这一面。 B) 偷换概念 原文 house prices are pushed up... leaving them unaffordable for local people 谈的是房价与可负担性，并未谈 rural social stability；选项把经济层面问题升格成「社会稳定」这种更大的范畴。 C) 无中生有 P4 谈的是市场力量与房价，并未提及 rural economies' revitalisation；revitalisation 这一话题在 P6 rural renaissance 处才隐约出现，与 P4 的论点无关。 D) ✓ 正确 For those who believe in rural preservation, this is deplorable ↔ It is detrimental to rural preservation. leaving them unaffordable for local people ↔ It is detrimental to rural preservation. 原文连续给出「房价上涨→本地人买不起→市场力量进一步驱赶居民→对乡村保护者而言可悲」四步推理，落脚点正是「对乡村保护不利」；D 既保留了评价的负面性，又精准落到 preservation 这个对象上。
records.keyword_relation: For those who believe in rural preservation, this is deplorable ↔ It is detrimental to rural preservation.；leaving them unaffordable for local people ↔ It is detrimental to rural preservation.

evidence.text: A solution has yet to be found for this challenge, for market forces are further forcing residents out of the countryside. For those who believe in rural preservation, this is deplorable

records.stem: What do we learn about the countryside with industrialisation and technological advances?

options.text: It is destined to change gradually.
It will present an idealised way of life.
It is likely to embrace foreign cultures.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about the countryside with industrialisation and technological advances? 问从文中得知什么，答案直接来自原文表述，不要求二步推断。
【拆句】 the countryside with industrialisation and technological advances 中 with 引出伴随状语，意为「在工业化与技术进步的影响下」，with 短语作 countryside 的后置修饰，整句直译「在工业化与技术进步下，我们对乡村得知什么」。
【定位】 P5 Whilst an idealised view of the countryside is common, the reality is that rural life has continuously evolved. Industrialisation brought an increase in divisions of labour, changing social links between rural people. The internet has introduced once foreign cultures into the countryside. Improved travel connections and affordability have made the world more accessible, creating a "global village". Considering these changes, surely an evolving countryside is inevitable. 尽管对乡村理想化的印象很常见，现实却是乡村生活一直在持续演变。工业化带来分工增加，改变了乡村人之间的社会联系。互联网把曾经陌生的文化带进了乡村。交通改善与可承受让世界更触手可及，造就了「地球村」。鉴于这些变化，乡村必然在演变之中。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 surely an evolving countryside is inevitable ↔ It is destined to change gradually. rural life has continuously evolved ↔ It is destined to change gradually. P5 段尾既明示必然性（inevitable）又通过 continuously evolved 暗示渐进性，A 把这两层语义都包含进 destined to change gradually，与预判完全一致。 B) 与原文相反 原文 Whilst an idealised view of the countryside is common, the reality is that rural life has continuously evolved 用 whilst 让步、the reality is 转折，明确把「理想化乡村」当成被否定的印象；选项 It will present an idealised way of life. 反把它说成将要呈现的现实。 C) 以偏概全 The internet has introduced once foreign cultures into the countryside 只是段中三件平行例证之一，与「分工」「全球村」共同支撑「乡村必然演变」这一论点；选项 It is likely to embrace foreign cultures. 把单一例子当成结论。 D) 过度推断 creating a "global village" 强调「世界更可及、变成地球村」，并不等于乡村会「越来越多元化」；选项 It will become increasingly diversified. 在「多文化进入」之上多走一步，推出 diversified 这个原文未说的结论。
records.keyword_relation: surely an evolving countryside is inevitable ↔ It is destined to change gradually.；rural life has continuously evolved ↔ It is destined to change gradually.

evidence.text: Whilst an idealised view of the countryside is common, the reality is that rural life has continuously evolved. Industrialisation brought an increase in divisions of labour, changing social links between rural people. The internet has introduced once foreign cultures into the countryside. Improved travel connections and affordability have made the world more accessible, creating a "global village". Considering these changes, surely an evolving countryside is inevitable

distractor_explanations.C: 以偏概全：The internet has introduced once foreign cultures into the countryside 只是段中三件平行例证之一，与「分工」「全球村」共同支撑「乡村必然演变」这一论点；选项 It is likely to embrace foreign cultures. 把单一例子当成结论。
distractor_explanations.D: 过度推断：creating a "global village" 强调「世界更可及、变成地球村」，并不等于乡村会「越来越多元化」；选项 It will become increasingly diversified. 在「多文化进入」之上多走一步，推出 diversified 这个原文未说的结论。

records.stem: What does the author think of the future of the countryside compared with cities?

options.text: It is going to be harder for the locals.
It is going to resemble that of cities.
It is less likely to stay static.
It is less easy to envisage.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author think of the future of the countryside compared with cities? 问作者对未来的对比判断，原文末段直接给出明示对比，不需推断。
【拆句】 What does the author think of the future of the countryside compared with cities? 中 compared with cities 是过去分词短语作 future 的后置定语，意为「与城市相比的乡村的未来」；句子结构稍长但语义直白。
【定位】 P7 We know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities, but the future of the countryside is less clear. 我们知道，世界将看到新城从尘土中崛起、现有城市发展为超大型城市，但乡村的未来则不那么清晰。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 P7 未提及 harder for the locals；本地人变难的话题在 P4 leaving them unaffordable for local people 出现过，但与「未来对比」无关；选项把跨段细节挪过来冒充末段对比的结论。 B) 与原文相反 原文 but the future of the countryside is less clear 把乡村未来与城市未来拉开差距；选项 It is going to resemble that of cities. 反说「乡村未来会像城市的未来」，把对比关系反转为类似关系。 C) 答非所问 But change is inevitable 谈的是变化必然，It is less likely to stay static. 复述这一变化必然性；但本题问的是「乡村未来与城市未来相比」这一对比维度，C 答的是「乡村是否会变」的另一维度。 D) ✓ 正确 but the future of the countryside is less clear ↔ It is less easy to envisage. We know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities ↔ It is less easy to envisage. 对比型细节题正确项必须同时保留比较关系与比较内容；D 既保留 less，又把 clear 同义置换为 easy to envisage，与预判完全契合。
records.keyword_relation: but the future of the countryside is less clear ↔ It is less easy to envisage.；We know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities ↔ It is less easy to envisage.

evidence.text: We know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities, but the future of the countryside is less clear

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：P7 未提及 harder for the locals；本地人变难的话题在 P4 leaving them unaffordable for local people 出现过，但与「未来对比」无关；选项把跨段细节挪过来冒充末段对比的结论。
distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：原文 but the future of the countryside is less clear 把乡村未来与城市未来拉开差距；选项 It is going to resemble that of cities. 反说「乡村未来会像城市的未来」，把对比关系反转为类似关系。
distractor_explanations.C: 答非所问：But change is inevitable 谈的是变化必然，It is less likely to stay static. 复述这一变化必然性；但本题问的是「乡村未来与城市未来相比」这一对比维度，C 答的是「乡村是否会变」的另一维度。

records.stem: What does the passage say about the statement "beauty is in the eye of the beholder"?

options.text: It has hardly ever been disputed.
Many people have found it absurd.
People have long been misled by it.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does the passage say about the statement 把范围圈死在那句引语上，要求复述作者对它的具体描述，不是推断也不是主旨。
【拆句】 What does the passage say about the statement "beauty is in the eye of the beholder"? 主干是 What does the passage say about X，X = the statement "beauty is in the eye of the beholder"；structure 平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Statements, like "beauty is in the eye of the beholder(观看者)", are rarely questioned. 诸如「美在观看者的眼中」这样的说法，几乎从不受到质疑。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 rarely questioned ↔ hardly ever been disputed 预判「几乎无人质疑」与 hardly ever been disputed 在频率与语义上完全等值，锁定 A。 B) 偷换概念 It can be interpreted aesthetically 说「它可被审美地解读」，与原文 rarely questioned 完全无关；作者只说「无人质疑」，没说「可被审美解读」。 C) 与原文相反 原文说「人们觉得 absurd to think otherwise」（反着想才荒谬），而 Many people have found it absurd 把「荒谬」直接扣给那句谚语本身，正话反说。 D) 无中生有 People have long been misled by it 说「人们长期被它误导」，原文只说作者「想 push back 一下」，并未给该谚语贴「误导」标签。
records.keyword_relation: rarely questioned ↔ hardly ever been disputed

evidence.text: Statements, like "beauty is in the eye of the beholder(观看者)", are rarely questioned

distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：It can be interpreted aesthetically 说「它可被审美地解读」，与原文 rarely questioned 完全无关；作者只说「无人质疑」，没说「可被审美解读」。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：原文说「人们觉得 absurd to think otherwise」（反着想才荒谬），而 Many people have found it absurd 把「荒谬」直接扣给那句谚语本身，正话反说。
distractor_explanations.D: 无中生有：People have long been misled by it 说「人们长期被它误导」，原文只说作者「想 push back 一下」，并未给该谚语贴「误导」标签。

records.stem: What does a recent study exploring aesthetic taste show?

options.text: Aesthetic tastes tend to differ from person to person.
Natural beauty is rarely surpassed by artificial beauty.
There is less consensus on objects shaped by human craft.
There is general agreement on what is pleasing to the eye.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does a recent study exploring aesthetic taste show 问的是一项具体研究 show 出什么——属于事实复述。
【拆句】 What does a recent study exploring aesthetic taste show? 主干是 What does a study show；exploring aesthetic taste 是 study 的现在分词后置定语，作用是限定哪项研究。结构清晰，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 The results from this study show that people agree very much in their aesthetic evaluation of natural objects, but they disagree more about artifacts, or human-made objects. 这项研究的结果显示，人们对自然物的审美评价高度一致，但对人造物（即人工制造的物品）则分歧更多。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 Aesthetic tastes tend to differ from person to person 把原文「人造物上分歧」扩大成「审美口味本来就因人而异」，丢掉了原文「自然物上一致」这一半。 B) 偷换概念 Natural beauty is rarely surpassed by artificial beauty 把研究讲成「自然美几乎不被人造美超越」，原文谈的是「评价一致性」，不是「美的优劣比较」。 C) ✓ 正确 they disagree more about artifacts, or human-made objects ↔ less consensus on objects shaped by human craft 预判要求选项聚焦「人造物上分歧更多」，less consensus on objects shaped by human craft 完整对应该语义，锁 C。 D) 以偏概全 There is general agreement on what is pleasing to the eye 只说「人们对什么好看普遍一致」，丢掉了原文「对人造物分歧更多」这关键一半，与研究的对比结论不符。
records.keyword_relation: they disagree more about artifacts, or human-made objects ↔ less consensus on objects shaped by human craft

evidence.text: The results from this study show that people agree very much in their aesthetic evaluation of natural objects, but they disagree more about artifacts, or human-made objects

distractor_explanations.A: 以偏概全：Aesthetic tastes tend to differ from person to person 把原文「人造物上分歧」扩大成「审美口味本来就因人而异」，丢掉了原文「自然物上一致」这一半。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：Natural beauty is rarely surpassed by artificial beauty 把研究讲成「自然美几乎不被人造美超越」，原文谈的是「评价一致性」，不是「美的优劣比较」。
distractor_explanations.D: 以偏概全：There is general agreement on what is pleasing to the eye 只说「人们对什么好看普遍一致」，丢掉了原文「对人造物分歧更多」这关键一半，与研究的对比结论不符。

records.stem: Why do people differ in their aesthetic appraisal of artifacts?

options.text: They come out in a great variety of designs.
They lead to varying behavioral consequences.
They take up much less natural space than landscapes.
They come into people's view less often than natural spaces.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 Why do people differ in their aesthetic appraisal of artifacts 问的是一项已写明的具体原因，不是让你推断作者的言外之意。
【拆句】 Why do people differ in their aesthetic appraisal of artifacts? 一般疑问句结构 Why do S V O，differ in 是固定搭配（在某方面有差异）；无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 Art and architecture, unlike natural spaces, do not have the same level of exposure. So, people do not have the same level of shared taste. 艺术与建筑（不像自然空间）没有同等程度的曝光度。因此，人们对它们的共同审美趣味也达不到同样的程度。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 They come out in a great variety of designs 谈的是「设计多样」，与原文给出的原因 exposure 完全无关；这是 P9 里 a wide array of embodiments 的话被移花接木过来。 B) 与原文相反 P6 明说差异 has to do more with elements of style, rather than "behavioral consequences"——作者用 rather than 否定了 behavioral consequences；They lead to varying behavioral consequences 反而把被否定的那一支抬回来当原因。 C) 无中生有 They take up much less natural space than landscapes 说人造物比自然景观「占用的自然空间更少」，原文从未做过这种空间面积比较；这是按生活常识替原文补造的对比。 D) ✓ 正确 do not have the same level of exposure ↔ come into people's view less often than natural spaces 预判要求「人造物被看到的机会少」，与 come into people's view less often than natural spaces 完全等值，锁 D。
records.keyword_relation: do not have the same level of exposure ↔ come into people's view less often than natural spaces

evidence.text: Art and architecture, unlike natural spaces, do not have the same level of exposure. So, people do not have the same level of shared taste

distractor_explanations.A: 答非所问：They come out in a great variety of designs 谈的是「设计多样」，与原文给出的原因 exposure 完全无关；这是 P9 里 a wide array of embodiments 的话被移花接木过来。
distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：P6 明说差异 has to do more with elements of style, rather than "behavioral consequences"——作者用 rather than 否定了 behavioral consequences；They lead to varying behavioral consequences 反而把被否定的那一支抬回来当原因。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：They take up much less natural space than landscapes 说人造物比自然景观「占用的自然空间更少」，原文从未做过这种空间面积比较；这是按生活常识替原文补造的对比。

records.stem: What does the example of sunset tell about nature?

options.text: It creates a powerful appeal through its brilliant radiance.
It displays aesthetic traits in a similar way the world over.
It embodies beauty with a wide array of aesthetic features.
It establishes the principles of beauty in a number of ways.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （例证目的题）
【判型】 What does the example of sunset tell about nature 问的是举这个例子是为了告诉读者关于 nature 的什么——典型的「例证目的」考法。
【拆句】 What does the example of sunset tell about nature? 主干 What does X tell about Y；tell 在此处意为 reveal / indicate（说明、揭示），不要按字面理解为「告诉某人某事」。
【定位】 P8 Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features, such as radiance, in a common way throughout the world. It's not exactly the same everywhere, but it is common. For example, a sunset is similar enough in different places to warrant almost universal appeal. 自然界以共通的方式在世界各地呈现某些普遍的审美特征（比如光辉）。各处并不完全相同，但确实有共通之处。例如，落日在不同地方足够相似，因而几乎能引起普世的吸引力。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 It creates a powerful appeal through its brilliant radiance 谈的是「落日靠光辉本身创造强烈吸引力」，是 sunset 例子的表层描写，不是例子要说明的论点（共通性）。 B) ✓ 正确 Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features, such as radiance, in a common way throughout the world ↔ It displays aesthetic traits in a similar way the world over 预判要求「自然在全球以共通方式呈现审美特征」，It displays aesthetic traits in a similar way the world over 与论点句逐项匹配，锁 B。 C) 张冠李戴 It embodies beauty with a wide array of aesthetic features 借用 a wide array of embodiments 与 Possible universal principles of beauty 的短语，但 P9 谈的是「美的原则允许多样体现」，不是 sunset 例子要说明的内容。 D) 过度推断 It establishes the principles of beauty in a number of ways 把「sunset 例证一种共通呈现方式」夸大成「确立了多个美学原则」，原文从未把 sunset 提到「确立原则」的高度。
records.keyword_relation: Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features, such as radiance, in a common way throughout the world ↔ It displays aesthetic traits in a similar way the world over

evidence.text: Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features, such as radiance, in a common way throughout the world. It's not exactly the same everywhere, but it is common. For example, a sunset is similar enough in different places to warrant almost universal appeal

distractor_explanations.A: 答非所问：It creates a powerful appeal through its brilliant radiance 谈的是「落日靠光辉本身创造强烈吸引力」，是 sunset 例子的表层描写，不是例子要说明的论点（共通性）。
distractor_explanations.C: 张冠李戴：It embodies beauty with a wide array of aesthetic features 借用 a wide array of embodiments 与 Possible universal principles of beauty 的短语，但 P9 谈的是「美的原则允许多样体现」，不是 sunset 例子要说明的内容。
distractor_explanations.D: 过度推断：It establishes the principles of beauty in a number of ways 把「sunset 例证一种共通呈现方式」夸大成「确立了多个美学原则」，原文从未把 sunset 提到「确立原则」的高度。

records.stem: Why do artifacts not always hold universal appeal?

options.text: The appreciation of their beauty is not subject to objective standards.
The universal principle of beauty prevents a wide array of embodiments.
The way their creators apply the principle of beauty may not be pleasing to everybody.
Their creators interpret the universal principle of beauty each in their preferred way.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
