Determine whether one is left-brained or right-brained.
Tell if one is more of a linguist or of a mathematician.
Ascertain how one's brain performs different tasks.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What do numerous personality quizzes online claim they are able to do? 是 What 引导的事实性提问，问"quizzes 声称做什么"，可直接回原文找事实陈述。
【拆句】 题干主干 What do…quizzes…claim they are able to do?，What 作 do 的宾语，they are able to do 是 claim 的宾语从句；结构平铺，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant. 网络上有成百上千的性格测试，宣称它们能够查明你的左半脑还是右半脑占主导。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 Distinguish between the two hemispheres of one's brain 说的是"区分大脑的两个半球"——这是解剖事实而非测试声称的本事，与原文承诺的"判断哪边占主导"不同。 B) ✓ 正确 ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant ↔ Determine whether one is left-brained or right-brained B 项把定位句改写成"判断一个人是左脑型还是右脑型"，与预判一致，且严格落在 P1 首句的字面承诺范围内。 C) 答非所问 Tell if one is more of a linguist or of a mathematician 取自 excel at language and math 的延伸描述，是"左脑型人"的衍生特征，而非测试本身宣称要做的事。 D) 张冠李戴 Ascertain how one's brain performs different tasks 的内容来自 different areas of the brain do different things，那是科学界的事实，不是"测试"声称要做的；动词 Ascertain 虽与原文同词，但宾语错配。
records.keyword_relation: ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant ↔ Determine whether one is left-brained or right-brained

evidence.text: There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：Distinguish between the two hemispheres of one's brain 说的是"区分大脑的两个半球"——这是解剖事实而非测试声称的本事，与原文承诺的"判断哪边占主导"不同。
distractor_explanations.C: 答非所问：Tell if one is more of a linguist or of a mathematician 取自 excel at language and math 的延伸描述，是"左脑型人"的衍生特征，而非测试本身宣称要做的事。
distractor_explanations.D: 张冠李戴：Ascertain how one's brain performs different tasks 的内容来自 different areas of the brain do different things，那是科学界的事实，不是"测试"声称要做的；动词 Ascertain 虽与原文同词，但宾语错配。

records.stem: What does the author say is sometimes stranger than fiction?

options.text: How one hemisphere of the brain impacts creativity.
How the two halves of our brains work alternately.
How the two hemispheres of our brains cooperate.
How one half of the brain dominates the other.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say is sometimes stranger than fiction? 问作者明说的内容，是对原文一句话的事实复现。
【拆句】 题干主干 What does the author say is…?，What 是表语补足语，is sometimes stranger than fiction 修饰 What 指向的具体事物；结构简单。
【定位】 P3 But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction. 但关于我们大脑两个半球如何协同运作的真实科学，有时比小说还要离奇。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 How one hemisphere of the brain impacts creativity 关注"某一个半脑对创造力的影响"，定位句强调的是"两半协同"，主体数量不符；creativity 也是从前文带过来的旁支话题。 B) 偷换概念 How the two halves of our brains work alternately 把 work together 改成 work alternately（轮流工作），意思完全不同——一个是同时合作，一个是交替使用。 C) ✓ 正确 the two halves of our brains work together ↔ the two hemispheres of our brains cooperate C 项把 "halves…work together" 替换成 "hemispheres…cooperate"，是定位句的等值改写。 D) 与原文相反 How one half of the brain dominates the other 正是文章一开头就否定的"左右脑主导说"，与定位句乃至全文立场相反。
records.keyword_relation: the two halves of our brains work together ↔ the two hemispheres of our brains cooperate

evidence.text: But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：How one hemisphere of the brain impacts creativity 关注"某一个半脑对创造力的影响"，定位句强调的是"两半协同"，主体数量不符；creativity 也是从前文带过来的旁支话题。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：How the two halves of our brains work alternately 把 work together 改成 work alternately（轮流工作），意思完全不同——一个是同时合作，一个是交替使用。
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：How one half of the brain dominates the other 正是文章一开头就否定的"左右脑主导说"，与定位句乃至全文立场相反。

records.stem: Why did many scientists have difficulty endorsing the idea that different areas of the brain do different things?

options.text: It contradicts the assumption that the two hemispheres of the brain are symmetrical.
It dismisses the view that the universe has been evolving in a consistent manner.
It is in conflict with the suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain work together.
It disrupts the idea that the right hemisphere of the brain controls the left side of the body.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 Why did many scientists have difficulty endorsing the idea…? 问原因，且原因通常在原文同句以 because/since 给出。
【拆句】 题干主干 Why did many scientists have difficulty endorsing the idea…?，that different areas of the brain do different things 是 idea 的同位语从句，解释 idea 内容；理解关键是 endorsing="赞同/接受"，不是"支持"商业意味。
【定位】 P5 But many scientists struggled with this idea, because the very suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain operate differently disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry. 但许多科学家难以接受这个观点，因为"大脑左右半球运作方式不同"这一论断本身就动摇了"自然界趋向完美对称"的观念。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry ↔ contradicts the assumption that the two hemispheres of the brain are symmetrical A 项把"动摇自然对称预设"这一动作改写为"与左右脑对称的预设相矛盾"，二者在本语境下指代同一观念，定位句即等于 A 项。 B) 无中生有 It dismisses the view that the universe has been evolving in a consistent manner 把对象从"自然对称"扩展为"宇宙演化方式"，原文未涉及宇宙演化的话题。 C) 张冠李戴 It is in conflict with the suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain work together 把矛盾对象说成"两半脑协同"，但原文中科学家排斥的不是"协同"，而是"对称"预设；况且"协同"是 P3 的肯定观点，本身不会被科学家抗拒。 D) 张冠李戴 It disrupts the idea that the right hemisphere of the brain controls the left side of the body 取自 P4 的解剖事实，是脊椎动物的客观规律，不可能被科学家抗拒；动词 disrupts 虽与原文同词，宾语却换错。
records.keyword_relation: disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry ↔ contradicts the assumption that the two hemispheres of the brain are symmetrical

evidence.text: But many scientists struggled with this idea, because the very suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain operate differently disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry

distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：It dismisses the view that the universe has been evolving in a consistent manner 把对象从"自然对称"扩展为"宇宙演化方式"，原文未涉及宇宙演化的话题。
distractor_explanations.C: 张冠李戴：It is in conflict with the suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain work together 把矛盾对象说成"两半脑协同"，但原文中科学家排斥的不是"协同"，而是"对称"预设；况且"协同"是 P3 的肯定观点，本身不会被科学家抗拒。
distractor_explanations.D: 张冠李戴：It disrupts the idea that the right hemisphere of the brain controls the left side of the body 取自 P4 的解剖事实，是脊椎动物的客观规律，不可能被科学家抗拒；动词 disrupts 虽与原文同词，宾语却换错。

records.stem: What belief have neuroscientists long rejected according to the passage?

options.text: There are left-dominant people and right-dominant people with different personalities.
There are noticeable differences between the left and right hemispheres of the brain.
One's personality is hardly related to the different halves of the brain.
Different areas of the brain are responsible for different activities.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What belief have neuroscientists long rejected according to the passage? 问"哪个观念被拒"，是对原文一处明确表态的复现。
【拆句】 题干主干 What belief have neuroscientists long rejected…?，long 修饰 rejected 表"长久以来一直拒绝"；现在完成时 + long，强调持续否定，是定位句的语气信号。
【定位】 P6 The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false. That's never been supported in the neuroscience community. Neuroscientists don't believe that and never have. "存在左脑主导型人和右脑主导型人、并且这与人格有关"这一观念是完全错误的。神经科学界从未支持过这种说法。神经科学家不相信这种说法，也从未相信过。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality ↔ There are left-dominant people and right-dominant people with different personalities A 项就是定位句被 categorically false / never been supported 否定的那个具体观念，与预判一致。 B) 与原文相反 There are noticeable differences between the left and right hemispheres of the brain 是 there are really important differences between the left hemisphere and the right hemisphere 明确肯定的事实，神经科学界并不拒斥它。 C) 与原文相反 One's personality is hardly related to the different halves of the brain 正是作者本人和神经科学界所持的立场（人格与左右脑无关），不是他们"长期拒绝"的观念。 D) 与原文相反 Different areas of the brain are responsible for different activities 是 different areas of the brain do different things 的同义改写，是科学界共识，不可能被"长期拒绝"。
records.keyword_relation: we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality ↔ There are left-dominant people and right-dominant people with different personalities

evidence.text: The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false. That's never been supported in the neuroscience community. Neuroscientists don't believe that and never have

distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：There are noticeable differences between the left and right hemispheres of the brain 是 there are really important differences between the left hemisphere and the right hemisphere 明确肯定的事实，神经科学界并不拒斥它。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：One's personality is hardly related to the different halves of the brain 正是作者本人和神经科学界所持的立场（人格与左右脑无关），不是他们"长期拒绝"的观念。
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：Different areas of the brain are responsible for different activities 是 different areas of the brain do different things 的同义改写，是科学界共识，不可能被"长期拒绝"。

records.stem: What are we advised to do with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves?
records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What are we advised to do…? 问作者给出的具体建议，原文末段必有对应明示。
【拆句】 题干主干 What are we advised to do with an online quiz…?，that tells us something about ourselves 是 quiz 的定语从句；advise sb. to do 的被动 are advised to do 是常见结构，注意 with 引出对象 "对……怎么办"。
【定位】 P7 When you come up with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves, we're drawn to that. It's irresistible. But you have to take it with an enormous grain of salt. 当出现一份告诉我们自身某些情况的网络测试时，我们会被吸引，难以抗拒。但你必须对它持极大的保留态度。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 Challenge its authority 暗示要去"挑战其权威性"，但原文只是建议保留态度、不轻信结论，并未要求与之对抗。 B) 无中生有 Scrutinize its originality 让人去审查"原创性"，原文丝毫未涉及测试是否原创的问题。 C) 答非所问 Evaluate its popularity 评的是"测试的流行程度"，与作者给读者的"个人如何对待结论"的建议完全错位。 D) ✓ 正确 take it with an enormous grain of salt ↔ Question its reliability 把习语 take it with an enormous grain of salt 还原为字面意 question its reliability，与预判一致。
records.keyword_relation: take it with an enormous grain of salt ↔ Question its reliability

evidence.text: When you come up with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves, we're drawn to that. It's irresistible. But you have to take it with an enormous grain of salt

distractor_explanations.A: 过度推断：Challenge its authority 暗示要去"挑战其权威性"，但原文只是建议保留态度、不轻信结论，并未要求与之对抗。
distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：Scrutinize its originality 让人去审查"原创性"，原文丝毫未涉及测试是否原创的问题。
distractor_explanations.C: 答非所问：Evaluate its popularity 评的是"测试的流行程度"，与作者给读者的"个人如何对待结论"的建议完全错位。

records.stem: What do we learn about team teaching from the passage?

options.text: It is generally conducted in classrooms without walls.
It allows students to choose teachers they favor most.
It prioritizes peer work over classroom instruction.
It is closely coordinated despite seeming confusion.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What do we learn about team teaching from the passage? 不含 infer/imply/main idea，问的是对 team teaching 的客观描述，属概括式细节。
【拆句】 What do we learn about team teaching from the passage? 主干为 What...do we learn，about team teaching 修饰 learn 的对象，from the passage 是来源状语，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P3 What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day. 看上去时不时像一团乱麻的场面，实际上是经过精心编排的方案：每天清晨，Westwood 的团队会碰头，为当天他们要重点关注的每个学生敲定一份个性化方案。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 classrooms without walls 把 dissolve the walls that separate their classes 的比喻当成物理上没有墙的教室，完全曲解原意。 B) 无中生有 文中从未提及让学生选择喜爱的教师；The teachers share large groups of students 强调教师轮换而非学生选师。 C) 偷换概念 原文 rotate between group instruction, one-on-one interventions, small study groups 把团体讲授与小组活动并列，并未说同伴协作优先于课堂讲授。 D) ✓ 正确 What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan ↔ It is closely coordinated despite seeming confusion 预判要求的看似混乱/实则编排两层语义，It is closely coordinated despite seeming confusion 两层都覆盖，结构对应整齐。
records.keyword_relation: What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan ↔ It is closely coordinated despite seeming confusion

evidence.text: What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day

distractor_explanations.A: 偷换概念：classrooms without walls 把 dissolve the walls that separate their classes 的比喻当成物理上没有墙的教室，完全曲解原意。
distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：文中从未提及让学生选择喜爱的教师；The teachers share large groups of students 强调教师轮换而非学生选师。
distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：原文 rotate between group instruction, one-on-one interventions, small study groups 把团体讲授与小组活动并列，并未说同伴协作优先于课堂讲授。

records.stem: What does initial research suggest regarding Westwood's innovative teaching model?

options.text: It could help raise teachers' pay.
It could turn out to be a success.
It could cut down overall costs.
It could end up like a gamble.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What does initial research suggest 直接索取研究的结论，属客观事实复述。
【拆句】 What does initial research suggest regarding Westwood’s innovative teaching model? 主干是 What does initial research suggest，regarding... 引导对象状语，等同 about，结构清楚。
【定位】 P4 By giving teachers more opportunity to collaborate, Mesa's administrators hoped to fill staffing gaps and boost teacher morale and retention. Initial research suggests the gamble could pay off. 通过让教师有更多协作机会，Mesa 的管理层希望补齐师资缺口、提升教师士气与留任率。初步研究显示这场赌博可能会奏效。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 overhauling teaching approaches can’t fix all the frustrations teachers have, such as low pay 明确指出教学模式改革解决不了低薪问题，故团队教学不能 raise teachers’ pay。 B) ✓ 正确 Initial research suggests the gamble could pay off ↔ It could turn out to be a success 预判要求 团队教学可能成功，It could turn out to be a success 与定位句语义、情态强度完全对齐。 C) 无中生有 全文未提及团队教学能降低总体成本；P4 谈的是士气、留任率与师资缺口，不是成本。 D) 偷换概念 原文 the gamble could pay off 中 gamble 仅是对 the model 的比喻指代，意为 这场赌博能赢；end up like a gamble 把赌博当成最终结果，等于说一切像赌博一样不确定，与原文积极语义相反。
records.keyword_relation: Initial research suggests the gamble could pay off ↔ It could turn out to be a success

evidence.text: By giving teachers more opportunity to collaborate, Mesa's administrators hoped to fill staffing gaps and boost teacher morale and retention. Initial research suggests the gamble could pay off

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：overhauling teaching approaches can’t fix all the frustrations teachers have, such as low pay 明确指出教学模式改革解决不了低薪问题，故团队教学不能 raise teachers’ pay。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：全文未提及团队教学能降低总体成本；P4 谈的是士气、留任率与师资缺口，不是成本。
distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：原文 the gamble could pay off 中 gamble 仅是对 the model 的比喻指代，意为 这场赌博能赢；end up like a gamble 把赌博当成最终结果，等于说一切像赌博一样不确定，与原文积极语义相反。

records.stem: What did superintendent Andi Fourlis say about the teaching profession?

options.text: Morale cannot be boosted until teaching models are overhauled.
Teachers are simply too busy to visit classes of their colleagues.
Progress is slow due to lack of collaboration among teachers.
Teachers often do fantastic things without being noticed.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What did superintendent Andi Fourlis say 直接索取人物原话观点，属观点细节。
【拆句】 What did superintendent Andi Fourlis say about the teaching profession? 主干 What did Andi Fourlis say，superintendent 同位语解释身份，about the teaching profession 限定话题，结构无陷阱。
【定位】 P5 "Teachers are doing fantastic things, but it's very rare a teacher walks into another room to see what's happening," said Andi Fourlis, superintendent of Mesa Public Schools. "Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation." Mesa 公立学校负责人 Andi Fourlis 说：教师们正在做着了不起的事情，但教师走进另一间教室看看发生什么的情况非常少见。我们这个行业进步如此缓慢，是因为我们在孤立地工作。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 原文未提出 士气提升必须先 overhaul 教学模式 这一条件关系；P5 谈的是进步缓慢的原因，不是 morale 的前提条件。 B) 偷换概念 原文是 it’s very rare a teacher walks into another room，即极少发生，并未给出 too busy 这一原因；选项擅自补充忙作为原因。 C) ✓ 正确 Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation ↔ Progress is slow due to lack of collaboration among teachers C 完整保留 进步慢←孤立工作 的因果方向，且情态/极性与原文一致。 D) 偷换概念 原文 Teachers are doing fantastic things, but it’s very rare a teacher walks into another room 的重点是 同行看不见，而非 不被注意；选项把同行无法观摩偷换为更宽泛的不被注意。
records.keyword_relation: Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation ↔ Progress is slow due to lack of collaboration among teachers

evidence.text: Teachers are doing fantastic things, but it's very rare a teacher walks into another room to see what's happening," said Andi Fourlis, superintendent of Mesa Public Schools. "Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation

distractor_explanations.A: 过度推断：原文未提出 士气提升必须先 overhaul 教学模式 这一条件关系；P5 谈的是进步缓慢的原因，不是 morale 的前提条件。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：原文是 it’s very rare a teacher walks into another room，即极少发生，并未给出 too busy 这一原因；选项擅自补充忙作为原因。
distractor_explanations.D: 偷换概念：原文 Teachers are doing fantastic things, but it’s very rare a teacher walks into another room 的重点是 同行看不见，而非 不被注意；选项把同行无法观摩偷换为更宽泛的不被注意。

records.stem: What does the author want to show by citing English teacher Jeff Hall's experience?

options.text: English teachers and science teachers are complementary in performing their tasks.
A teacher of arts and letters is completely puzzled by what a science teacher teaches.
The new teaching model helps inform the teacher how their instruction is received.
Science teachers will hardly know the confusion they create without a performance appraisal.

records.explanation:

records.stem: What does the U.S. secretary of education say in his open letter?

options.text: It is of vital importance to respond promptly to the school absence crisis.
The academic performance of chronically absent students is deplorable.
Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to school absences.
The effect of school absences on American education is worrisome.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What does the U.S. secretary of education say in his open letter? 问的是某人具体说的内容，答案就在原文某句话里，不需推断。
【拆句】 结构是 What does the U.S. secretary of education say in his open letter?——典型 what 引导的特殊疑问句，主语 the U.S. secretary of education，谓语 say，介词短语 in his open letter 限定 say 的发生场景；无从句、无否定、无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement. 他的公开信指出，一年缺课 10%——无论是否有故——是低学业成就的一个主要原因。
【选项】 A) 过度推断 公开信里没有任何关于 "必须迅速回应" 的话——urging communities to support every student 是劝学校社区支持学生出勤，不是对 respond promptly 的呼吁；A 项把作者（urging）的动作改写成信件内容，且加了原文没有的 "vital importance / promptly" 程度词。 B) 偷换概念 deplored 在原文里描述的是 Education officials 对 "all this missed instruction" 的态度，B 项把它偷换成了 "chronically absent students 的 academic performance is deplorable"——主语从 "缺课现象" 偷换成 "学生的学业表现"，evaluatee 错位。 C) ✓ 正确 missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason ↔ school absences is a primary cause of low academic achievement ↔ Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to C 项把 missing 10% of school days … is a primary cause of low academic achievement 的主动因果倒装为 "低学业主要归因于缺课" 的被动因果，与预判 "缺课是学业差的主因" 完全吻合。 D) 张冠李戴 公开信原文用 primary cause 的客观因果定性，并未对 "school absences 对美国教育的影响" 作 worrisome 这种情感色彩评价——D 项把 Worrying 段的句首词搬到这里，但那是作者对 "担心缺勤" 的转述，并非教育部长公开信的内容。
records.keyword_relation: missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason ↔ school absences；is a primary cause of low academic achievement ↔ Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to

evidence.text: His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement

distractor_explanations.A: 过度推断：公开信里没有任何关于 "必须迅速回应" 的话——urging communities to support every student 是劝学校社区支持学生出勤，不是对 respond promptly 的呼吁；A 项把作者（urging）的动作改写成信件内容，且加了原文没有的 "vital importance / promptly" 程度词。
distractor_explanations.B: 偷换概念：deplored 在原文里描述的是 Education officials 对 "all this missed instruction" 的态度，B 项把它偷换成了 "chronically absent students 的 academic performance is deplorable"——主语从 "缺课现象" 偷换成 "学生的学业表现"，evaluatee 错位。
distractor_explanations.D: 张冠李戴：公开信原文用 primary cause 的客观因果定性，并未对 "school absences 对美国教育的影响" 作 worrisome 这种情感色彩评价——D 项把 Worrying 段的句首词搬到这里，但那是作者对 "担心缺勤" 的转述，并非教育部长公开信的内容。

records.stem: What do the authors find about school absences?

options.text: Excused school absences have little impact on children's learning.
There is little difference between unexcused and excused absences.
Excused absences lead to comparatively better school performance.
Unexcused absences are a big challenge to both schools and families.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What do the authors find about school absences? 问的是作者的客观发现，原文必有对应陈述句，不属于推断。
【拆句】 结构是 What do the authors find about school absences?——What 作 find 的宾语，主语 the authors，介词短语 about school absences 限定 find 的话题范围；句法简单，没有陷阱。
【定位】 P6 We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning. 我们发现，由家长请假的 excused absences 对孩子的学习几乎没有伤害。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 absences excused by a parent ↔ Excused school absences do little to harm children's learning ↔ have little impact on children's learning A 项是 P6 第一句的字面同义改写——主语 excused absences、谓语 do little to harm 全部一一对应，无任何添加或扭曲，与预判完全吻合。 B) 与原文相反 原文 the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none 明确指出 unexcused 与 excused 差异很大——B 项 little difference 与原文 much worse 直接相反。 C) 过度推断 原文只说 excused absences do little to harm、有 excused 缺勤的孩子 have test scores equal to their peers who have no absences——是 "equal to"（相当），不是 comparatively better（相对更好）。"持平" 被悄悄抬升为 "更好"。 D) 答非所问 Unexcused absences are a big challenge to both schools and families 谈的是 unexcused 对学校和家庭构成挑战——题干 Q47 问的是 "authors 关于 school absences 的发现"，作者的核心发现是 excused 不损学（P6），而非 unexcused 对学校家庭有多挑战。话题偏离。
records.keyword_relation: absences excused by a parent ↔ Excused school absences；do little to harm children's learning ↔ have little impact on children's learning

evidence.text: We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning

distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：原文 the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none 明确指出 unexcused 与 excused 差异很大——B 项 little difference 与原文 much worse 直接相反。

records.stem: What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.?

options.text: Children's academic performance depends on reducing the number of absences.
Schools can boost children's academic performance by effective intervention.
Schools as well as families should be held responsible for out-of-school crises.
Children's academic performance is closely related to the quality of instruction.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.? 问的是原文已经写明的预设，不是要读者推断政策背后的隐含逻辑。
【拆句】 结构是 What is the assumption underlying education policies in the U.S.?——主语是 the assumption，underlying 是现在分词作后置定语（= that underlies），限定 assumption 是 "作为政策基础的" 那种预设；不要把 underlying 误读为时间状语。
【定位】 P11 They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences. 这些政策还预设，学校能通过减少学生缺勤来有效进行干预。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文 missing school for any reason harms children academically 是 "缺课损学业"——A 项 Children's academic performance depends on reducing the number of absences 把它倒过来说 "学业取决于减少缺勤"，表面相近但因果主语错位：原文主语是 "缺课"，A 项主语变成 "学业"，且 depends on 把单向因果偷换为 "取决于" 这一更强的依存关系。 B) ✓ 正确 schools will be able to effectively intervene ↔ Schools can boost children's academic performance by effective intervention by reducing student absences + These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically ↔ boost children's academic performance B 项把第二个 assume（学校能有效干预）与前一句的因果（缺课损学业）合起来——干预 → 减少缺勤 → 提升学业，是政策预设的完整逻辑，与预判吻合。 C) 张冠李戴 原文 hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss 说政策让学校和家庭对 "缺课天数" 负责，而不是对 out-of-school crises 负责——"out-of-school crises" 是 out-of-school challenges 里的概念，C 项把它扣到了 "政策让学校家庭负责的对象" 头上，移花接木。 D) 无中生有 原文从头到尾在讨论 attendance / absences / missed instruction（错过的教学），从未讨论 the quality of instruction（教学质量）——D 项凭空引入 "教学质量" 概念，与原文核心论域无关。

records.stem: What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences?

options.text: Directing resources to helping needy children.
Pressuring schools to reduce unexcused ones.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences? 问的是作者明说的建议，原文有原句，不需推断。
【拆句】 结构是 What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences?——suggest doing 是 suggest 接动名词的固定搭配，What 在动名词 doing 后充当宾语；regarding = about，限定话题。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P13 We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most. 我们反而建议：把无故缺勤作为信号，把资源调配给最需要这些资源的孩子和家庭。
【选项】 A) 答非所问 原文 P13 的建议是 "把 unexcused absence 当信号 → 把资源调配给需要者"，不是 Identifying their underlying causes（找缺勤的根本原因）——作者已经在前文给出原因（家庭/社区危机），末段不再建议 "找原因"，而是 "用信号导资源"。 B) 过度推断 原文 P10–P12 批评了现行政策，但 We instead suggest 的建议内容是 "用 unexcused absence 当信号导资源"，而不是 Reframing school attendance policies（重构考勤政策）——作者直接给出替代做法，没把 "重构政策" 作为建议本身提出。 C) ✓ 正确 channel resources to ↔ Directing resources to the children and families who need them most ↔ needy children C 项把 channel resources to 直接对应 Directing resources to，把 who need them most 压缩为 needy——两步同义改写都是六级高频考法，与预判完全吻合。 D) 与原文相反 原文 P12 明确指出现行政策 pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often 是负面后果，作者是 "批评施压"——D 项 Pressuring schools to reduce unexcused ones 反而把 "施压学校" 作为作者的建议，与原文立场完全相反。

options.text: Figure out what is the most fascinating job.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What did the author advise people do for almost a decade 用 What did 直接问事实，没有 infer/suggest/imply/mainly about 等推断或主旨信号。
【拆句】 What did the author advise people do for almost a decade 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 the author advise people do，advise sb. do 处省略 to（口语化结构），for almost a decade 是时间状语修饰整个动作，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same. "Follow your passion," I counseled. "You can figure out the employment stuff later." 在将近十年的时间里，我告诉我遇到的每一个人：他们应该和我做一样的事。我劝告说：「追随你的激情」「就业那些事儿你以后再琢磨」。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 Figure out what is the most fascinating job 把 fascinated 这个形容作者自己研究方向的词嫁接到 job 上，原文 P2 是作者劝别人 follow passion，不是劝别人去找最有趣的工作。 B) 张冠李戴 Follow widely accepted career counsel 把作者自己当年发出的建议描述为去跟随别人的建议，但原文 I counseled 表明作者本人就是 counsel 的发出者。 C) 偷换概念 Pursue their careers with passion 是『用激情去追求事业』，原文是『追随你的激情』，二者并不等价：前者是把激情当工作态度，后者是把激情当工作方向。 D) ✓ 正确 Follow your passion ↔ Do whatever they are zealous for 预判答案是『追随激情/做自己热爱的事』，Do whatever they are zealous for 用 zealous for 同义替换 passion，正中预判。

records.stem: What is important to turning one's passion into a stable, good-paying job?

options.text: Willingness to take unpaid internships and low-paying jobs.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What is important to turning one's passion into a stable, good-paying job 问的是某事的关键条件，是事实层面的细节题。
【拆句】 What is important to turning one's passion into a stable, good-paying job 中 turning ... job 是动名词短语作介词 to 的宾语，a stable, good-paying job 中两个形容词并列修饰 job，无陷阱。
【定位】 P8 Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans in the meantime. They are also better situated to take unpaid internships to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent. And they often have access to parents' social networks to help them find jobs. 出身富裕家庭的激情追随者更有能力等到自己真正热爱的工作出现，同时不必担心助学贷款；他们也更有条件接受无薪实习以打开职业大门，因为有父母替他们付房租；而且，他们往往可以借助父母的社会人脉帮自己找工作。

records.stem: What happens when everyone is encouraged to follow their passion?

options.text: Many more career aspirants end up unemployed.
People are less concerned with socioeconomic inequality.
Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist.
Career counselors are going to lose credibility.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What happens when everyone is encouraged to follow their passion 问的是一个已发生在原文里的具体结果，不需推断。

【判型】 What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem? 问的是被势利者认定值得尊重的具体人群类别，是文中明示的事实
【拆句】 主干 What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem，deem 是「认为、视为」的正式动词，等于 consider；worth respect and esteem 作 deem 的宾语补足语。需注意 deem 不是常见词，但句式 deem sb. worth doing/sth. 与 consider sb. worth 同构。
【定位】 P7 For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect. 在势利者眼中，唯有那些已经获得赞誉、已经取得成功的人，才是值得尊重的对象。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 the already acclaimed and already successful ↔ Those with fame and fortune 预判核心是「已获得外在声名地位的人」，A 项 Those with fame and fortune 用名词 fame and fortune 浓缩了 acclaimed 与 successful 两个分词 B) 张冠李戴 There is no room in their timid regimented minds 中的 regimented minds 是描写势利者 their 的心智状态（胆怯、刻板），不是「被尊重的对象」；选项把势利者的特征张冠到「被尊重者」头上 C) 与原文相反 At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence 说势利者缺乏想象力；someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society 说「聪明、善良的人反而被社会忽略」——这部分人恰恰是势利者「看不到」的，而不是势利者尊敬的对象 D) 与原文相反 their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil 中的「品质藏于陌生面纱之下」，主体仍是被社会忽略的、品质未显的人，正是势利者「看不见」而非「尊敬」的对象

records.stem: What does the author imply we should do to avoid being snobbish?

options.text: Be aware there has never been such a thing as a better or worse person.
Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives.
Realize that better or worse keeps changing in unexpected ways.
Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （推断题）
【判型】 What does the author imply we should do 中的 imply 是明确的推断信号词，要求由作者明示主张做「一步逻辑延伸」得出建议
【拆句】 主干 What does the author imply we should do，to avoid being snobbish 是不定式作目的状语；being snobbish 是 avoid 的动名词宾语（avoid 后只跟 v-ing）。结构简单，无陷阱。
【定位】 P8 And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path. 正因为我们其实并不善于判断他人的价值，所以我们最根本的义务始终是——对几乎每一个与我们相遇的人保持善良、温厚、好奇与想象力。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 原文 The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person 明确反对「无所谓好人坏人」这种说法；选项 there has never been such a thing as a better or worse person 却正是被作者明确否定的命题 B) ✓ 正确 to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path ↔ Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives our ultimate duty remains ↔ Be kind to... 预判三要素：第一是态度（善良、好奇）、第二是对象（每一个相遇者）、第三是语气（建议、应该）。B 项以祈使句 Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet 三要素全中 C) 偷换概念 better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places 说的是「好坏的人出现在意想不到的地方」——位置出乎意料；选项 better or worse keeps changing in unexpected ways 把它偷换成「好坏不断以意想不到的方式变化」——把空间分布偷换成动态变化 D) 与原文相反 carry none of the outward signs of distinction 直白说「不带任何显赫的外在标志」；选项 Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits 却要求依据「显著的性格特征」判断人，与原文明确否定的方向一致
records.keyword_relation: to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path ↔ Be kind to and curious about those who we happen to meet in our lives；our ultimate duty remains ↔ Be kind to...

evidence.text: And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path

distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places 说的是「好坏的人出现在意想不到的地方」——位置出乎意料；选项 better or worse keeps changing in unexpected ways 把它偷换成「好坏不断以意想不到的方式变化」——把空间分布偷换成动态变化
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：carry none of the outward signs of distinction 直白说「不带任何显赫的外在标志」；选项 Judge people on the basis of their distinctive character traits 却要求依据「显著的性格特征」判断人，与原文明确否定的方向一致

records.stem: What do we learn about the gender pay gap in the US during the 1980s?
records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about the gender pay gap in the US during the 1980s 直接问一个客观时间段的客观状况，没有 infer / imply / main idea 这类信号。
【拆句】 题干主干是 What do we learn about the gender pay gap，in the US during the 1980s 是修饰 "the gender pay gap" 的时间地点状语，句子结构简单、无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast. During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year. 但在美国 1980 年代，女性的薪酬开始追赶——而且速度很快。在那十年里，性别薪酬差距以每年约一个百分点的速度在缩小。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 It was being slowly closed 把原文的 fast 偷换成 slowly，方向完全相反。 B) ✓ 正确 they began to catch up—fast ↔ shrinking rapidly closed by about one percentage point a year ↔ rapidly 预判强调"差距在 1980 年代快速缩小"，It was shrinking rapidly 与之完全等值，且未引入任何额外含义，直接锁定 B。 C) 张冠李戴 It started to yawn 借用 the gap remains yawning 制造关联，但 yawning 在原文描述的是 P2 之后趋势停滞后差距依旧巨大的状态，不是 1980 年代发生的事，属于张冠李戴。 D) 答非所问 It remained substantial 描述的是 Women have historically been paid less 这种历史背景下的总体状态，并不针对题干所问的 1980 年代特征。
records.keyword_relation: they began to catch up—fast ↔ shrinking rapidly；closed by about one percentage point a year ↔ rapidly

evidence.text: But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up—fast. During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：It was being slowly closed 把原文的 fast 偷换成 slowly，方向完全相反。
distractor_explanations.C: 张冠李戴：It started to yawn 借用 the gap remains yawning 制造关联，但 yawning 在原文描述的是 P2 之后趋势停滞后差距依旧巨大的状态，不是 1980 年代发生的事，属于张冠李戴。
distractor_explanations.D: 答非所问：It remained substantial 描述的是 Women have historically been paid less 这种历史背景下的总体状态，并不针对题干所问的 1980 年代特征。

records.stem: What happened with the introduction of state and federal family leave policies?

options.text: The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse.
The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably.
The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started.
The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What happened with the introduction of... 问的是政策推行这一具体事件之后的客观结果，是典型的事实型提问。
【拆句】 with the introduction of state and federal family leave policies 是介词短语作状语，提示时间背景；句子无从句、无否定，结构平铺直叙。
【定位】 P5 After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since. 事实上，美国引入家庭休假政策之后，性别工资收敛率降至每年仅 0.03 个百分点，并自此一直停留在这个水平。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse 借用 that progress began to reverse during the pandemic，但原文的"反转"发生在大流行期间，不是家庭休假政策引入之后。 B) ✓ 正确 the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year ↔ The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably 选项几乎逐词保留了 the rate of gender wage convergence...fell 的主干，只把后面的具体数字抽象化，是最高度等值的同义替换，直接锁定 B。 C) 无中生有 The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started 借用 helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families，但原文只说政策让一些女性留下来，没有说"产后返岗成为新趋势"，且这不是题干"introduction后发生了什么"的核心结果。 D) 无中生有 The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention 把"差距缩小"和"引起更多关注"拼接在一起，但原文从未提及关注度变化，是凭空捏造。
records.keyword_relation: the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year ↔ The rate of gender wage convergence started to fall noticeably

evidence.text: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since

distractor_explanations.A: 张冠李戴：The process towards salary equity at work began to reverse 借用 that progress began to reverse during the pandemic，但原文的"反转"发生在大流行期间，不是家庭休假政策引入之后。
distractor_explanations.C: 无中生有：The trend of women returning to work after childbirth started 借用 helped those women to stay in the workplace—instead of dropping out to have families，但原文只说政策让一些女性留下来，没有说"产后返岗成为新趋势"，且这不是题干"introduction后发生了什么"的核心结果。
distractor_explanations.D: 无中生有：The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention 把"差距缩小"和"引起更多关注"拼接在一起，但原文从未提及关注度变化，是凭空捏造。

records.stem: What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries?

options.text: The insufficient motivation women generally have for career advancement.
The opportunities numerous women give up for pay raise and promotion.
The huge amounts of time and energy women spend taking care of the family.
The lack of policy support from government and business corporations.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What partly accounts for the slip in women's salaries 问的是导致薪水下滑的部分原因，答案应在原文有明确文本对应，不需推断。
【拆句】 题干主干 What partly accounts for the slip，in women's salaries 修饰 slip；副词 partly 提示原文只承担"部分"原因，不要求穷尽所有因素。
【定位】 P8 Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement. 部分原因在于女性在家承担了更多无偿劳动，这会侵蚀她们可用于工作的时间，以及用于职业发展的精力。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 The insufficient motivation women generally have for career advancement 把原因归结为女性自身"职业发展动力不足"，原文从未做出此种心理动机层面的归因。 B) 与原文相反 The opportunities numerous women give up for pay raise and promotion 暗示女性"主动放弃"涨薪机会，但原文 mothers are passed over for raises and promotion 是被动语态——她们是"被跳过"，不是"主动放弃"。 C) ✓ 正确 women take on more of the unpaid labor at home ↔ taking care of the family eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement ↔ The huge amounts of time and energy C 同时包含"时间和精力"与"照顾家庭"两个核心要素，对应定位句的两段含义，是定位句的高度同义改写，直接锁定 C。 D) 与原文相反 The lack of policy support from government and business corporations 把原因归为"缺乏政策支持"，但原文恰恰相反：政策（family leave）已经引入并提供支持，问题反而出在政策支持的副作用上。
records.keyword_relation: women take on more of the unpaid labor at home ↔ taking care of the family；eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement ↔ The huge amounts of time and energy

evidence.text: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement

distractor_explanations.A: 无中生有：The insufficient motivation women generally have for career advancement 把原因归结为女性自身"职业发展动力不足"，原文从未做出此种心理动机层面的归因。
distractor_explanations.B: 与原文相反：The opportunities numerous women give up for pay raise and promotion 暗示女性"主动放弃"涨薪机会，但原文 mothers are passed over for raises and promotion 是被动语态——她们是"被跳过"，不是"主动放弃"。
distractor_explanations.D: 与原文相反：The lack of policy support from government and business corporations 把原因归为"缺乏政策支持"，但原文恰恰相反：政策（family leave）已经引入并提供支持，问题反而出在政策支持的副作用上。

records.stem: What does the new study say about wage parity?

options.text: It would have stalled if those controllable problems had not been addressed.
It would have halted if company and government had not worked together.
It would have been achieved with the complete erasure of gender biases.
It would have been attained with the continuation of the 1980s trend.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What does the new study say about wage parity 要求复述研究的明确表述，而非读者推论，属于细节复述。
【拆句】 题干是简单疑问句，about wage parity 是介词短语作 say 的状语；结构简单。
【定位】 P9 The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now. 这项研究没有深入探讨那个问题，只是说如果 1980 年代的趋势延续下去，我们现在本应已经实现了薪酬平等。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 It would have stalled if those controllable problems had not been addressed 借用 once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed 制造对应，但原文是"问题已被解决之后还会有别的问题"，选项却说"如果没解决就会停滞"，方向颠倒。 B) 无中生有 It would have halted if company and government had not worked together 把"公司和政府合作"作为条件，但原文从未提及二者协同与否，只是说休假可由 company or government policy 支持。 C) 过度推断 It would have been achieved with the complete erasure of gender biases 借用 through the erasure of things like bias，但原文用了 things like bias 这种举例口吻，且只是 if 假设下的推测，并未说"完全消除偏见就能实现"。 D) ✓ 正确 if the 1980s trend continued ↔ with the continuation of the 1980s trend we would have been at parity by now ↔ It would have been attained D 把虚拟条件 if the 1980s trend continued 和结果 would have been at parity 一一对应，无缺漏无外加，是定位句最严格的同义改写。
records.keyword_relation: if the 1980s trend continued ↔ with the continuation of the 1980s trend；we would have been at parity by now ↔ It would have been attained

evidence.text: The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：It would have stalled if those controllable problems had not been addressed 借用 once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed 制造对应，但原文是"问题已被解决之后还会有别的问题"，选项却说"如果没解决就会停滞"，方向颠倒。
distractor_explanations.B: 无中生有：It would have halted if company and government had not worked together 把"公司和政府合作"作为条件，但原文从未提及二者协同与否，只是说休假可由 company or government policy 支持。
distractor_explanations.C: 过度推断：It would have been achieved with the complete erasure of gender biases 借用 through the erasure of things like bias，但原文用了 things like bias 这种举例口吻，且只是 if 假设下的推测，并未说"完全消除偏见就能实现"。

records.stem: What prevents women from achieving parity with men in the final analysis?

options.text: Ignoring biases against women in the workplace.
Giving birth to children and taking care of them.
Failing to mandate breaks for childbirth and care.
Lacking resources to address biological problems.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What prevents women from achieving parity with men in the final analysis 询问作者最终归因，答案对应原文末段一句明确归因句，不需多步推理。
【拆句】 prevents women from achieving parity with men 是 prevent sb from doing sth 结构；in the final analysis 是状语，意为"归根结底"，需要识别这个固定搭配才能锁定原文末段。
【定位】 P10 If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated. 如果 1980 年代女性的进步是通过消除偏见之类的东西取得的，那么一旦这些相对可控的问题被处理掉之后，女性身上仍然会存在一个问题——她们是承担生育以及在最初几周照料孩子的人，因为像哺乳能力这样的生理因素，迫使她们休假，无论这种休假是否被强制规定。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Ignoring biases against women in the workplace 把原因归为"忽视偏见"，但原文 through the erasure of things like bias 恰是说偏见已被消除，且作者强调即便消除之后仍有问题——并非"忽视"导致。 B) ✓ 正确 who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks ↔ Giving birth to children and taking care of them B 把末段长句中的两个核心动作（生育 + 照护）抽出并列，正好对应预判中的"生育和照顾孩子"两层根因，是最纯粹的同义改写，直接锁定 B。 C) 与原文相反 Failing to mandate breaks for childbirth and care 把"不强制规定休假"作为最终原因，但原文 whether or not those breaks were mandated 明确指出强制与否都没用，最终原因不是强制不强制。 D) 无中生有 Lacking resources to address biological problems 借用 biological factors like the ability to breastfeed，但原文从未说"缺乏资源去解决生物学问题"，且作者立场是生物学因素本身就难以绕开，不是资源问题。
records.keyword_relation: who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks ↔ Giving birth to children and taking care of them

evidence.text: If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women—who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated

distractor_explanations.A: 与原文相反：Ignoring biases against women in the workplace 把原因归为"忽视偏见"，但原文 through the erasure of things like bias 恰是说偏见已被消除，且作者强调即便消除之后仍有问题——并非"忽视"导致。
distractor_explanations.C: 与原文相反：Failing to mandate breaks for childbirth and care 把"不强制规定休假"作为最终原因，但原文 whether or not those breaks were mandated 明确指出强制与否都没用，最终原因不是强制不强制。
distractor_explanations.D: 无中生有：Lacking resources to address biological problems 借用 biological factors like the ability to breastfeed，但原文从未说"缺乏资源去解决生物学问题"，且作者立场是生物学因素本身就难以绕开，不是资源问题。

records.stem: 选择第 26 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 B) consequences 名词
【词性槽】 形容词 significant + ___ + for 介词短语

records.stem: What do we learn about successful changes in organizations?

records.explanation:

【拆句】 What do we learn about successful changes in organizations? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 we learn，about 介词短语限定 learn 的内容，successful changes 是真正的题眼，in organizations 是发生场域。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P2 That is largely because successful change requires more than a vision, it requires a workforce that not only doesn't resist change, but embraces it. 这在很大程度上是因为成功的变革不只需要愿景，它还需要一支不但不抵触变革、还会拥抱变革的员工队伍。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 They can be immediately implemented with great ease. 称变革「轻易立刻落地」，但 Most organizations aspire to deploy significant change programs, only to find them nearly impossible to implement 明说大多数变革极难落地，两者完全相反。 B) 偷换概念 They are usually led by organization leaders of vision. 把成功变革的关键归到「有远见的领导」上，但定位句 successful change requires more than a vision 恰恰说仅有 vision 不够，关键在 workforce；把强调点偷换了。 C) ✓ 正确 it requires a workforce that not only doesn't resist change, but embraces it ↔ They call for enthusiastic support from the workforce. a workforce ↔ the workforce They call for enthusiastic support from the workforce. 的「require + 全员热情支持」与定位句 requires a workforce that ... embraces it 精准对位，且对位完整、无外加成分。 D) 强加因果 They often result from simulation learning experiences. 说成功变革「源于」模拟学习，但全文逻辑是 simulation 服务于 change，并非 change 的来源；定位句也未涉及 simulation。

【定位】 P6 The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning. 在数量无限、零风险的模型里探索、实验并反复运用新知的能力，正是让 simulation 成为最高效学习方式之一的原因。

records.stem: What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible?

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible? 是问明确做法的标准细节题。
【拆句】 What should participants do in a simulation to reap the greatest benefits possible? 主干 What should participants do，in a simulation 是地点状语，to reap the greatest benefits possible 是目的不定式，possible 后置修饰 benefits。无陷阱。
【定位】 P7 To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing. 为最大化从模拟中获得的收益，参与者应立刻把从体验中所学应用到工作中，以打通「学」与「做」之间的桥梁。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 Take the experience as a mere game. 让参与者「把体验当作单纯的游戏」，但 If they don't, they will view the experience as a game, which can be difficult to apply on the job 明确把「视为游戏」当作负面后果。 B) ✓ 正确 participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience ↔ Apply promptly what they learn to their jobs. to forge a smooth link between learning and doing ↔ to their jobs B 在副词（promptly ↔ immediately）、核心动作（apply what they learn ↔ apply the learning）与落点（to their jobs ↔ between learning and doing）三处与定位句完全对位。 C) 答非所问 Develop a deep level of understanding. 取自 enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding，那是 simulation 的功效（果），不是参与者「应当做什么以最大化收益」（因）。 D) 无中生有 Strive to connect closely with their leaders. 让参与者「努力与领导紧密联系」，但全文从未要求 participants 去与 leaders 建立紧密联系，原文 forge a link 的对象是 learning 与 doing，不是 participants 与 leaders。

records.stem: What does the passage say is the more recent thinking of economic growth?

options.text: It is vital to the future of humanity.
It should be governments' chief concern.
It is an indicator of government performance.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does the passage say is the more recent thinking of economic growth\? 问「文章说……是什么」，要的是原文给出的具体表述，不是要考生推断。
【拆句】 主干是 What does the passage say is the more recent thinking of economic growth\?，what 是 say 的宾语，is 引导的从句作 say 的真正宾语；不要把 is 误读成主句谓语。结构清晰、无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 Unlimited growth is not sustainable, and economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability in our economic models. 无限增长不可持续，经济思潮正转向「我们应当在经济模型中以可持续为目标」这一理念。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 we should aim for sustainability in our economic models ↔ It should be made sustainable 预判「应追求可持续」与 It should be made sustainable 字面同向，无需推断，直接锁定。 B) 偷换概念 原文说「可持续经济」对未来重要 a sustainable economy is vital to our future，主语是「sustainable economy」，而非 It（指 economic growth）本身。 C) 与原文相反 原文明确 GDP growth … should not be the primary goal of governments，作者主张增长不应是政府首要关切，It should be governments' chief concern 正好相反。 D) 与原文相反 原文首句即否定 GDP growth is not a good indicator of how well a country is performing，It is an indicator of government performance 正是这个被否定的旧观点。

records.stem: Why are some people opposed to the idea that governments should focus on happiness?

options.text: Governments cannot impose happiness on citizens.
People's happiness is built upon their own endeavor.
Happiness means different things to different people.
Happiness depends on sustainable economic growth.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 Why are some people opposed to the idea that governments should focus on happiness\? 问「反对的原因」，原文必有一段集中陈述反对理由。
【拆句】 主干 Why are some people opposed to the idea，后接 that 引导的同位语从句解释 idea 的内容；opposed to 是固定搭配「反对」，不要看成被动语态。
【定位】 P2 Even on the broadest interpretation of 'happiness' as prosperity or 'life satisfaction', people want different things. 即使把「幸福」理解到最宽泛的程度——视为「繁荣」或「生活满意度」——人们想要的东西也各不相同。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 Governments cannot impose happiness on citizens 是作者本人的让步（governments cannot impose life satisfaction on citizens），而非反对者的反对原因，时空错位。 B) 无中生有 原文 P2 从未提到「幸福建立在个人努力上」；endeavor 在全文不存在，是凭空添加的因果。 C) ✓ 正确 people want different things ↔ Happiness means different things to different people Don't different people experience different levels of happiness\? ↔ Happiness means different things to different people 「幸福因人而异」与 Happiness means different things to different people 同义，三个反问句的共同指向皆收束于此。 D) 强加因果 P1 把 sustainable 与 happiness 视为两条不同线索，原文从未说 Happiness depends on sustainable economic growth；该选项把两个概念强行嫁接。

records.stem: What does philosopher Julian Baggini suggest governments do in a recently published article?

options.text: Try to reduce inequality between the rich and the poor.
Provide people with access to resources for a better life.
Change people's behaviors to put social wealth to better use.
Make use of advanced technologies to improve people's lives.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What does philosopher Julian Baggini suggest governments do 是经典「某人的具体主张」型细节题。
【拆句】 主干 What does philosopher Julian Baggini suggest governments do，suggest 后接省略 that 的宾语从句 governments do (what)，what 是 do 的宾语前置——理解为「Baggini 建议政府做什么」。
【定位】 P4 Access is key: people do not need to own, but rather access things that enable them to live well. 「使用权」是关键：人们不必拥有，而是要能用上那些让他们生活得更好的东西。
【选项】 A) 以偏概全 could help reduce inequality 只是 Baggini 主张的「附带效益」（could help），不是其建议政府该做的核心；选项 A 把附带效益当成主张主体。 B) ✓ 正确 access things that enable them to live well ↔ Provide people with access to resources for a better life 预判「让公民能用上让生活更好的资源」与 Provide people with access to resources for a better life 字面同向。 C) 偷换概念 原文说 changes in social behavior enable us to make more efficient use of the assets，是「社会行为已发生的变化」让现有资产用得更高效；选项把它改成「政府去改变人们行为以更好利用社会财富」，主动者与目的都被偷换。 D) 以偏概全 Technological advances 在原文同样只是 access 模型成立的「条件」，不是 Baggini 给政府的建议；选项 D 抓了边缘条件而漏掉主张句。

records.stem: Why does the WHO feel the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to justify its recommendations?

options.text: Mental health programs cannot be executed without GDP growth.
Psychological interventions are conducive to people's wellbeing.
Poor mental health is detrimental to a nation's economic system.
Governments still take economic development as their priority.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （推断题）
【判型】 Why does the WHO feel the need to appeal to the economic benefits 问「WHO 为何觉得有必要诉诸经济利益」，答案不在 WHO 这句的字面，而要从作者紧接的评论中推断政府的倾向。
【拆句】 主干 Why does the WHO feel the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to justify its recommendations\?，feel the need to do = 觉得有必要做，to justify 是目的状语——「为了让其建议显得合理」。
【定位】 P6 It says a lot, however, that the WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to persuade governments that the cost of taking proposed measures is justified. As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens' continued productivity. 然而，WHO 不得不诉诸「改善心理健康带来的经济收益」来说服政府这一举措的成本合理，这一点本身就说明了问题：只要政府仍把经济置于首位，他们就只关心公民能否继续创造产值。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 原文从未说「无 GDP 增长就执行不了心理健康项目」，仅说「政府要看到经济收益才肯掏钱」；选项 A 把动机改成了执行前提，凭空捏造。 B) 答非所问 Psychological interventions are conducive to people's wellbeing 是事实陈述，原文 improving mental health 也支持这一点，但题干问的是「WHO 为何要诉诸经济收益」，与「干预有益健康」无关。 C) 偷换概念 原文强调「政府以经济为先」是导致 WHO 必须用经济话术的「原因」；选项 C 反过来说「心理健康差对经济不利」是 WHO 用经济话术的原因——把工具变成了动机来源。 D) ✓ 正确 As long as the economy is their priority ↔ Governments still take economic development as their priority It says a lot, however, that the WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits ↔ Governments still take economic development as their priority 「政府只听经济话术」的根本原因即「政府仍以经济为先」，与 Governments still take economic development as their priority 同义。

records.stem: What message does the author try to convey at the end of the passage?

options.text: Governments should consider citizens' views in decision-making.
Governments should set sustained productivity as their top priority.

records.explanation:

records.stem: What does the author say about human beings?

options.text: They cannot prosper without cooperating with each other.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 What does the author say about human beings? 问的是作者就 human beings 这一具体对象说了什么，落点在某一具体陈述上而非整篇主旨。
【拆句】 What does the author say about human beings? 是常规疑问句结构，主干 "the author say"，关于 human beings，无从句、无否定、无比较，结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 As interdependent beings we cannot thrive independent of others. 作为相互依赖的存在，我们无法脱离他人独自繁荣兴盛。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 thrive ↔ prosper cannot thrive independent of others ↔ cannot prosper without cooperating with each other They cannot prosper without cooperating with each other. 把 cannot thrive independent of others 改写为"必须合作才能兴旺"，正是预判内容的同义转述。 B) 偷换概念 They share a common interest and believe in a just cause. 取自 we share a common interest, or who also believe in a cause we are serious about，但原文这是"喜欢和谁一起工作"的举例，不是对 human beings 的总体陈述；且 cause 被偷换为 just cause（正义事业）。 C) 过度推断 They think and behave alike in different social groups. 声称"在不同群体中想法行为都一样"，原文只说人喜欢和"like-minded"的人共事，并未说人在所有群体中思想行为都相同。 D) 与原文相反 They cannot gain independence without fighting for it. 谈"独立要靠斗争争取"，但原文 we cannot thrive independent of others 强调的是"无法独立"而非"为独立而战"，话题相反。
records.keyword_relation: thrive ↔ prosper；cannot thrive independent of others ↔ cannot prosper without cooperating with each other

records.stem: What do we learn about solidarity in an increasingly diverse society?

records.stem: What would we witness in the setting of communitarianism?

options.text: Ruling of social norms and ridding of individuality.

【拆句】 What would we witness in the setting of communitarianism? 主干 "we would witness"，"in the setting of communitarianism" 限定情境，would 表示一般陈述语气，无难点。
【定位】 P5 In this setting, individuals give up their own interests to serve the common good. 在这种情境下，个人放弃自身利益以服务于共同利益。

records.stem: What do social theorists think of solidarity?

records.stem: What is the finding of one study about people who keep giving unsolicited advice?

options.text: They turn out to be well-meaning.
They are capable of influencing others.
They are inclined to crave for power.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 题干 What is the finding of one study 指向某个具体研究的事实性结论，不含 infer/imply/mainly。
【拆句】 题干主干是 What is the finding of one study，about 引导的介词短语修饰 finding，限定研究对象是 people who keep giving unsolicited advice（who 引导定语从句修饰 people）。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。
【定位】 P1 One study found that people with a high tendency to seek power were more likely to give advice than those with an opposite tendency. 一项研究发现，求权欲望强的人比求权欲望相反（低）的人更倾向于给出建议。

records.stem: How is the advice giver likely to react to the rejection of their advice?

options.text: They may regard it as a threat.

【答案】 A （细节题）
【判型】 题干 How is the advice giver likely to react 问的是一个原文中有具体描述的反应方式。
【拆句】 主干 How is the advice giver likely to react，to 引导的介词短语 to the rejection of their advice 表反应对象。likely to 是预测性短语，对应原文的 may/possibly 等情态表达。
【定位】 P5 If the act of giving advice is contributing actively to someone's feelings of self-worth, an outright rejection may be perceived as a threat, activating their fight-or-flight response, possibly causing them to double down on their validation-seeking behavior, or leading to a larger conflict. 如果给建议这一行为正主动地构建着对方的自我价值感，那么一次直率的拒绝可能被对方视为威胁，激活其“战或逃”反应，可能导致他们加倍寻求认可，或引发更大的冲突。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 may be perceived as a threat ↔ They may regard it as a threat 预判“视为威胁”在四项中只与 They may regard it as a threat 形成 1:1 同义对应；B/C/D 均取自定位句末尾的分词链或脱离原文。 B) 与原文相反 They may modify their behavior 暗示劝告者会调整行为；原文却是 double down on their validation-seeking behavior——加倍重复原行为，方向相反。 C) 过度推断 They get ready for a larger conflict 描述劝告者“准备好”打更大架；原文是 possibly...leading to a larger conflict，只是分词链中可能的下游结果，并非劝告者主动准备。 D) 与原文相反 They begin to doubt their self-worth 说劝告者开始怀疑自己；原文方向相反——他们的 self-worth 被威胁后，会更努力地寻求认可（double down on validation-seeking），而不是怀疑。

records.stem: What do we learn from the passage about practicing mindfulness?

It helps our mind to stay calm when facing judgments from others.

records.explanation:
【答案】 B （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn from the passage about practicing mindfulness 问的是文章关于 mindfulness 的客观陈述，没有 infer/imply/mainly 这类信号，是一道关于 mindfulness 本质特征的细节题。

【定位】 P2 This means simply that it is possible to observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment in a way that amplifies the feeling or sends the mind spiraling off into thinking about old memories or anticipating events. 这意味着，我们可以观察自己产生渴望、愉快念头甚至恐惧情绪，而无需在当下作出反应、不放大该情绪，也不让心思滑向旧时记忆或对未来事件的预期。
【选项】 A) 与原文相反 原文 without … sends the mind spiraling off into thinking about old memories or anticipating events 明确把「回想旧事 / 预期未来」放在否定结构里，是正念要避免的，A 把它说成正念的作用，恰好与原文相反。 B) ✓ 正确 observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment ↔ focuses our attention on the present moment we learn not to react to experience with likes and dislikes or judgments of good and bad ↔ without making judgments 预判落在「观察当下、不卷入、不评判」三点上，focuses our attention on the present moment without making judgments 把前两点合在一句里全覆盖，是定位句的紧贴改写。 C) 偷换概念 原文 observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment 强调观察情绪而不卷入，C 项却说「把注意力集中在个人情绪上」，把「观察」偷换成「集中」，两者一冷静一沉浸，语义错位。 D) 张冠李戴 原文谈的是「自己不对体验作好坏评判」（judgments of good and bad），并未涉及「他人评判我们」，D 项把评判主体从「自我」换成「他人」，无原文依据。

evidence.text: This means simply that it is possible to observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment in a way that amplifies the feeling or sends the mind spiraling off into thinking about old memories or anticipating events

distractor_explanations.C: 偷换概念：原文 observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment 强调观察情绪而不卷入，C 项却说「把注意力集中在个人情绪上」，把「观察」偷换成「集中」，两者一冷静一沉浸，语义错位。

【拆句】 What do we see in today's "attention economy" according to Jenny Odell? 主干 What do we see in today's attention economy，according to Jenny Odell 是把观点归属到具体人物的状语，关键在于答案必须落到 Odell 的话上，而不是文章自己说的。
【定位】 P4 The artist Jenny Odell argues that in our "attention economy" human attention has been transformed into a commodity that big corporations buy and sell. 艺术家 Jenny Odell 论述道：在我们的「注意力经济」中，人的注意力已经被转化成大公司买卖的商品。
【选项】 A) 偷换概念 原文 This economy rests on a technological revolution of mobile phones and social media that makes it possible for corporations to target our attention with their content at every moment 说技术革命让公司能持续抢占注意力，没说技术让产品/服务持续更新，A 项偷换了技术革命的作用。 B) ✓ 正确 human attention has been transformed into a commodity that big corporations buy and sell ↔ People's attention is turned into something that can be bought and sold 选项 B 几乎是 Odell 原话的一对一改写，主语、动词、对象、属性四要素全对齐，是 according to 型细节题里最干净的同义替换。 C) 偷换概念 原文 buy and sell 的宾语是 human attention（人的注意力），C 项把宾语偷换成 mobile phones and social media，是把抽象对象偷换成具体技术，正好踩中考生「具象更易接受」的认知偏误。 D) 无中生有 原文谈的是公司买卖「人的注意力」，并未谈消费者本身是否冲动消费；D 项关于「人们购买商品不细想」属凭空生造。

records.stem: What benefit can practicing mindfulness bring to us according to some scholars?

options.text: It prevents us from making arbitrary judgments about others.
It shifts our attention from material things to spiritual pursuits.
It is conducive to our forging better interpersonal relationships.
It is helpful in regaining our ability to enjoy what we have in life.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What benefit can practicing mindfulness bring to us according to some scholars 用 according to some scholars 归属信息源，是出处型细节题。
【拆句】 What benefit can practicing mindfulness bring to us according to some scholars? 主干 What benefit can practicing mindfulness bring to us，according to some scholars 是把观点归到学者群体的状语，注意不要把作者自己其它段落的好处当成学者说的。
【定位】 P6 Most mindfulness research focuses on the individual benefits of the practice, but some scholars assert that we can not only practice mindfulness for ourselves but also practice it for others. It can help us build stronger, healthier relationships. 多数正念研究关注其个人层面的益处，但一些学者论断：正念不仅可为己练，也可为他人而练；它能帮我们建立更稳固、更健康的人际关系。
【选项】 A) 张冠李戴 「不作评判」是 P3 谈 mindfulness 个体效用时的内容，而 Q49 问的是 some scholars 的观点；把 P3 的句子嫁接到学者名下属于张冠李戴，且 prevent us from making arbitrary judgments about others 也夸大了原文「自己不评判体验」的限定。 B) 无中生有 原文没有把好处归结为「从物质转向精神追求」，B 项凭空生造一组对立维度。 C) ✓ 正确 help us build stronger, healthier relationships ↔ conducive to our forging better interpersonal relationships C 项把学者观点收束句 help us build stronger, healthier relationships 完整改写成 conducive to our forging better interpersonal relationships，主体、动作、对象逐项对齐。 D) 张冠李戴 「重拾享受生活的能力」对应 relish the things that make life special, like being together with those we love，是作者自己的论述而非 some scholars 的观点；嫁接到学者名下属于张冠李戴。

records.stem: 选择第 26 空的词汇
records.explanation:
【答案】 J) impose 动词
【词性槽】 复数主语 proposals 之后缺谓语，需动词原形（一般现在时）
【依据】 impose caps/limits on 是政策语域的固定搭配，「对……设限」 The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases, preventing landlords in the state from raising rent more than the rate of inflation in most cases.——提案「对租金涨幅设上限」，呼应首段 put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices，impose caps on 与 put limits on 是同义改写，这正是六级最爱考的「换说法不换意思」。
【竞争词】 M) presume presume 意为「假定」，与 caps 不构成搭配且逻辑相反 presume 是「假定、推测」，presume caps 不是英语搭配；且提案是「实际设限」而非「假定存在上限」，代入后与后半句 preventing landlords…（实际阻止房东涨租）矛盾。
【易错】 最具迷惑性的错误词是 M) —— presume 与 impose 同为原形动词，「提案假定上限」粗读似乎也通 。The proposals __(26)__ caps on rent increases 中 presume 形态合格，且考生若只认识 presume 不认识 impose，容易用「熟悉的词」填。防坑：盯住宾语搭配——caps/limits 的舞伴是 impose（impose caps on），presume 后接的是「事实从句」；再回看首段 put some limits on ever-increasing rent prices，同义改写的锚点直接指向 impose。

records.stem: What do experts think of health secretary Matt Hancock's idea?

options.text: It is a welcome initiative but is long overdue.
Its success depends on how it is implemented.
It is too simplistic to produce the desired effect.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （细节题）
【判型】 What do experts think of health secretary Matt Hancock's idea? 主体（experts）与对象（Hancock's idea）都明确可定位，是观点类细节题；只是正确项需要把原文两处评价整合后认出，比对要求更高。

【定位】 P4 This idea has the virtue of simplicity, though some experts question its effects and call for a greater degree of differentiation, arguing that time online by itself is not a bad thing and it all depends on what you are doing. 这个想法有简单这一优点，不过一些专家质疑其效果，并主张更大程度的区别对待，理由是上网时间本身并非坏事，关键在于你在做什么。
【选项】 A) 无中生有 Its implementation requires prompt action. 称实施需要迅速行动，但专家对效果的质疑与'快慢'无关，prompt action 在原文没有任何对应表述，属于凭空添加的主张。 B) 张冠李戴 It is a welcome initiative but is long overdue. 里，welcome 出自作者对两项举措的总评 Both initiatives are welcome.，long overdue 出自作者对监管巨头滞后的批评 Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue.——两句都是作者的声音，且 overdue 说的还不是这个想法本身；题干问的是专家。 C) 偷换概念 原文专家说 it all depends on what you are doing——效果取决于你在网上做什么（内容），Its success depends on how it is implemented. 偷换成'取决于如何实施'；depends on 句型原样照搬，宾语却被整个换掉。 D) ✓ 正确 has the virtue of simplicity ↔ too simplistic some experts question its effects ↔ to produce the desired effect 预判'太简单、难奏效'正是 It is too simplistic to produce the desired effect. 的字面意思，且每一半都能在定位句找到出处（simplicity / question its effects），锁定 D。

records.stem: Besides social media companies, what factors contribute to young people's psychological health problems?

options.text: Poorly financed schools and health services.

【定位】 P5 Of course, social media companies are not the source of all our ills, and can offer a too-easy target for politicians keen to divert attention from inadequately resourced schools and health services. 当然，社交媒体公司并非我们所有问题的根源，而且它们很容易成为政客们的靶子——政客热衷于借此转移人们对投入不足的学校和医疗服务的关注。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 inadequately resourced schools and health services ↔ Poorly financed schools and health services. 预判候选'投入不足的学校与医疗服务'与 Poorly financed schools and health services. 仅修饰语有别，主体名词逐字相同，且它确属'社交媒体公司以外'的因素，锁定 A。 B) 答非所问 Politicians' eagerness to divert public attention. 取自 politicians keen to divert attention，但政客转移视线是对问题的掩盖手段，不是导致年轻人心理问题的成因；题干问的是 contribute to 心理问题的因素，此项答非所问。 C) 答非所问 Bad statutory regulation of digital media giants. 借自 P4 Statutory regulation of the digital media giants is long overdue.——监管缺位针对的正是数字媒体巨头本身，属于'社交媒体公司'这一条线，而题干用 Besides social media companies 明确把这条线排除在外；且 P5 列举的其他原因里也根本没有它。 D) 偷换概念 原文的另一成因是 increasing pressure to succeed in education and in life more broadly——年轻人自己在教育和人生上的成功压力；Their parents' educational background and life. 把 education and life 的原词留下，却硬是安上 parents' 这个原文没有的主体，把'自身压力'偷换成'父母背景'。

records.stem: What do we learn about the G-20's agreement on curbing the use of tax havens?

options.text: It has aggravated the problem in non-G-20 countries.
It has taken a toll on countries such as Cayman Islands.
It has failed to achieve the expected outcome.
It has failed to result in any long-term plan.

records.explanation:
【答案】 C （细节题）
【判型】 What do we learn about the G-20's agreement...? 询问关于该协议的事实信息，没有 infer/suggest/imply 等推断标志。
【拆句】 What do we learn about the G-20's agreement on curbing the use of tax havens? 为主谓宾结构，介词 on 后接动名词短语作后置修饰，整体无否定、比较等陷阱，平铺直叙。
【定位】 P1 About a decade ago, the G-20, a forum of the world's biggest economies, agreed to crack down on multinational corporations' abusive use of tax havens. This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices that shielded a large chunk of corporate profits from tax authorities. But, instead of reining in the use of tax havens—countries such as the Bahamas and Cayman Islands with very low or no effective tax rates—the problem has only gotten worse. 大约十年前，世界最大经济体论坛 G-20 同意打击跨国企业滥用避税天堂的行为。这产生了一项计划，旨在遏制将大量企业利润 shield 在税务机关之外的做法。但是，非但没有遏制避税天堂的使用——例如巴哈马和开曼群岛等实际税率极低或为零的国家——问题反而变得更糟。

This resulted in a plan that aimed to curb practices ↔ the expected outcome the problem has only gotten worse ↔ failed to achieve It has failed to achieve the expected outcome. 准确概括了 计划旨在遏制 与 问题反而恶化 之间的转折关系。 D) 与原文相反 原文 This resulted in a plan 明确说明协议产生了计划，选项却说 failed to result in any long-term plan。

【选项】 A) 无中生有 原文只提到全球有效企业税率从 23% 降至 17%，这是单向下降而非 fluctuating（波动），更非利润转移激增的主因。 B) ✓ 正确 U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens ↔ Lenient policies of the U.S. shift profits from high-tax countries to tax havens ↔ shift of profits to tax havens Lenient policies of the U.S. 是 U.S. policies that made it easier to shift profits... 的同义概括。 C) 偷换概念 原文 high-tax countries 指税率较高的国家，选项却偷换为 Heavy taxes imposed on them（对企业征收重税），将国家属性错误地套到企业上。 D) 偷换概念 原文 growth 的主语是 the tax avoidance industry，选项却改成 their business（跨国企业业务），主体被替换。

records.stem: What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end?

options.text: The alignment of corporate taxes with consumption taxes.
The implementation of generous tax rates in all countries.

records.explanation:

【拆句】 What does the author say would bring tax havens to an end? 中，What 引导宾语从句，would bring... to an end 是固定短语表'使...终结'，整体询问作者提出的充分条件。

records.stem: What could be expected of the global problem of profit-shifting in the near future?

options.text: It would be solved with more countries cutting tax rates.
It would end with governments' awareness of its severity.
It would cease to exist with worldwide corporate support.
It would continue because of noncooperation from the U.S.

records.explanation:
【答案】 D （推断题）
【判型】 What could be expected of... in the near future? 要求根据文中当前事实推断未来趋势，含有 could / expected / near future 等推断与未来指向词。
【拆句】 What could be expected of the global problem of profit-shifting in the near future? 中，could be expected of 表示'对...可以预期什么'，in the near future 限定时间范围，整体为推断语气。

records.stem: Why will private companies be motivated to join the effort of electrifying sub-Saharan Africa?

options.text: There is big money to be made.
They have enough funding in place.
South Africa has set a successful example.
Governments are turning to them for help.

records.explanation:
【答案】 A （推断题）
【判型】 Why will private companies be motivated to join the effort of electrifying sub-Saharan Africa?询问动机，需要由原文事实做一步逻辑延伸，而非直接找到原句。
【拆句】 Why will private companies be motivated to join the effort of electrifying sub-Saharan Africa?主干为Why will private companies be motivated，to join...为不定式短语表动作；被动语态be motivated提示询问驱动因素。
【定位】 P7 After all, electrifying sub-Saharan Africa is a $350 billion opportunity. 毕竟，让撒哈拉以南非洲通电是一个3500亿美元的机遇。
【选项】 A) ✓ 正确 a $350 billion opportunity ↔ There is big money to be made 3500亿美元的机会意味着可赚取大量金钱，There is big money to be made准确概括了这一动机。 B) 与原文相反/偷换概念 原文With the right funding and structure in place是前提条件，不是已经拥有足够资金；They have enough funding in place与原文相反。 C) 答非所问 南非是政府与私营部门合作的例子，不能直接说明私营企业参与的根本动机。 D) 强加因果/答非所问 政府求助是私营部门参与的外部条件，但题目问的是private companies自身的motivation，核心驱动力是商业机会。
